prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds `qwen update --target-version <version>` for standalone installations. An explicit target skips npm version discovery and installs that exact release through the existing download and verification flow, including `QWEN_UPDATE_BASE_URL`. Omitting the option preserves normal update discovery.

Concrete stable and prerelease versions accept an optional leading `v`. Explicit requests allow same-version reinstalls and downgrades. Invalid targets are rejected before downloading, and a downloaded executable reporting a different version is rejected before activation. Unsupported installation methods return an actionable error instead of suggesting an unpinned upgrade. Help and error text are localized.

## Why it's needed

Operators may already have selected a release while npm registry access is unavailable. Configuring a reachable artifact source alone does not help because the current update command performs registry discovery first. Explicit selection makes that dependency unnecessary and prevents discovery from choosing a different release.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run an explicit-version update with a custom HTTPS release root while npm registry access is unavailable. It should install exactly the selected version without invoking npm or contacting a registry.
- Try a concrete prerelease, a same-version reinstall and an explicit downgrade. Each should use the specified version and retain the previous installation for rollback.
- Try a mutable tag, malformed version, missing argument, unavailable archive, incorrect checksum or an archive whose executable reports a different version. Failures must preserve the original installation and clean up update locks and temporary files.
- For a non-standalone installation, expect a nonzero exit and instructions to install the selected version manually, without an unpinned package-manager command.
- Omit the target option and confirm that normal version discovery remains in use.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the installed CLI's update help has no target-version option; source always runs version discovery before downloading.

After: focused unit tests pass, and isolated CLI tests use a local HTTPS release source with registry access unavailable to verify exact installation and failure preservation. Detailed E2E evidence is posted separately.

Validation: full build, workspace typecheck, bundle, 170 focused tests, changed-file ESLint and Prettier checks passed. The npm lockfile was used for final validation; the optional pnpm layout exceeded an unrelated document-export asset budget, while the npm build passed that gate.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Tested: build, typecheck, unit tests and isolated CLI E2E |
| Windows | Not tested locally |
| Linux | Baseline update help only; new implementation not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 22.23.1. E2E runs use isolated home directories and disposable installations, a local HTTPS server with a temporary trusted CA, and network/subprocess guards. Downloaded fixtures contain a real Node runtime and a small version-reporting CLI; this verifies updater behavior, not the functionality of a complete new release. No real installation was updated.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: explicit requests intentionally permit reinstalls and downgrades. Version equality is now checked before activation for all standalone update entrypoints.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows deferred replacement, full release-package acceptance, daemon/UI upgrade orchestration and release approval policies.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: existing calls without the option retain version discovery; malformed versions are rejected more strictly.

## Linked Issues

Closes #11484

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

为独立安装新增 `qwen update --target-version <version>`。指定目标时跳过 npm 版本查询，通过现有下载与校验流程安装该精确版本，并继续支持 `QWEN_UPDATE_BASE_URL`。不指定参数时保留原有版本查询行为。

支持具体稳定版和预发布版本，以及可选的 `v` 前缀。显式请求允许同版本重装和降级。非法目标在下载前拒绝；下载后若程序报告的版本与目标不一致，则在激活前拒绝。不支持的安装方式返回可操作的错误提示，避免建议一个未固定版本的升级命令。帮助与错误文案已本地化。

## 需求背景

用户可能已经确定要安装的版本，但无法访问 npm registry。仅配置可访问的制品源仍然不够，因为当前升级命令会先查询 registry。指定版本可以移除这个依赖，并避免版本发现选择另一个版本。

## 审查者验证计划

### 验证方法

- 在 npm registry 不可用时，结合自定义 HTTPS 下载源执行指定版本升级。应准确安装目标版本，不调用 npm，也不访问 registry。
- 验证具体预发布版本、同版本重装和显式降级。每种情况均应使用指定版本，并保留旧安装以供回退。
- 验证可变标签、非法版本、缺少参数、制品不存在、校验不匹配和包内程序版本不匹配。失败必须保留旧安装，并清理锁与临时文件。
- 非独立安装应返回非零退出码，提示手动安装指定版本，不输出未固定版本的包管理器升级命令。
- 不提供目标参数时，应继续执行原有版本查询。

### 修改前后证据

修改前：已安装 CLI 的升级帮助中没有指定版本参数；源码在下载前始终查询版本。

修改后：相关单测通过；隔离 CLI 测试使用本地 HTTPS 制品源，在 registry 不可用的条件下验证准确安装及失败保护。详细 E2E 证据单独评论发布。

验证通过：完整构建、工作区类型检查、bundle、170 项相关测试，以及改动文件的 ESLint 和 Prettier 检查。最终验证使用 npm 锁文件；可选 pnpm 布局触发了无关的文档导出体积限制，npm 构建通过了同一门禁。

### 测试平台

- macOS：构建、类型检查、单测和隔离 CLI E2E 已验证。
- Windows：未在本地验证。
- Linux：仅检查基线升级帮助，未在本地验证新实现。

### 验证环境

Node.js 22.23.1。E2E 使用隔离 HOME、临时安装、本地 HTTPS 服务、临时受信 CA，以及网络和子进程监测。下载制品由真实 Node 运行时和精简的版本输出 CLI 组成，证明的是升级器行为，而非完整新版本的功能验收。未升级任何真实安装。

## 风险与范围

- 显式指定版本允许重装和降级；所有独立升级入口都会在激活前核对版本一致性。
- 未覆盖 Windows 延迟替换、完整发布包验收、daemon/UI 升级编排或版本审核策略。
- 未指定参数时保留现有行为；非法版本校验更加严格。

关联并关闭 #11484。

</details>

prs.title: feat(extensions): support unscoped npm installation and updates
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Allows extensions distributed as unscoped npm packages to be installed and updated using `package-name`, `package-name@version`, or `package-name@tag`. CLI and daemon installation accept these sources, and updates retain the saved package source and registry.

## Why it's needed

Previously, npm extension sources had to start with `@scope/`; an otherwise valid unscoped package failed with `Install source not found` before reaching the registry. Teams publishing unscoped extension packages could not use the npm installation/update flow.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Install an unscoped extension from a test registry, publish a newer latest version, and update the installed extension. Both a bare source and `@latest` should move to the newer version; an exact version should stay pinned, and `@beta` should follow beta independently of latest. Confirm scoped packages still install, existing local paths retain priority, and `owner/repo` remains a GitHub source. Daemon installation should accept an unscoped package with a registry override and reject a Git ref for npm sources.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the globally installed CLI rejects the unscoped fixture with `Install source not found`; a scoped control installs successfully from the same registry. After: see the separate E2E report comment for bundled CLI installation and update results.

Validation: 132 core tests and 1,441 CLI install/daemon server tests pass on the refreshed main baseline. Build, typecheck, bundle, lint, formatting, and isolated CLI E2E results are recorded in the separate report.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment

Isolated QWEN_HOME directories and a deterministic loopback npm registry serving harmless extension manifests; no model calls or user extension changes.

## Risk & Scope

- A missing bare filename that is also a valid npm name now resolves through npm; existing local files/directories retain priority. Use an explicit path for an intended local source.
- Existing relative-path/GitHub ambiguity and unscoped marketplace `:plugin` selectors over daemon routes are outside this change. Scoped marketplace selectors retain their existing behavior.
- No installation metadata migration, version policy change, new daemon route, or runtime ownership change.
- Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/unscoped-npm-extensions/docs/design/unscoped-npm-extensions.md) / [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/unscoped-npm-extensions/docs/design/unscoped-npm-extensions.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

支持通过 `package-name`、`package-name@version` 或 `package-name@tag` 安装及更新无 scope 的 npm 扩展。CLI 和 daemon 安装接受这些来源，更新保留已保存的包来源和 registry。

## 背景

此前 npm 扩展来源必须以 `@scope/` 开头；有效的无 scope 包名也会在请求 registry 前报 `Install source not found`，因此发布无 scope 扩展包的团队无法使用 npm 安装和更新流程。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

从测试 registry 安装无 scope 扩展，发布新的 latest 版本后更新。裸包名和 `@latest` 应升级到新版本，精确版本应保持固定，`@beta` 应独立于 latest 跟随 beta。确认 scoped 包仍可安装，已有本地路径保持优先，`owner/repo` 仍为 GitHub 来源。daemon 应接受带 registry 覆盖的无 scope 包，拒绝对 npm 来源指定 Git ref。

### 前后证据

改动前：全局 CLI 对无 scope 测试包报 `Install source not found`，同一 registry 中的 scoped 对照包安装成功。改动后：构建产物的安装和更新结果见独立 E2E 报告评论。

验证：同步 main 后，132 项核心测试及 1,441 项 CLI 安装/daemon server 测试通过。构建、类型检查、bundle、lint、格式检查及隔离 CLI E2E 结果见独立报告。

### 测试平台

macOS 已测试；Windows、Linux 未进行本地测试。

### 环境

使用隔离 QWEN_HOME 目录和提供无副作用扩展清单的确定性本地 npm registry；未调用模型或修改用户扩展。

## 风险与范围

- 不存在的裸文件名若同时为有效 npm 包名，将通过 npm 解析；已有本地文件/目录保持优先。若意图使用本地来源，应使用显式路径。
- 现有相对路径/GitHub 歧义及 daemon 中无 scope 的 marketplace `:plugin` 选择器不在本次范围内。已有 scoped marketplace 选择器行为保留。
- 不迁移安装元数据，不改变版本策略，不新增 daemon 路由或改变运行时归属。
- 设计文档：[英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/unscoped-npm-extensions/docs/design/unscoped-npm-extensions.md) / [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/unscoped-npm-extensions/docs/design/unscoped-npm-extensions.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联问题

无。

</details>

prs.title: ci(java): remove MariaDB full integration lane
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Run the complete Runtime Broker and Managed Agent database integration suite on MySQL 8.4 only. Remove the MariaDB matrix leg and engine-switching startup plumbing while retaining two isolated MySQL instances, the full test profile, missing-test guards, failure diagnostics and cleanup. Align the database support documentation and strengthen the retained JDBC contract with nonzero millisecond fixtures and precise-clock checks on MySQL.

## Why it's needed

MySQL is the maintained database target. Running the same full suite on MariaDB adds another engine to operate and qualify. Make that boundary explicit: MariaDB no longer has a CI lane or an ongoing compatibility guarantee, while existing production dialect handling remains in place.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm full SDK Java validation schedules one MySQL integration job, with an independent database instance for each Maven fork. All non-Hosted integration tests and the complete-report guard must still execute. Startup failures, readiness timeouts and a failure in the second instance must preserve diagnostics and cleanup. Hosted, failover, EventTransport and other Java jobs retain their previous definitions.

Confirm repository contracts preserve millisecond timestamps, lease renewal, takeover and stale-owner CAS behavior through both direct initialization and Flyway on H2 and MySQL. The real MySQL clock test must check precise and whole-second readings at UTC, +08:00 and -04:00.

Local evidence: nine workflow-consumer test files total 662 passed and 15 existing platform skips; seven selected H2 tests and three selected real-MySQL tests passed with no skips; Checkstyle, root build/typecheck, changed-script ESLint, formatting and two self-audit passes completed. The initial macOS Bash 3 run failed 22 unchanged reporter cases; all passed with Bash 5. The follow-up comment cleanup also passed all 21 report-guard tests. Fast CI at `28bdcb7` failed in unchanged workspace-recovery code with an H2 binary/string parameter mismatch; a standalone run of its three tests passed, so the CI failure remains unresolved and is not classified as infrastructure. The rewritten MySQL job was skipped by the fast tier and still needs full-tier CI before merge.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — CI and database verification changes; no UI changes.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64; Node 26.12.1; pnpm 11.24.0; Bash 5.3.20; JDK 21.0.8; Maven 3.9.14. Selected JDBC tests used a disposable native MySQL 8.4.11 instance with strict SQL mode, binary logging disabled and a 128 MiB packet limit, plus a freshly installed matching SDK in a task-specific Maven repository. Linux CI retains MySQL 8.4.6 with native AIO disabled; this local run does not validate that container setup. Java setup, validation and cleanup used 88.914 seconds of the shared 600-second budget, and the disposable database was stopped and removed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: MariaDB-specific regressions will no longer be detected by full CI; any future compatibility guarantee needs separate qualification.
- Not validated / out of scope: the complete Linux MySQL profile and Hosted/failover/EventTransport gates remain CI work. Production SQL and dialect handling are unchanged.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no schema, catalog migration or connection-admission changes. This narrows the documented ongoing database support target to MySQL.

Synchronized design updates: [JDBC scope in English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/53524a9b98ee9c7172bcbc655372a1986411b4c7/docs/design/managed-runtime-broker-jdbc.md) / [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/53524a9b98ee9c7172bcbc655372a1986411b4c7/docs/design/managed-runtime-broker-jdbc.zh-CN.md), and [lock/queue scope in English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/53524a9b98ee9c7172bcbc655372a1986411b4c7/docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.md) / [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/53524a9b98ee9c7172bcbc655372a1986411b4c7/docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.zh-CN.md). Additional synchronized designs: [verify toolchain in English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/53524a9b98ee9c7172bcbc655372a1986411b4c7/docs/design/verify-java-toolchain.md) / [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/53524a9b98ee9c7172bcbc655372a1986411b4c7/docs/design/verify-java-toolchain.zh-CN.md), and [integration optimization in English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/53524a9b98ee9c7172bcbc655372a1986411b4c7/docs/design/2026-10-22-mysql-ci-optimization.md) / [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/53524a9b98ee9c7172bcbc655372a1986411b4c7/docs/design/2026-10-22-mysql-ci-optimization.zh-CN.md). Historical MariaDB measurements are preserved.

## Linked Issues

N/A

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

Runtime Broker 和 Managed Agent 的完整数据库集成测试仅在 MySQL 8.4 上运行。移除 MariaDB 矩阵分支及切换引擎的启动逻辑，保留两个独立 MySQL 实例、完整测试 profile、漏测守卫、失败诊断及清理。同步数据库支持文档，并通过非零毫秒夹具和真实 MySQL 精确时钟检查加强保留的 JDBC 契约。

## Why it's needed

MySQL 是持续维护的数据库目标。在 MariaDB 上重复运行同一套完整测试，会增加另一个引擎的运维和验收成本。本次明确这一边界：MariaDB 不再有 CI 分支或持续兼容承诺，现有生产方言处理继续保留。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

确认完整 SDK Java 验证只调度一个 MySQL 集成任务，每个 Maven 分叉各用独立数据库实例。所有非 Hosted 集成测试及完整报告守卫必须继续执行。启动失败、就绪超时和第二个实例失败时，必须保留诊断及清理。Hosted、故障恢复、EventTransport 和其他 Java 任务保留原定义。

确认 Repository 契约在 H2 和 MySQL 的直接初始化及 Flyway 两条路径上，保持毫秒时间戳、租约续期、接管和过期持有者的 CAS 行为。真实 MySQL 时钟测试必须在 UTC、+08:00 和 -04:00 下同时检查精确读数及整秒读数。

本地证据：九个工作流消费者测试文件合计 662 项通过、15 项现有平台跳过；七项选定 H2 测试和三项选定真实 MySQL 测试全部通过且无跳过；Checkstyle、根目录构建及类型检查、变更脚本 ESLint、格式检查和两轮自审均完成。首次 macOS Bash 3 运行中有 22 项未改动的报告器用例失败，改用 Bash 5 后全部通过。后续注释清理还通过了全部 21 项报告守卫测试。`28bdcb7` 的 fast CI 在未改动的工作区恢复代码中因 H2 二进制与字符串参数类型不匹配而失败；单独运行该类的三项测试通过，因此 CI 失败仍未解释，也未归类为基础设施问题。重写后的 MySQL 任务被 fast 档跳过，合并前仍需完整档 CI 验证。

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — 本次修改 CI 和数据库验证，无 UI 变化。

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ 已测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ 未测试 |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64；Node 26.12.1；pnpm 11.24.0；Bash 5.3.20；JDK 21.0.8；Maven 3.9.14。选定 JDBC 测试使用独立临时原生 MySQL 8.4.11 实例，启用严格 SQL 模式、关闭二进制日志、设置 128 MiB 包限制，并在任务专属 Maven 仓库中重新安装匹配的 SDK。Linux CI 继续使用关闭 native AIO 的 MySQL 8.4.6；本地运行不构成该容器配置的验证。Java 准备、验证及清理共使用共享 600 秒预算中的 88.914 秒，临时数据库已停止并移除。

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff：完整 CI 不再发现 MariaDB 特有回归；未来若要重新承诺兼容，需单独验收。
- Not validated / out of scope：完整 Linux MySQL profile 以及 Hosted、故障恢复和 EventTransport 门控仍交由 CI 完成。生产 SQL 及方言处理不变。
- Breaking changes / migration notes：不修改 schema、catalog 迁移或连接准入；文档中的持续数据库支持目标收敛为 MySQL。

已同步的设计更新：[JDBC 范围英文版](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/53524a9b98ee9c7172bcbc655372a1986411b4c7/docs/design/managed-runtime-broker-jdbc.md) / [简体中文版](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/53524a9b98ee9c7172bcbc655372a1986411b4c7/docs/design/managed-runtime-broker-jdbc.zh-CN.md)，以及[锁和队列范围英文版](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/53524a9b98ee9c7172bcbc655372a1986411b4c7/docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.md) / [简体中文版](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/53524a9b98ee9c7172bcbc655372a1986411b4c7/docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.zh-CN.md)。另同步[verify 工具链英文版](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/53524a9b98ee9c7172bcbc655372a1986411b4c7/docs/design/verify-java-toolchain.md) / [简体中文版](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/53524a9b98ee9c7172bcbc655372a1986411b4c7/docs/design/verify-java-toolchain.zh-CN.md)，以及[集成优化英文版](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/53524a9b98ee9c7172bcbc655372a1986411b4c7/docs/design/2026-10-22-mysql-ci-optimization.md) / [简体中文版](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/53524a9b98ee9c7172bcbc655372a1986411b4c7/docs/design/2026-10-22-mysql-ci-optimization.zh-CN.md)。保留历史 MariaDB 测量记录。

## Linked Issues

N/A

</details>

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): materialize inert external workspaces
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an operator-only way to materialize an already registered external storage alias as a discoverable Workspace with an explicitly delegated owner. The operation creates only metadata and an idempotent receipt in one transaction. It does not allocate storage, start a worker, or enable Session execution.

An owner can discover the new Workspace, but its Session-creation and directory-selection capabilities remain unavailable. Replaying a completed request returns the original creation receipt without restoring revoked access, changing a renamed Workspace, or reactivating removed metadata.

## Why it's needed

#15512 needs a durable link between registered external storage and the Workspace a Session will eventually select. Registration alone creates storage records, not a Workspace or owner grant. This is a deliberately inert prerequisite: later execution admission, tools, recovery and exact-worker close must become usable together rather than allowing partially wired Sessions.

This increment is independent of #15654's provisioning prerequisite and does not copy its changes.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

On an isolated fresh catalog, register external storage using the loopback operator credential, then materialize its alias with an owner. Confirm the owner can discover it on the public and WebShell surfaces, an unrelated actor cannot, and neither Session creation nor directory selection is advertised. Requests without operator authorization must fail.

Replay the request and confirm its receipt is stable and rows are not duplicated. Change the owner or display name under the same key and confirm a conflict. Revoke access or rename/remove the Workspace, then replay: the original receipt returns, but current state must not be restored. Concurrent attempts must produce one Workspace, grant and completed receipt. A receipt-write failure must roll back the preceding Workspace and grant writes.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The baseline has external registration but no materialization operation. The candidate was exercised through actual Spring HTTP and an isolated MySQL 8.4 instance on the designated Linux development machine: registration/materialization/replay succeeded, owner-only discovery remained non-executable, and empty public/WebShell Session creation was rejected before execution state was created. Raw SQL readback found no Sessions, Turns or Runtime bindings.

Prompted creation in the live Harness-disabled configuration was rejected at the deployment availability gate; this is not claimed as live EXTERNAL-specific prompt admission proof. Separate focused service tests exercise the storage-kind gate with Harness availability supplied. No browser screenshot or running Hosted worker is claimed for this inert slice.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--- | :---: |
| macOS | ⚠️ source review only; no heavy runtime execution |
| Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| Linux | ✅ focused Java/MySQL and real HTTP validation on development host |

### Environment (optional)

Remote JDK 21.0.12.1, Maven 3.9.11, task-isolated dependency repository and MySQL 8.4.13 in a capped Podman container. Existing services and databases were preserved. The application ran from compiled production classes and cached dependencies, without test fixture classes.

Validation: 110 focused Java tests and both Checkstyle executions passed. The first nine-case MySQL run had eight passes and one test exception-wrapper mismatch; after a test-only correction, the affected rollback method passed on both H2 and MySQL. Original failed evidence is retained; these results are not presented as a second full nine-case run. The CLI inventory suite passed 204 tests after correcting its generated digest header; scoped formatting and the CLI dependency build/bundle passed. The full local review engine exited before model execution because its isolated operator-policy configuration could not be read; that gate is unverified. Independent source reviews found no remaining issue in this slice. This PR is **ready for review**; full CI and final acceptance remain pending.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the authenticated operator may delegate ownership to the specified actor. That field is a grant target, not proof of authenticated user identity or tenant membership. Existing loopback and bearer checks remain required; public authentication is unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: full external Hosted execution, real worker/tool effects, available-Harness prompted Session flow, drain/ACK safety, recovery, shell/capture and full CI. This PR does not complete #15512.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the new receipt namespace extends the shared V1 catalog CHECK under the repository's pre-release fresh-catalog policy. A source revert is not a guarantee that an old binary can open the changed database catalog. No V2 migration or schema-version bump is introduced.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-10-25-external-hosted-workspace.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-25-external-hosted-workspace.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Part of #15512. Related prerequisite: #15654. Neither this PR nor the provisioning prerequisite closes the full feature issue.

prs.title: feat(web-shell): browse managed auto-memory in /memory (listing, read, toggles)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The web-shell /memory panel gains a third tab, "Auto memory", that browses the managed auto-memory store: entries are listed grouped by scope (project scope under the workspace's managed memory root — `<memory-base>/projects/<workspace>/memory/`, or `<workspace>/.qwen/memory` with `QWEN_CODE_MEMORY_LOCAL=1` — and user scope under `<memory-base>/memories/`; the daemon reports the resolved directories in `projectDir`/`userDir`) with title, description, and size, and selecting an entry reads its content through the daemon with a 1 MiB read cap and an explicit truncation flag. The tab also exposes the managed settings `memory.enableManagedAutoMemory` and `memory.enableManagedAutoDream` as toggles (written to user scope), and on a local daemon advertising the `workspace_local_open` capability a per-scope "Open folder" button opens the scope's directory on the daemon host.

On the daemon side this adds `GET /workspace/auto-memory` and `GET /workspace/auto-memory/file?path=...` (the file route re-validates the requested path against the two managed roots server-side, symlink-canonicalized, before opening it; failures map to typed statuses: 400 outside/non-regular, 404 missing, 403 untrusted workspace), exposed over ACP as `_qwen/workspace/auto-memory` and `_qwen/workspace/auto-memory/file`. The SDK gains `DaemonClient.workspaceAutoMemory()`, `workspaceAutoMemoryFile(path)`, and `openAutoMemoryFolderLocally(scope)`; the web shell gains the `useDaemonAutoMemory` hook, the `AutoMemoryPanel` component, and the new tab in `MemoryMessage`. i18n adds the needed en/zh-CN strings and removes the now-unused "not available yet" placeholders.

## Why it's needed

Issue #13396: the web-shell /memory panel did not render managed auto-memory at all — the folder entry and the auto-memory/auto-dream toggles were dead ends labeled "not available from web-shell yet". Desktop and web-shell users have no TUI, so the memory panel is their only place to inspect what the agent has remembered or to switch memory capture on and off.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `pnpm install`, then start the development daemon and web shell (repo `dev` script) for a workspace that already has auto-memory entries, or create one under the project's managed memory directory (e.g. `<workspace>/.qwen/memory/` with `QWEN_CODE_MEMORY_LOCAL=1`).
2. Run `/memory` in the web shell — the panel now has three tabs: Project, User, and the new "Auto memory".
3. In the Auto memory tab: expect entries grouped under "Project memory" / "User memory" with per-scope file count and total size; click an entry to see its content; a file over 1 MiB shows the truncation notice instead of failing; the toggles reflect the effective settings and persist to user scope when flipped.
4. On a local daemon advertising `workspace_local_open`, an "Open folder" button appears per scope; on a remote daemon it is hidden.
5. Web-shell unit tests (from `packages/web-shell`): `npx vitest run --config vitest.config.ts client/components/messages/AutoMemoryPanel.test.tsx client/components/messages/MemoryMessage.test.tsx client/daemon/workspace/hooks/useDaemonAutoMemory.test.tsx` → 24/24 pass.
6. Daemon unit tests (from `packages/cli`): `npx vitest run src/serve/workspace-auto-memory.test.ts src/serve/routes/workspace-local-open.test.ts` → the new suites pin the read boundary (outside-root refusal, symlink escape, missing file, 1 MiB truncation, torn read, untrusted-workspace fail-closed, relative-path refusal) and the folder-open target (200 with scope, 404 missing dir, 400 non-directory).
7. `npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` and `prettier --experimental-cli --check` are clean for the touched packages in the same environment.

### Evidence (Before & After)

No live-session screenshots in this verification pass (unit/type/format checks ran in a one-off Docker container; interactive before/after screenshots can follow if maintainers want them). Before: the /memory panel had no auto-memory section at all — the "not available from web-shell yet" placeholder strings were the only trace. After: the Auto memory tab described above; behavior is covered by 45 unit tests — 24 web-shell (panel rendering, reads including truncation and 404, toggle persistence and error notices, folder-button gating, tab switching) and 21 daemon-side (path confinement, read contract, listing, HTTP status mapping, folder-open target, relative-path refusal).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment

One-off `node:22-bookworm` Docker container with a full pnpm workspace install (unit tests, `tsc --noEmit`, `prettier --check`). No live Desktop/daemon session was driven as part of this PR's verification.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the file-read route accepts an arbitrary `path` query, so it re-validates the resolved path against the two managed roots on the server (symlink-canonicalized) before opening it — outside-root and symlink-escape reads are refused (400), missing files 404, and anything outside a trusted workspace 403 (fail-closed). This boundary is now pinned by daemon unit tests. Content reads are capped at 1 MiB with a `truncated` flag rather than failing. The panel is read-only for entries (no write/delete UI), and the toggles only write user-scope settings.
- Not validated / out of scope: no interactive live-session run (macOS/Windows ⚠️); "Open folder" relies on the existing `workspace_local_open` daemon flow and is unit-tested with mocks only; no write/edit UI for auto-memory files. The read-contract helpers (BOM detection, no-follow open, torn-read refusal) are shared with, but separately implemented next to, the explicit memory route — extending the existing module instead was considered, but the two stores have different root semantics (workspace-qualified vs user-global), which the tests pin on both sides.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — additive routes, SDK methods, and i18n keys; the removed i18n keys had no remaining references in web-shell.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13396

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

Web Shell 的 /memory 面板新增第三个选项卡「Auto memory（自动记忆）」，用于浏览托管的 auto-memory 存储：条目按作用域分组列出（项目作用域位于该 workspace 的托管内存根目录——`<memory-base>/projects/<workspace>/memory/`，或在 `QWEN_CODE_MEMORY_LOCAL=1` 时为 `<workspace>/.qwen/memory`——用户作用域位于 `<memory-base>/memories/`；daemon 在 `projectDir`/`userDir` 中报告解析后的目录），显示标题、描述和大小；点击条目时通过 daemon 读取其内容，读取上限 1 MiB，超出时显式标记截断。该选项卡同时以开关形式暴露两个托管设置 `memory.enableManagedAutoMemory` 与 `memory.enableManagedAutoDream`（写入用户作用域）；在声明了 `workspace_local_open` 能力的本地 daemon 上，每个作用域还有一个「打开文件夹」按钮，用于在 daemon 所在主机上打开对应目录。

Daemon 侧新增了 `GET /workspace/auto-memory` 与 `GET /workspace/auto-memory/file?path=...`（文件路由在打开前会在服务端把请求路径做符号链接规范化后重新校验到两个托管根目录之内；失败映射为类型化状态：400 越界/非普通文件、404 不存在、403 未受信 workspace），并通过 ACP 以 `_qwen/workspace/auto-memory` 与 `_qwen/workspace/auto-memory/file` 暴露。SDK 新增 `DaemonClient.workspaceAutoMemory()`、`workspaceAutoMemoryFile(path)` 与 `openAutoMemoryFolderLocally(scope)`；Web Shell 新增 `useDaemonAutoMemory` hook、`AutoMemoryPanel` 组件以及 `MemoryMessage` 中的新选项卡。i18n 补齐了所需的 en/zh-CN 文案，并移除了不再使用的「尚不可用」占位键。

## 为什么需要

Issue #13396：Web Shell 的 /memory 面板此前完全不渲染托管 auto-memory——文件夹入口和 auto-memory/auto-dream 开关都是写着「web-shell 暂不可用」的死胡同。Desktop 与 Web Shell 用户没有 TUI，内存面板是他们查看代理记了什么、或开关记忆捕获的唯一入口。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

1. `pnpm install` 后，用仓库的 `dev` 脚本启动开发态 daemon 与 Web Shell，workspace 需已有 auto-memory 条目（或自行在项目托管内存目录下创建，例如 `QWEN_CODE_MEMORY_LOCAL=1` 时的 `<workspace>/.qwen/memory/`）。
2. 在 Web Shell 中运行 `/memory`——面板现在有三个选项卡：Project、User，以及新增的「Auto memory」。
3. 在 Auto memory 选项卡中：条目应分组显示在「Project memory」「User memory」之下，并显示每个作用域的文件数与总大小；点击条目可查看内容；超过 1 MiB 的文件显示截断提示而不是报错；开关反映当前生效的设置值，切换后持久化到用户作用域。
4. 在声明了 `workspace_local_open` 能力的本地 daemon 上，每个作用域出现「打开文件夹」按钮；远程 daemon 上隐藏。
5. Web Shell 单元测试（在 `packages/web-shell` 下运行）：`npx vitest run --config vitest.config.ts client/components/messages/AutoMemoryPanel.test.tsx client/components/messages/MemoryMessage.test.tsx client/daemon/workspace/hooks/useDaemonAutoMemory.test.tsx` → 24/24 通过。
6. Daemon 单元测试（在 `packages/cli` 下运行）：`npx vitest run src/serve/workspace-auto-memory.test.ts src/serve/routes/workspace-local-open.test.ts` → 新增用例钉住读取边界（越界拒绝、符号链接逃逸、文件缺失、1 MiB 截断、torn read、未受信 workspace fail-closed、相对路径拒绝）与打开文件夹目标（200 带 scope、404 目录缺失、400 非目录）。
7. 同一环境下 `npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` 与 `prettier --experimental-cli --check` 对所涉包均干净。

### 证据（前后对比）

本次验证不包含真实会话截图（单测/类型/格式检查在一次性 Docker 容器内完成；如维护者需要交互式前后截图，可后续补充）。之前：/memory 面板完全没有 auto-memory 部分——只有「web-shell 暂不可用」的占位文案。之后：即上文所述的 Auto memory 选项卡；行为由 45 个单元测试覆盖——24 个 Web Shell（面板渲染、含截断与 404 的读取、开关持久化与错误提示、打开文件夹的显隐、选项卡切换）+ 21 个 Daemon 侧（路径收敛、读取契约、列表、HTTP 状态映射、打开文件夹目标、相对路径拒绝）。

### 测试平台

|     操作系统     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境

一次性 `node:22-bookworm` Docker 容器，完整 pnpm workspace 安装（单元测试、`tsc --noEmit`、`prettier --check`）。本次 PR 验证未驱动真实的 Desktop/daemon 会话。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：文件读取路由接受任意 `path` 查询参数，因此在打开文件前会在服务端把解析后的路径（符号链接规范化）重新校验到两个托管根目录之内——越界与符号链接逃逸的读取一律拒绝（400），文件缺失 404，未受信 workspace 403（fail-closed）。该边界现由 daemon 单元测试钉住。内容读取以 1 MiB 为上限并以 `truncated` 标记截断，而不是直接失败。面板对条目只读（无写入/删除 UI），开关只写用户作用域设置。
- 未验证/范围之外：未做交互式真实会话验证（macOS/Windows ⚠️）；「打开文件夹」依赖既有的 `workspace_local_open` daemon 流程，仅用 mock 做了单元测试；不提供 auto-memory 文件的写入/编辑 UI。读取契约辅助函数（BOM 检测、no-follow 打开、torn read 拒绝）与显式 memory 路由共享同一契约但为独立实现——曾考虑扩展既有模块，但两个存储的根语义不同（workspace 限定 vs 用户全局），两侧均已有测试钉住。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无——路由、SDK 方法与 i18n 键均为新增；被移除的 i18n 键在 web-shell 中已无引用。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #13396

prs.title: feat(web-shell): present Generated UI cards as interactive views
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Web Shell presents built-in Generated UI cards as interactive views instead of exposing MCP plumbing. Other MCP Apps keep their existing presentation.

- **Card:** the built-in card drops the "MCP App · generated-ui" header and divider. When the host keeps a resettable activation, one quiet row carries **Reopen and reset** and, after a reopen, the short notice that goes with it. The App frame is titled "Interactive view".
- **Tool row:** reads **Interactive view** (交互视图) with the card title as its description, instead of `mcp__generated-ui__generated_ui_show`.
- **Sizing and loading:** the card may grow to 4000 px (generic Apps keep 960 px), so its content scrolls with the page instead of inside the transcript. Size reports from an App that briefly has no width are ignored, so the card no longer spikes thousands of pixels tall during a resize. The frame stays behind a loading line until the App initializes, so a sandbox origin that is not reachable yet (for example a port that is not forwarded over SSH) never shows a browser error page.
- **Sandbox page:** the daemon's MCP App sandbox proxy page (`packages/cli/src/serve/mcp-app-sandbox.ts`) no longer scrolls around the App frame. The inline frame's baseline gap made the page a few pixels taller than its frame, which showed light default scrollbars and a strip below every App.
- **Parameter review:** the review for a card's parameter message lists the parameters and values first, keeps the full message and routing details in a collapsed section, and sends with **Continue analysis**.
- **Fallback:** with the feature off, or when a retained card has been released and offers **Reopen interactive view**, the card shows the saved title and summary instead of the structured result JSON.

## Why it's needed

In the real Web Shell walkthrough, a Generated UI answer looked like protocol output: an "MCP App" header, a tool row named `mcp__generated-ui__generated_ui_show`, a parameter review that opened with protocol prose and a JSON snapshot, and history that showed structured JSON once the feature was off. Cards also showed nested scrolling, a light strip with scrollbars around the App, a browser error page while the sandbox port was unreachable, and a brief height spike while resizing. These are part of the UI/UX blockers for turning `experimental.generatedUi` on by default (#14019).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. With `experimental.generatedUi` on, ask Web Shell for an interactive calculator. The tool row reads "Interactive view <title>", the card has no MCP header, and there is no strip or scrollbar below the App.
2. Click **Continue analysis with current parameters**: the review lists parameters and values, with the full message under a collapsed section.

prs.title: feat(managed): Add bounded authority history queries
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Implements the complete PR5 slice: committed-prefix historical queries, bounded authority residency, streaming recovery, production consumer migration, and activation/inbox terminal-state convergence. Hosted and managed-local reuse MySQL/H2 through the Java service; standalone CLI sessions retain JSONL, resource files and the existing writer lease. Full canonical history remains available.

Historical facts retain versions, source locators and digests. SQL indexing advances only over a complete continuous prefix, while disposable file views are rebuilt from verified canonical input. Missing or damaged derived data can rebuild; unavailable or corrupt canonical history cannot become a negative lookup. A known committed append retains its original receipt after an index failure; uncertain append settlement remains governed by the original append protocol.

Authority retains at most 1,024 recent events and 8 MiB, with an owner-shared historical cache of at most 2,048 entries and 4 MiB. Old commands, first execution receipts, Hook uniqueness, child/team identities and cold Session epochs survive eviction. Active checkpoint state stays resident; archived tool/binding history uses a fixed asynchronous view. Selected model context remains distinct from complete terminal/domain history, and transcript, cancellation/Goal recovery, ACP/SSE and historical lists stream or page the appropriate channel.

Historical branch checkpoints accept an external owner as the chain boundary while still rejecting real cycles. First Legacy background notifications can proceed to strict persistence when no transcript exists; without a recorder they remain unaccepted. Missing Managed history, restore-proof errors and other I/O failures still reject. Session/history repositories explicitly retain their dedicated database and JSON dependencies when embedded beside an application's business beans. Hosted fixtures also explicitly select the existing schema-aware Managed JDBC template so durable identity assertions observe normalized identities.

Activation/inbox snapshot decoding uses pinned pure-JavaScript [@streamparser/json](https://github.com/juanjoDiaz/streamparser-json) 0.0.26 and releases consumed containers while preserving the semantic JSON checksum. This adds no native module or Node minimum increase.

## Why it's needed

Completed history previously accumulated in authority, scheduling state and recovery collections. PR5 moves cold facts to durable verified queries while preserving retry, conflict, fencing, ordering and original-result semantics. The target is memory proportional to active state, fixed caches and bounded I/O, with the costs of complete historical storage and cold scans retained explicitly.

## Reviewer Test Plan

Current source is `621a3dec4d17875878dc1d162e02a670b910d575` (tree`e09fbbd736ec1c45a9fb13619db9c85671ee60f9`), integrating main `591ebc57405f33cd26daf5dd6c36a890ebf17adf`. The initial commit`ae748919c7f79f32e7eff59696a6c6f8900337d1` integrated4afe and reconciled nine schema/surface conflicts; the later main branch-point change produced two additional replay conflicts. Both contracts now coexist with41canonical tables/42withFlyway/842columns/168routes. All Java/schema files remain byte-identical to the first integration. The second merge preserves130main-only and276PR-only blobs exactly, with five explicit emitter/test/bilingual-design exceptions.

Branch checkpoints remain attached only to a source record's last nonempty visible assistant chunk. Recent Managed restore pages carry a bounded certified map. Full restore uses weak metadata keyed by exact yielded records, resolves through the iterator's existing fixed-prefix query and closes it normally or on refusal. Replay buffers only one checkpointed record's emissions, preserves emission ownership/timestamps and rewriting, and stamps before byte/update accounting and delivery. No full-history strong map, per-assistant catalog reopening, larger cap, canonical mutation or inherited cold-nonbulk feature expansion is added.

The final candidate passed build148.488s,typecheck57.554s,build-then-bundle2.836s and scoped formatting/lint. Independent affected verification passed128/128:103 in two CLI replay files,10 Managed transcript cases,5 physical transcript cases and10 ACP caller/bulk/error cases;zero missing targets or target skips. Three exact pre-fix RED cases turned GREEN;the byte-budget case and two caller-forwarding cases are post-fix-only. Root and independent audits each have two clean incremental passes. Source,dist,dependencies,toolchain,generated git-commit input and staged manifest remained stable;the committed tree matches that tested candidate. This is TypeScript/static evidence,not Java or full-process acceptance.

The first integration's treeb8f2 had separately passed build144.664s/types53.173s/bundle2.509s andCLI252. Its original three-file metadata run completed554pass/1timeout/10skip in917.651s. Exactly10 GNU-realpath targets then passed with177 non-targets filtered,yielding564 distinct metadata passes and one unresolved120s octopus fixture timeout(reported135.065s). The exact test,actual helpers and parser match main4afe where traced,but no main baseline A/B establishes pre-existing,infra or flake attribution. No timeout extension or blind replay occurred;the later replay merge leaves those meta inputs unchanged and does not clear the failure.

[Final-head full SDK Java40814197681](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40814197681) was dispatched exactly once;initial readbackqueued/0jobs,actual checkout and full acceptance remain unverified. The [intermediate AE full40809955427](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40809955427) was also dispatched once:queued15jobs(6success/3failure/4running/2queued). Broker123248986933/multi-node123248986941 timed out RocketMQ startup at10min,gates unrun,cause unproved. MariaDB123248986802 passed5958unit/H2(19skip),1234real-profile and3SurefirePackaging tests,zero failure/error;Checkstyle/SpotBugs0,MavenSUCCESS,but jobFAIL at the existing Failsafe-only report guard. Actual checkoutAE is proven;this is not final621 acceptance. No rerun/cancel. Profiles,real databases/HTTP,native10k/100k,checkpoint/context,HostedCSI/AutomationMonitor and platform gates must be accepted on the final source. Earlier empty-context scale does not establish total RSS or all-network-buffer qualification. PR remains Ready/CHANGES_REQUESTED with0human approvals and0unresolved review threads.

At preceding exact6db,MySQL123196931979/MariaDB123196932088 each passed5883unit/H2(19skip),1218real-profile(no skip) and3SurefirePackaging tests with0failure/error;both jobs failed the existing Failsafe-only report guard. Multi-node123196932054 timed out RocketMQ startup before gate execution,cause unproved. Previous f418full40768219375 ended12success3failure;Hosted123143870911 recorded165tests/1failure/4errors/4skips:four Workflow mirrors pending150s andFG9f stopping→ended. These do not prove canonical consumption loss,a unique PR5 cause or all older fixture failures fixed. No guard,ledger,assertion or timeout was weakened,and no older manually cancelled or mixed-failure workflow restarted. The [original bilingual report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15696#issuecomment-6433993522) retains all a2f2/c65/2fda/934/0c/3c92 source boundaries,failures,skips,unrun gates and prior focused successes. Historical R25 root18/independent78/final-main13/meta677pass15skip andR31 merge-tree fast evidence remain scoped to their own inputs.

### How to verify

1. Read old commands, original receipts and event identities outside the resident window and after restart. Expect the original result, no repeated producer or side effect, and rejection of conflicting identity reuse or stale fences.
2. Hold one query prefix while a newer commit arrives. Confirm continuous row/byte-limited pages, honest unavailable coverage, derived-index rebuild, and refusal of missing/corrupt canonical transactions or resources.
3. Restore a historical branch whose first parent belongs to an external owner, then an actual cyclic chain. Expect live/cold model and context recovery only for the valid chain. Check notification admission with no Legacy transcript, no recorder, a missing Managed log and I/O/restore-proof failures.
4. In an embedding host with its own JDBC/JSON beans, confirm Session and historical queries use the dedicated Managed collaborators. Exercise approvals, tool results, cancellation, cleanup, Child/Hook and SSE across the window on the final Core→Java→database path. Complete checkpoint/context scale and Hosted/CSI fault profiles before declaring eviction qualified.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for visual/TUI evidence. Before, the accepted historical external-parent branch failed model/context restoration, and a recorder-less Legacy notification rejected with ENOENT. The same probes now recover the valid branch and return the original unaccepted outcome without a recorder, while real cycles, Managed source loss and other read failures still reject. These are source-backed and in-process contract results; CLI attempts that could not reach the fixture session are not E2E passes. The new merge probes first lacked streamed/recent/all branch metadata; the same three probes now pass, preserving the last-visible-chunk and original byte budgets. No Java or rendered UI result is inferred.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--- | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ Tested locally: final replay128/build/types/bundle passed; metadata timeout retained |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally; prior2fda Java CI succeeded, current head pending |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally; prior2fda CI subsets succeeded, current head/full qualification pending |

### Environment (optional)

macOS ARM64, Node26.12.1, Bash5.3.20 and installed GNU realpath for the ten targeted metadata replays; local bundle0.26.3. Prior Node22.22.3 compatibility and Java/MySQL evidence retain their recorded source boundaries. No new Java preparation, compilation, test, Checkstyle or SpotBugs command ran: the shared local budget remains CLOSED564.787/600 seconds, with35.213 unused seconds forbidden. Disposable test/runtime resources were task-owned and cleaned.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: this is a coordinated asynchronous Core/CLI/service migration. Verified file generations and request-private CSI scratch add disk I/O, write amplification, SQL round trips and cold recovery/close time. Bounded residency does not imply bounded historical disk size or constant recovery time.
- Not validated / out of scope: current-head full Java profiles, actual database/HTTP restoration, checkpoint/context scale, native scale and complete Hosted/CSI/Automation/Monitor fault acceptance remain pending. Previous empty-context scale does not cap total process RSS or all network buffers. Existing Hosted, multi-node and darwin-x64 failures are retained without blind retries or assertion/timeout weakening. No deployment or publication acceptance is claimed.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: cold Managed Core queries become asynchronous with workspace consumers migrated together. The shared prerelease V1 baseline and validation add derived history tables; no V2 migration or automatic catalog/history deletion. Older servers without native history-query support use the existing protocol to build a verified file view. No journal deletion, replay-floor advance, automatic snapshot publication or local writer-ownership replacement.

Complete synchronized [English design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/621a3dec4d17875878dc1d162e02a670b910d575/docs/design/2026-10-27-managed-session-authority-window.md) and [Chinese design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/621a3dec4d17875878dc1d162e02a670b910d575/docs/design/2026-10-27-managed-session-authority-window.zh-CN.md) describe ownership, recovery and qualification boundaries.

## Linked Issues

Related to #13184 and #12380. This PR does not close the complete historical-retention tracker.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

实现完整 PR5 切片：固定提交前缀的历史查询、有界 authority 驻留、流式恢复、生产消费者迁移，以及 activation/inbox 终态收敛。Hosted 与 managed-local 通过 Java 服务复用 MySQL/H2；纯文件 CLI 保留 JSONL、资源文件及原 writer lease。完整 canonical 历史继续保留。

历史事实保存版本、来源定位与 digest。SQL 索引仅跨完整连续前缀推进，可丢弃文件视图从已验证 canonical 输入重建。派生数据缺失或损坏可以重建；canonical 历史不可用或损坏不能变成负查询。已确定提交的追加在索引失败后仍保留原回执；未知追加结果仍由原追加协议结算。

authority 最多保留最近 1,024 个事件且不超过 8 MiB，owner 共享历史缓存最多 2,048 项且不超过 4 MiB。旧命令、首次 execution receipt、Hook 唯一性、child/team 身份与冷 Session epoch 在淘汰后仍有效。活跃 checkpoint 状态驻留，归档 tool/binding 历史使用固定异步视图。选定模型上下文与完整终态/domain 历史保持区别，transcript、取消/Goal 恢复、ACP/SSE 与历史列表按相应通道流式或分页读取。

历史分支 checkpoint 将外部 owner 视为链边界，同时继续拒绝真实循环。首条 Legacy 后台通知在 transcript 尚不存在时可进入严格持久化路径；没有 recorder 时仍不接受。Managed 历史缺失、恢复 proof 错误及其他 I/O 失败仍拒绝。嵌入宿主同时提供业务 bean 时，Session/历史仓库仍显式使用专用数据库与 JSON 依赖。 Hosted 夹具亦显式选择现有 schema-aware Managed JDBC 模板，使持久身份断言读取正确归一后的标识。

activation/inbox 快照解码使用固定纯 JavaScript 库 [@streamparser/json](https://github.com/juanjoDiaz/streamparser-json) 0.0.26，释放已消费容器，保留语义 JSON checksum。不新增 native module，不提高 Node 下限。

## Why it's needed

此前已完成历史持续堆积于 authority、调度状态和恢复集合。PR5 将冷事实移至持久、经过验证的查询，同时保留重试、冲突、fencing、顺序及原结果语义。目标是内存随活跃状态、固定缓存与有界 I/O 增长，完整历史存储和冷扫描的成本则明确保留。

## Reviewer Test Plan

当前源码为 `621a3dec4d17875878dc1d162e02a670b910d575`（tree`e09fbbd736ec1c45a9fb13619db9c85671ee60f9`），集成main `591ebc57405f33cd26daf5dd6c36a890ebf17adf`。首次提交`ae748919c7f79f32e7eff59696a6c6f8900337d1`集成4afe并整合九处schema/路由冲突；后续main分支点改动又引入两处回放冲突。双方契约现共同保留41canonical表/含Flyway42表/842列/168路由。全部Java/schema文件与首次集成逐字相同。第二次合并的130main独有及276PR独有blob精确等父，只有五处emitter/测试/双语设计显式例外。

分支checkpoint只标注在源记录最后一个非空、可见assistant chunk。近期Managed恢复页携带有界认证map；全量恢复以精确产出record为弱键保存元数据，复用迭代器既有固定前缀查询，并在正常完成或拒绝时关闭。回放仅暂存一个checkpoint记录的emissions，保留来源身份/时间戳及rewriter，在字节/更新数核算和发送前标注。不新增完整历史强map、逐assistant重开目录、更大cap、canonical修改或继承的冷nonbulk功能扩展。

prs.title: fix(cli): abort headless runs on SIGHUP so in-flight shell tools are stopped
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Registers the existing headless `shutdownHandler` for `SIGHUP` as well as `SIGINT` and `SIGTERM`, and removes it in the same cleanup block. A hangup now aborts the run the same way Ctrl+C or SIGTERM does, so running shell tools are stopped through the normal cancellation path.

## Why it's needed

In headless mode a `SIGHUP` (ssh/session teardown, terminal multiplexers, `kill -HUP`) currently ends the process by default action. The abort never reaches running shell tools. Those run in their own process group, so they keep running and finish unobserved. On `--continue` their calls then have no recorded result, and resume answers them with "Treat as failure and retry if needed." The model is told to retry actions that have already taken effect (#15799). Background shells are left with a status file stuck at `running` (#15800).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Unit test: `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/nonInteractiveCli.test.ts -t "routes SIGHUP"` asserts that SIGHUP is routed to the same handler as SIGTERM and removed on exit.

Manual (headless, Linux): create `work.sh` containing `sleep 3` and `echo paid >> ledger.txt`. Run `qwen "Run exactly this shell command and nothing else: bash work.sh" --yolo </dev/null &` with job control on (`set -m`). About 1 s after `sleep 3` starts, send `kill -HUP -- -<pgid of qwen>`. Then run `qwen "continue where you left off" --continue --yolo`.

- Before: `ledger.txt` gets `paid` after qwen exited, and the resumed request contains the "Treat as failure and retry" placeholder for the call.
- After: the command is stopped, qwen exits 130, and the call carries the regular cancellation result.

### Evidence (Before & After)

We used a deterministic harness: a stub model issues a fixed tool call, and the signal is sent at command start or mid-way. Scenarios were single, parallel, and background-shell calls, 3 runs per cell, 54 runs per build. We compared released 0.26.2 with this branch built from source, both on Node.js 22.23.

| | command after SIGHUP | resumed record of the call | background status file |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.26.2 (20 of 54 cells affected, 3/3 each) | keeps running, completes | "Tool execution result was not recorded … Treat as failure and retry if needed." | stays `running` |
| this branch (0 of 54) | stopped, exit 130 | regular cancellation result | `cancelled` |

SIGINT and SIGTERM cells are unchanged before and after.

On CI, `Test (ubuntu-latest, Node 22.x)`, `Lint & Static` and the integration tests pass. Locally, `npm run preflight` (Node.js 22.23) passes clean, install, format, lint, build and typecheck, and `src/nonInteractiveCli.test.ts` passes (248 tests including the new one). The local test step also fails some suites: most need a newer git than the test machine's 2.25, which rejects `git init -b`. The rest fail the same way on the base commit without this patch. None of them involve `nonInteractiveCli`.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: on a hangup the headless process now exits through the abort path with code 130, the same as SIGINT/SIGTERM in headless mode, instead of 129 from the default signal action. A wrapper that checks for 129 specifically would see a different code.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS and Windows were not tested locally. Per-call persistence and the placeholder wording from #15799 are larger changes and are not part of this PR. Interactive mode is not changed.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none beyond the exit code above.

## Linked Issues

Related to #15799 (fix direction item 3) and #15800 (write-side half: the background status file now ends as `cancelled`). This PR covers only part of each, so neither should be closed by it.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

**这个 PR 做了什么**

让无头模式已有的 `shutdownHandler` 除了 `SIGINT` 和 `SIGTERM` 之外，也处理 `SIGHUP`，并在同一个清理块里把它移除。挂断信号现在和 Ctrl+C、SIGTERM 一样中止运行，正在执行的 shell 工具会走正常的取消路径被停下。

**为什么需要**

目前在无头模式下，`SIGHUP`（ssh 或会话断开、终端复用器、`kill -HUP`）会按默认动作直接结束进程，中止信号传不到正在运行的 shell 工具。这些工具在自己的进程组里，所以会继续运行，在无人看管的情况下跑完。之后 `--continue` 时，这些调用没有记录结果，恢复时会给它们填上 "Treat as failure and retry if needed."。模型因此被要求重试已经生效的操作（#15799）。后台 shell 的状态文件会一直停在 `running`（#15800）。

**审阅者测试计划**

如何验证：

单元测试：`npx vitest run packages/cli/src/nonInteractiveCli.test.ts -t "routes SIGHUP"`，断言 SIGHUP 被路由到与 SIGTERM 相同的处理函数，并在退出时移除。

手动验证（无头模式，Linux）：新建 `work.sh`，内容为 `sleep 3` 和 `echo paid >> ledger.txt`。打开作业控制（`set -m`），运行 `qwen "Run exactly this shell command and nothing else: bash work.sh" --yolo </dev/null &`。在 `sleep 3` 开始约 1 秒后，发送 `kill -HUP -- -<qwen 的进程组号>`。然后运行 `qwen "continue where you left off" --continue --yolo`。

- 修改前：qwen 退出后 `ledger.txt` 仍被写入 `paid`，恢复时的请求里，这次调用带着 "Treat as failure and retry" 占位文本。
- 修改后：命令被停止，qwen 以 130 退出，这次调用带的是正常的取消结果。

前后对照证据：

我们用了一个确定性的测试工具：桩模型发出固定的工具调用，在命令开始时或执行到一半时发送信号。场景包括单个、并行和后台 shell 调用，每格 3 次，每个构建 54 次。对比的是已发布的 0.26.2 和从源码构建的本分支，两者都用 Node.js 22.23。

| | SIGHUP 之后的命令 | 恢复时这次调用的记录 | 后台状态文件 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.26.2（54 格中 20 格受影响，每格 3/3） | 继续运行并完成 | "Tool execution result was not recorded … Treat as failure and retry if needed." | 停在 `running` |
| 本分支（54 格中 0 格） | 被停止，退出码 130 | 正常的取消结果 | `cancelled` |

SIGINT 和 SIGTERM 的各格在修改前后没有变化。

CI 上 `Test (ubuntu-latest, Node 22.x)`、`Lint & Static` 和集成测试都已通过。本地 `npm run preflight`（Node.js 22.23）的 clean、install、format、lint、build 和 typecheck 全部通过，`src/nonInteractiveCli.test.ts` 也通过（248 个测试，含新增的一个）。本地测试步骤里有部分测试套件失败：大多数需要比测试机的 git 2.25 更新的版本，因为 2.25 不支持 `git init -b`；其余的在不带本补丁的基线提交上同样失败。它们都不涉及 `nonInteractiveCli`。

测试平台：macOS ⚠️ 未测；Windows ⚠️ 未测；Linux ✅ 已测。

**风险与范围**

- 主要风险或取舍：挂断时，无头进程现在走中止路径以 130 退出，和无头模式下的 SIGINT、SIGTERM 一致，不再是默认信号动作给出的 129。专门检查 129 的外层脚本会看到不同的退出码。
- 未验证或不在范围内：本地没有在 macOS 和 Windows 上测试。#15799 里提到的按调用落盘和占位文案修改是更大的改动，不在本 PR 内。交互模式没有改动。
- 破坏性变更与迁移说明：除上面的退出码外，没有。

**关联 issue**

与 #15799（修复方向第 3 项）和 #15800（写入侧的一半：后台状态文件现在会以 `cancelled` 结束）相关。本 PR 只覆盖了它们各自的一部分，因此不应由本 PR 关闭。

</details>

prs.title: feat: add hybrid code mode
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a Codex-aligned `tools.mode` enum with `direct`, `code_mode`, and `code_mode_only`. `code_mode` keeps ordinary tools directly callable while also exposing the isolated `exec` JavaScript tool; each visible ordinary tool carries its nested JavaScript declaration, while `exec` retains compact `ALL_TOOLS` metadata. `code_mode_only` preserves the strict exec-only ordinary-tool surface, and `direct` remains the default.

Updates filtered subagent tool surfaces so direct declarations and nested exec bindings honor the same allowlists, exposes the enum in Settings as Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only, regenerates the settings JSON schema, and removes the former `tools.codeModeOnly` boolean setting entirely.

Adds synchronized [English](docs/design/code-mode.md) and [Chinese](docs/design/code-mode.zh-CN.md) design documents, and brings the existing CodeModeOnly design up to the repository's bilingual documentation standard ([English](docs/design/code-mode-only.md), [Chinese](docs/design/code-mode-only.zh-CN.md)).

## Why it's needed

Qwen Code previously offered only the default direct tool surface or the strict CodeModeOnly surface. Models could not combine direct calls for simple operations with `exec` orchestration for multi-tool workflows. A three-value enum matches Codex's `ToolMode` naming and gives users one explicit setting for all supported exposure modes.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Leave `tools.mode` unset or set it to `direct`, restart Qwen Code, and confirm ordinary tools remain available while `exec` is absent.
2. Set `tools.mode` to `code_mode`, restart, and confirm both ordinary tools and `exec` are available. Confirm ordinary tool descriptions include their `tools.<name>(args)` declaration and deferred tools remain discoverable through `tool_search`.
3. Set `tools.mode` to `code_mode_only`, restart, and confirm ordinary tools are available through `exec` rather than as top-level calls, while direct control tools remain available.
4. Open Settings and confirm Tool Mode cycles among Default, Code Mode, and Code Mode Only. Confirm `tools.codeModeOnly` is no longer present in the settings schema.
5. Start with `--safe-mode` or `--bare` while either code mode is configured and confirm the effective mode is `direct`.

Automated verification completed: focused Core tests (121 tests), focused CLI tests (585 tests), a repeated settings-schema regression run (60 tests), full build, full typecheck, full lint, and both installed and branch-built CLI version smoke checks.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: Settings exposed `Code Mode Only (Experimental)` as a boolean with `false` / `true`.

After: Settings exposes `Tool Mode (Experimental)` as an enum displaying Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only. Updated TUI snapshots cover the default display.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Node.js v24.18.0; local source build and package-level Vitest suites.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Hybrid mode adds a short nested-call declaration to each ordinary tool description, increasing prompt size slightly; complete schemas are not duplicated in the `exec` description.
- Not validated / out of scope: Live-provider interactive runs and Windows/Linux local execution were not tested; CI covers supported platforms.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: `tools.codeModeOnly` is removed. Replace `{ "tools": { "codeModeOnly": true } }` with `{ "tools": { "mode": "code_mode_only" } }`.

## Linked Issues

Related to #10377.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

新增与 Codex 对齐的 `tools.mode` 枚举，支持 `direct`、`code_mode` 和 `code_mode_only`。`code_mode` 在保留普通工具直接调用能力的同时提供隔离的 `exec` JavaScript 工具；每个可见普通工具会携带自己的嵌套 JavaScript 声明，而 `exec` 保留精简的 `ALL_TOOLS` 元数据。`code_mode_only` 保持严格的普通工具仅经 `exec` 调用模式，`direct` 仍为默认值。

更新经过过滤的子智能体工具面，使直接声明和 `exec` 嵌套 binding 遵守同一组 allowlist；在设置界面中将该枚举显示为 Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only；重新生成 settings JSON schema；并彻底移除原来的 `tools.codeModeOnly` 布尔设置。

新增同步的[英文](docs/design/code-mode.md)和[中文](docs/design/code-mode.zh-CN.md)设计文档，并将现有 CodeModeOnly 设计补齐为仓库要求的双语文档（[英文](docs/design/code-mode-only.md)、[中文](docs/design/code-mode-only.zh-CN.md)）。

## 为什么需要

Qwen Code 此前只提供默认的直接工具面或严格的 CodeModeOnly 工具面。模型无法在简单操作中使用直接调用，同时在多工具工作流中使用 `exec` 编排。三值枚举与 Codex 的 `ToolMode` 命名一致，并为所有支持的暴露模式提供一个明确的统一设置项。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 不设置 `tools.mode` 或将其设为 `direct`，重启 Qwen Code，确认普通工具仍可用且不存在 `exec`。
2. 将 `tools.mode` 设为 `code_mode` 并重启，确认普通工具和 `exec` 同时可用；确认普通工具描述包含各自的 `tools.<name>(args)` 声明，延迟工具仍可通过 `tool_search` 发现。
3. 将 `tools.mode` 设为 `code_mode_only` 并重启，确认普通工具通过 `exec` 而不是顶层调用使用，同时直接控制工具仍然可用。
4. 打开设置界面，确认 Tool Mode 可在 Default、Code Mode 和 Code Mode Only 之间切换，并确认 settings schema 中不再存在 `tools.codeModeOnly`。
5. 配置任一 code mode 后用 `--safe-mode` 或 `--bare` 启动，确认有效模式为 `direct`。

已完成自动化验证：Core 相关测试（121 个）、CLI 相关测试（585 个）、再次运行的 settings schema 回归测试（60 个）、完整 build、完整 typecheck、完整 lint，以及已安装版本和分支构建版本的 CLI 版本 smoke 检查。

### 前后对比证据

之前：设置界面以 `false` / `true` 布尔值展示 `Code Mode Only (Experimental)`。

之后：设置界面以枚举展示 `Tool Mode (Experimental)`，可选 Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only。更新后的 TUI snapshot 覆盖默认显示。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

macOS、Node.js v24.18.0；本地源码构建和 package 级 Vitest 测试套件。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：混合模式会在每个普通工具描述中增加一段简短的嵌套调用声明，使 prompt 略微增大；完整 schema 不会在 `exec` 描述中重复。
- 未验证 / 范围外：未进行真实 provider 的交互式运行，也未在 Windows/Linux 本地执行；支持平台由 CI 覆盖。

prs.title: fix(core): infer DeepSeek Flash effort on Alibaba proxies
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Recognizes DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and its 1017 snapshot on the Alibaba proxy domain families that the client already treats as DashScope-compatible. With no explicit capability declaration, reasoning controls select High by default and offer Low, High, and Max. Requests use the same native defaults and mappings, and turning thinking off sends the existing DashScope switch.

## Why it's needed

Public DeepSeek and MaaS endpoints already expose the correct reasoning defaults. The equivalent model on an existing Alibaba proxy route misses that capability lookup, falls back to the generic five-tier list, and has no known default selection. This change closes that route-recognition gap. The [Alibaba Cloud API reference](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/qwen-api-via-openai-chat-completions) documents High as the default and Low/High/Max as the native tiers for this model.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Configure DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on a DashScope-compatible host under `alibaba-inc.com`, `aliyun-inc.com`, or `alicloudapi.com`, without an explicit reasoning capability declaration. Check that the model controls select High and offer only Low, High, and Max, including when the selected model uses an opaque route ID.
2. Select each supported tier and inspect the next request. The top-level reasoning effort should match the selection; an unset preference uses High, and legacy Medium/Extra High preferences map to High. Turning thinking off must disable it without a competing effort field.
3. Confirm explicit capability declarations and static request overrides still take precedence. Other model IDs and arbitrary or lookalike gateway domains must retain their previous behavior.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: current-main regression checks fail for all three proxy families because the reasoning preview is absent; the effort list falls back to five tiers. A separate global CLI baseline (0.22.0) also shows five tiers without a configured effort, but it is older than main and is not evidence of a current public-endpoint regression.

After: all 689 focused tests pass (471 core and 218 CLI), including ACP default/option metadata, request serialization, explicit overrides, and hostname/model negative controls. Full build, typecheck, bundle, and changed-file lint/format checks pass. Independent code review found no actionable defects. The compiled core → compiled ACP preview → production Web Shell mapper path confirms High and Low/High/Max on all three proxy families; the built interactive footer displays High.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ build, typecheck, bundle, 689 focused tests, lint/format |
| 🪟 Windows | Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Isolated worktree based on main, repository-pinned pnpm dependencies, and synthetic configuration. Request-pipeline checks stub network delivery; no production model requests or settings changes are involved.

## Risk & Scope

- Inference is limited to the exact V4.1 Flash and 1017 model IDs on the three existing proxy domain families. It reuses the established capability, selection, and request handling.
- Explicit declarations remain authoritative. No settings migration or new configuration option is introduced.
- The screenshot's deployed version and endpoint have not been identified. This PR fixes the reproduced current-main proxy gap; it does not claim real-instance acceptance or live proxy inference validation.

## Linked Issues

None.

- 自动识别仅限上述三个现有代理域名族上的 V4.1 Flash 与 1017 精确模型 ID，复用已有能力、选档与请求处理。

prs.title: fix(core): keep Write deny rules when quoting hides the async operator
prs.body:
## Linked Issues

Fixes #12246.

## What

`cd .qwen ; cd 'x\'';echo ' & echo {} > settings.json` with `deny: ["Write(.qwen/settings.json)"]` evaluated to `allow` and overwrote the protected file with no prompt. The second `cd` is backgrounded by the real ` & ` (bash reads `'x\''` + `';echo '` as one concatenated argument), but the permission splitter read a `;` between the two quote fragments, treated the `cd` as foreground, moved the effective cwd, and the write resolved to the wrong path — so the deny rule never saw it.

Verified live against bash: the payload above really does write `.qwen/settings.json`.

## Root cause

The two backslash readings disagree on where the operators are: the escape-everywhere reading sees a `;` inside what bash treats as one quoted word. A boundary only one reading sees cannot be allowed to decide a `cd`'s foreground/background effect on its own, and mixing both readings' boundaries into one split invents phantom `cd` targets no shell produces.

## Fix

Built on top of #11765's dual-reading splitter:

- `splitCompoundCommandSegmentsForReading(command, reading)` exposes one reading's split next to the union default (rule-parser). The union split stays the default for boundary discovery.
- `extractShellOperationsAcrossCommand` walks each self-consistent reading separately when a backslash is present and merges the operation sets (deduped); for cwd attribution the walker needs each reading's own split, since the union's mixed boundaries would attribute writes to phantom cwds. The permission layer aggregates to the most restrictive verdict, so a boundary only one reading sees can no longer move a write away from the protected path.
- `isDynamicShellPath` also escalates `cd` targets carrying shell metacharacters (`;|&><`), which can only be quoting artifacts of a split.

## Reviewer Test Plan

```bash
cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/permissions/ --reporter=dot
```

New pins:

- `shell-semantics.test.ts`: the exploit shape attributes the write to `/repo/.qwen/settings.json` (the bash-correct path); a quoting-artifact `cd` target escalates to `cwdUnknown` instead of becoming a phantom cwd.
- `permission-manager.test.ts`: the issue's exact rule config returns `deny` for the exploit and both controls keep `deny`; the single-reading split is pinned directly for both the plain-quote and ANSI-C cases.

## Tested

| OS | Result |
| --- | --- |
| macOS arm64 | permissions suite 1077/1077 pass (includes upstream's #11765 rows); full core suite 29625 pass, 2 failures reproduce identically on a clean checkout (environment-git tests #12514 / gitPull wedged-index, unrelated to this diff); `tsc --noEmit` clean; eslint clean on touched files |

## Risk & Scope

Core permission path, small scope. The dual-reading evaluation only engages when the command contains a backslash; other commands take the identical path as before. The three `echo 'a\' # ...` comment rows settle at `ask` (fail-closed), matching upstream's existing expectation for the ambiguous shape.

## Out of scope

- Converging the two segmentations themselves (#11882 umbrella).
- No changes to the `Write` rule matcher or deny syntax.

## Affiliation

Individual contributor (not affiliated with Moonshot AI).

prs.title: fix(permissions): surface malformed rules to operators
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Malformed permission rules now produce an operator-visible warning on every ingestion path. Configured invalid rules also remain visible in both `/permissions` interfaces with an explicit `invalid: not applied` label. Their matching behavior is unchanged: malformed rules still never match.

## Why it's needed

A typo in a deny or ask rule currently removes the intended restriction without any default-visible diagnostic. The operator can believe a command is blocked or requires confirmation while the rule has actually been discarded. This change exposes that configuration failure without introducing a new fail-closed matching policy.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Use a settings file containing `permissions.deny: ["Bash(docker *"]`, start the CLI, and open the Deny tab in `/permissions`. Startup should name the malformed rule and the unbalanced parentheses. The deny list should retain the raw rule and mark it as not applied. The same malformed input should remain non-matching.

I verified this through the built CLI in a real pseudo-terminal with an isolated HOME and a synthetic loopback provider configuration. The baseline emitted no warning and its Deny tab contained only the add-rule row. With this change, startup emitted `Ignoring malformed rule (unbalanced parentheses): Bash(docker *` and the Deny tab displayed `Bash(docker * (invalid: not applied)`. The session made zero model API calls and zero tool calls.

Local validation on the final sources:

- Permission core tests: 570 passed.
- Ink and OpenTUI dialog tests: 74 passed.
- Baseline mutation control: 2 new core assertions and 2 new UI assertions failed as expected.
- `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm run lint`: passed.
- Restored-source build after the baseline TUI comparison: passed.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: no startup warning; the malformed deny rule was absent from the Deny tab.

After:

```text
Ignoring malformed rule (unbalanced parentheses): Bash(docker *

› 1. 添加新规则…
  2. Bash(docker * (invalid: not applied)
```

The complete before/after pseudo-terminal captures were retained locally with the test logs.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Darwin 27.0.0; Node.js v26.5.0; built CLI in a pseudo-terminal. HOME and settings were isolated for the test. The provider used a synthetic API key and an unused loopback endpoint; no model request was made.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Invalid configured rules now occupy a row in the permission list. This is intentional and the row explicitly says that the rule is not applied.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows and Linux interactive rendering were not run locally. The separate `tools.disabled` typo-detection issue and any fail-closed matching redesign are out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. Invalid rules continue to be ignored for matching.

## Linked Issues

Refs #15752

prs.title: fix(cli): gate project hooks behind an approval dialog
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Hooks declared in a workspace's `.qwen/settings.json` now need the user's approval before they load, the same way project MCP servers do (#4615). The first interactive start in a workspace that declares hooks shows a dialog listing every hook (event, matcher and command) with Approve / Reject (Esc postpones to the next start or `/hooks` and notes in the transcript that the hooks were not loaded). Every repo-supplied string in the dialog is sanitized to one row, the list shows each hook's env, header names, allowed env vars and prompt text, and it is capped to the terminal height so the options stay visible. The decision is saved per project (keyed by the folder holding the `.qwen/settings.json`, so `/cd` and `--worktree` don't move it) in `~/.qwen/hookApprovals.json`, bound to a hash of the exact hooks configuration, so any later edit asks again while a settled rejection is not re-asked. Approving mid-session un-gates the hooks on the running config and reloads the hook registry; `/hooks` (which re-reads settings) recomputes the gate so an edited block stays unloaded and the dialog pops again. Both the ink and OpenTUI renderers get the dialog, and both `/hooks` browsers (plus the ACP hooks status) list withheld project hooks as awaiting approval. Headless runs cannot prompt, so unapproved project hooks stay unloaded and `qwen -p` prints one stderr line saying how to approve them. Only a YOLO asked for on the command line (`--yolo`, `--approval-mode yolo`) skips the gate, since a repository's own settings can set `tools.approvalMode`; `--bare`, `--safe-mode` and `disableAllHooks` load no hooks and ask nothing. A project `.env` cannot relocate the approvals file. User, system and extension hooks are untouched. Docs for hooks and trusted folders describe the new step, and a design doc (EN + zh-CN) records the decisions.

## Why it's needed

`security.folderTrust.enabled` defaults to `false`, and a disabled feature treats every folder as trusted, so a cloned repository's `.qwen/settings.json` is merged in full and its `SessionStart` (or any other) command hooks run the moment `qwen` starts there, with no prompt. "Clone a repo, open an AI coding tool in it" is a routine action, which makes this remote code execution for anyone who can get a user to clone a repository. Project MCP servers from the same file already have a hash-bound approval gate; project hooks had none. Gating hooks the same way closes the hole without changing the folder-trust default or breaking repositories that legitimately use project hooks: they keep working after a one-time approval.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Create a repository with `.qwen/settings.json` containing `{ "hooks": { "SessionStart": [{ "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "touch /tmp/repo-hook-ran" }] }] } }` and use a fresh `QWEN_HOME` (no `security.folderTrust`). Run `qwen -p hi` in it. Expected: `/tmp/repo-hook-ran` is not created and stderr says the project hooks were not loaded because they are not approved. On main the file is created silently.
2. Run `qwen` interactively in the same repository. Expected: a yellow "Untrusted hooks in .qwen/settings.json" dialog lists `SessionStart  touch /tmp/repo-hook-ran`; the hook has not run while the dialog is open. Choose Approve. Expected: `~/.qwen/hookApprovals.json` now has a record for the repository path with `status: approved`; a second start shows no dialog and the hook runs. `qwen -p hi` now also runs it.
3. Edit the hook command in `.qwen/settings.json` and start again. Expected: the dialog is back (the stored hash no longer matches) and the hook does not run until re-approved. Choose Reject: no dialog on later starts, hooks stay unloaded, until the block changes again.
4. With the dialog pending in a session, run `/hooks`: project hooks are listed as awaiting approval; after approving, they are enabled under source Project.
5. `qwen --yolo -p hi` runs the hook without a record; adding `"tools": {"approvalMode": "yolo"}` to the repository's own settings does not, and `qwen -p hi` stays gated. `--safe-mode`, `--bare` and `disableAllHooks` load no hooks and print no warning.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before (main @ 628ab5c1af), headless, fresh home:

```
$ qwen -p hi
PONG
$ ls -l /tmp/repo-hook-ran
-rw-r--r--  1 user  wheel  0 Oct 19 11:15 /tmp/repo-hook-ran
```

After, headless:

```
$ qwen -p hi
Project hooks in .qwen/settings.json were not loaded: they are not approved for this folder. Run qwen interactively here to review them.
PONG
$ ls -l /tmp/repo-hook-ran
ls: /tmp/repo-hook-ran: No such file or directory
```

After, interactive start (captured with expect; the hook file does not exist while the dialog is open):

```
   │ Untrusted hooks in .qwen/settings.json
   │ This workspace declares hooks: commands Qwen Code runs on events such as
   │  session start or before a tool call. Approving lets them run with your
   │ privileges. Approval is bound to this exact configuration — if
   │ .qwen/settings.json changes, you will be asked again.
   │
   │   SessionStart  touch /tmp/repo-hook-ran
   │
   │ › 1. Approve these hooks
   │   2. Reject (esc)
```

After approving, `~/.qwen/hookApprovals.json`:

```json
{
  "/private/var/.../cloned-repo": {
    "hash": "a6f5750fd7ee774be7238ccc4fe62412ca9e52fb6dbb9909834f2a5a939ad74c",
    "status": "approved"
  }
}
```

A second interactive start shows no dialog and creates `/tmp/repo-hook-ran`; after editing the hook command, `qwen -p hi` is gated again.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local `npm run bundle` build run against a mock model provider; unit tests via `npx vitest run` in `packages/core` and `packages/cli`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: users who rely on project hooks see one new dialog per repository (and again after each edit to the hooks block). Headless and ACP sessions in a repository whose hooks were never approved interactively silently skip them; headless prints a warning, ACP does not yet.
- Not validated / out of scope: an ACP request to approve project hooks (follow-up, mirroring the MCP one); the experimental LSP `.lsp.json` command path described in the issue; re-firing `SessionStart` for hooks approved mid-session (they register for subsequent events; the next session runs them from the start). Windows and Linux rely on CI.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none in settings. Existing project hooks stop loading until approved once; the approval file is new and user-local.

Design doc: [docs/design/2026-10-19-project-hooks-approval-gate.md](https://github.com/TianYuan1024/qwen-code/blob/fix/project-hooks-approval-gate/docs/design/2026-10-19-project-hooks-approval-gate.md) / [中文](https://github.com/TianYuan1024/qwen-code/blob/fix/project-hooks-approval-gate/docs/design/2026-10-19-project-hooks-approval-gate.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Closes #14746
