<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

工作区 `.qwen/settings.json` 里声明的 hooks 现在需要用户批准后才会加载，与项目 MCP 服务器（#4615）一致。在声明了 hooks 的工作区第一次交互式启动时，会弹出对话框列出每条 hook（事件、matcher、命令），可选批准或拒绝（Esc 推迟到下次启动或打开 `/hooks` 时，并在会话记录中提示 hooks 未加载）。对话框中仓库提供的每个字符串都被清理为一行，列表展示每个 hook 的 env、请求头名称、允许的环境变量和 prompt 文本，并按终端高度截断以保证选项可见。决定按项目（以 `.qwen/settings.json` 所在目录为键，`/cd` 与 `--worktree` 不影响）保存在 `~/.qwen/hookApprovals.json`，绑定 hooks 配置的哈希，因此之后的任何修改都会重新询问，而已拒绝的配置不会反复询问。会话中批准会解除运行中 config 的闸门并重载 hook 注册表；`/hooks`（会重新读取设置）会重新计算闸门，修改过的 hooks 块保持不加载并再次弹出对话框。ink 与 OpenTUI 两套渲染器都有该对话框，两个 `/hooks` 浏览器（以及 ACP hooks 状态）都把被扣留的项目 hooks 标为等待审批。无头模式无法提示，未批准的项目 hooks 保持不加载，`qwen -p` 在 stderr 打印一行说明如何批准。只有命令行要求的 YOLO（`--yolo`、`--approval-mode yolo`）跳过闸门，因为仓库自己的设置可以设置 `tools.approvalMode`；`--bare`、`--safe-mode` 与 `disableAllHooks` 不加载 hooks 也不询问。项目 `.env` 不能改变审批文件位置。用户、系统和扩展 hooks 不受影响。hooks 与 trusted folders 文档描述了新步骤，并附设计文档（中英）。

## 为什么需要

`security.folderTrust.enabled` 默认关闭，关闭时每个目录都被视为受信任，克隆仓库的 `.qwen/settings.json` 会被完整合并，其中 `SessionStart`（或任何事件）的命令 hook 在 `qwen` 启动时就执行，没有任何提示。"克隆仓库 → 在里面打开 AI 编码工具"是再普通不过的操作，这相当于对任何能让用户克隆仓库的人开放了远程代码执行。同一文件里的项目 MCP 服务器已经有哈希绑定的审批闸门，项目 hooks 却没有。用同样的方式给 hooks 加闸门，既不改目录信任默认值，也不破坏合法使用项目 hooks 的仓库：一次批准后照常工作。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 创建一个仓库，`.qwen/settings.json` 内容为 `{ "hooks": { "SessionStart": [{ "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "touch /tmp/repo-hook-ran" }] }] } }`，使用全新的 `QWEN_HOME`（未设置 `security.folderTrust`）。在其中运行 `qwen -p hi`。预期：`/tmp/repo-hook-ran` 未创建，stderr 提示项目 hooks 因未批准而未加载。在 main 上该文件会被静默创建。
2. 在同一仓库交互式运行 `qwen`。预期：黄色的 "Untrusted hooks in .qwen/settings.json" 对话框列出 `SessionStart  touch /tmp/repo-hook-ran`；对话框打开期间 hook 未执行。选择 Approve。预期：`~/.qwen/hookApprovals.json` 中出现该仓库路径的记录，`status: approved`；再次启动不再弹框，hook 执行；`qwen -p hi` 也会执行它。
3. 修改 `.qwen/settings.json` 中的 hook 命令后再启动。预期：对话框再次出现（存储的哈希不再匹配），重新批准前 hook 不执行。选择 Reject：之后启动不再弹框，hooks 保持不加载，直到该块再次变化。
4. 对话框待定时运行 `/hooks`：项目 hooks 显示为禁用；批准后 `/hooks` 在 Project 来源下显示为启用。
5. `qwen --yolo -p hi` 无需记录即执行 hook；在仓库自己的设置里加 `"tools": {"approvalMode": "yolo"}` 则不行，`qwen -p hi` 仍被拦截。`--safe-mode`、`--bare` 与 `disableAllHooks` 不加载任何 hooks，也不打印警告。

### 证据（修复前 / 后）

见上方英文部分：修复前无头运行静默创建文件；修复后无头运行被拦截并给出警告，交互式启动显示审批对话框，批准后写入 `hookApprovals.json`，再次启动不再询问；修改 hook 后再次被拦截。

### 测试平台

macOS ✅；Windows、Linux 依赖 CI ⚠️。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：使用项目 hooks 的用户每个仓库会多一次对话框（hooks 块每次修改后再问一次）。从未交互式批准过的仓库，无头与 ACP 会话会静默跳过项目 hooks；无头会打印警告，ACP 目前不会。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：ACP 审批项目 hooks 的请求（后续，照 MCP 的实现）；issue 里描述的实验性 LSP `.lsp.json` 命令路径；会话中批准后补发 `SessionStart`（批准后对后续事件生效，下一次会话从头执行）。Windows 与 Linux 依赖 CI。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：设置无变化。既有项目 hooks 在批准一次之前不再加载；审批文件为新增的用户本地文件。

Closes #14746

prs.title: feat(ci): report the Actions queue on the Fleet Shepherd dashboard
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a read-only census of the repository's Actions queue to the Fleet Shepherd's existing 15-minute tick, and renders it as a new section on the dashboard issue the shepherd already maintains. Each tick reports the queued depth, the in-progress count, the wait distribution, the queued breakdown by workflow and by event, and a digested / new / still-queued comparison against the previous tick's set of queued run ids.

Runs older than a day are reported as a separate aged tail and excluded from the wait distribution and the breakdown, because they are a different population rather than slow runs. The comparison spans every enumerated run, aged tail included.

The census pulls no lever: it never dispatches, reruns, cancels, or deletes anything, opens no issue, and introduces no thresholds.

The second commit fixes a defect the census itself exposed: the shepherd had stopped running. Eighteen of its last thirty runs were cancelled, each within a second of the next run's creation, and nothing completed between 14:13 and 15:19 Beijing. A concurrency group keeps one pending run and a newer pending run cancels the older one — `cancel-in-progress: false` protects only runs that already started — so with a pool wait longer than the tick interval every tick replaced the previous tick's queue position and none of them ever reached a runner. The tick now runs every thirty minutes, the concurrency key splits into three groups (ticks, watch, rescued runs), and a second cron runs the same job in a watch mode that dispatches one rescue when nothing has completed for seventy-five minutes and nothing is in progress.

## Why it's needed

The queue backs up for hours at a time and nothing in the repository reports it. Measured today between 13:47 and 14:24 Beijing time, 229–233 runs were queued against 19–33 in progress, with a live median wait of about 146 minutes. The shepherd's only queue awareness today watches its own autofix dispatches, so a repo-wide backlog stays invisible until someone opens the Actions tab. The autofix loop cannot discover it either — its inputs are issue labels, reviews, comments and a scan of open pull requests, none of which reads a queue metric.

Two measurement traps shaped the design, both confirmed against live data rather than assumed.

Depth is non-monotonic: it falls when runs are cancelled and rises while the queue drains, so two depth readings cannot answer "is it draining". Only a set difference can, which is why the previous sample is persisted — and why it is recorded only for a complete enumeration. Diffing a complete enumeration against a partial one counts every run that merely left the window as digested; a live rehearsal with a 100-of-229 baseline reported 145 "new" runs that were an artifact of the partial baseline, not a burst.

The aged tail actively misattributes. 81 of 231 queued runs were created on 2026-08-19, the workflow-size incident the shepherd's own comments already record, and nothing sat between one day and seventy days. Counting them put the median wait at 243 minutes with a seventy-day maximum, and ranked two workflows into the fan-out top five that had no live queued runs at all. Excluding them yields a median of 146 minutes and a top five that matches what is actually waiting.

Whether a backlog is fixable inside the repository at all — event fan-out and stage budgets are, pool capacity and platform incidents are not — remains a human attribution call. This change makes the evidence visible; acting on it is deliberately left out.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Dispatch the shepherd on this branch with the dry-run input, so no write is performed and the shared dashboard is untouched:

```
gh workflow run qwen-fleet-shepherd.yml --repo QwenLM/qwen-code --ref feat/shepherd-queue-census -f dry_run=true
gh run view <run-id> --repo QwenLM/qwen-code --log | grep -E '🧮 queue:|DRY-RUN'
```

Confirm that the log carries one census summary line, that the live and aged counts sum to the enumerated count, that the depth is plausible against a direct queued-count query taken at the same moment, and that every write line is a dry-run line — in particular the dashboard update. With the queue deeper than five hundred runs the summary should report an incomplete enumeration, and the rendered section should describe the waits as a floor and record no sample.

For the unit coverage, run the shepherd meta-tests and the workflow-size gate. The tests extract the programs from the workflow and replay them with real jq and a stubbed gh, so an edit that drifts from the assertions fails there rather than in production.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Not a TUI change. Before: the dashboard has Bot fleet, Takeover pool and Awaiting human sections and no queue section. After, the rendered section from a live read-only rehearsal against this repository:

```
## Actions queue

Queued 232 · in progress 33 · enumerated 231 (151 live + 80 aged)

> ⚠️ **80 queued run(s) are older than 24h** (oldest 2026-08-19T01:04:50Z). They are excluded from the waits and the breakdown below: a run this old was never started, and counting it names last season's workflows as today's fan-out. The list is status+age only — check `gh run view <id> --json jobs` before deleting any.

Wait since creation (live, under 24h): p50 146m · max 461m

| Workflow | Queued (live) |
| --- | --- |
| 🧐 Qwen Pull Request Review | 55 |
| tui-parity | 40 |
| Managed Agent gate | 11 |
| E2E Tests | 9 |
| Qwen Code CI | 5 |

Events (live): pull_request_target 61 · pull_request 59 · push 8 · workflow_run 7 · pull_request_review 6 · schedule 4
```

The same rehearsal without the aged split reported p50 243m, max 101111m, and a top five containing Qwen Triage Finalize (26) and Comment Attachment Guard (13) — neither of which had a single live queued run.

Six mutations were each confirmed to turn the suite red: keeping aged runs in the breakdown, dropping the completeness gate on the comparison, dropping it on the persisted sample, stopping the enumeration on a full page, sorting the fan-out ascending, and turning one statistic back into a bare assignment. The last one aborts the entire replay under `set -e`, which is the whole-tick failure the added guards prevent.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local meta-tests only, plus read-only rehearsals against the live repository API. The workflow itself runs on the hosted pool the shepherd already uses.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the persisted run-id set grows the dashboard body by roughly 6 KB at the five-hundred-run cap, against GitHub's 65536-character issue-body limit. Enumeration costs at most six API calls per tick on a runner that already runs every fifteen minutes.
- Not validated / out of scope: no threshold, alert, or issue filing is implemented on the census side, so nothing here yet routes a backlog to the autofix loop; that is deferred until the dashboard has produced a few days of real data. The rescue watch has not run in production yet — its first scheduled watch tick lands after merge, and until then its behaviour is covered only by the behavioral replay.
- Second risk, from the scheduling fix: rescued runs share one group, so at most one can be outstanding, and the watch is the only thing that dispatches them. If the watch itself cannot be scheduled, nothing rescues the shepherd; that is the same pool problem one level up, and the failure is visible as a stale dashboard rather than silently. The aged tail is identified by age alone — the listing carries no job state, which is why the banner tells the reader to check a run's jobs before deleting it. Windows and Linux were not exercised locally; the change is bash and jq inside a Linux-hosted job.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The first tick after merge has no previous sample and reports no comparison; the following tick does. The workflow-size baseline is raised in this change, and about 2.8 KB of that increase is pre-existing drift on main rather than this feature.

Design document: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/shepherd-queue-census/docs/design/2026-10-28-shepherd-queue-census.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/shepherd-queue-census/docs/design/2026-10-28-shepherd-queue-census.zh-CN.md)

## Design document

The scheduling decisions above are recorded in the same design document as the census, in a section named for the self-starvation and the rescue lane.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在 Fleet Shepherd 已有的 15 分钟一跳上，增加一次对仓库 Actions 队列的只读普查，并把它渲染成 shepherd 本就维护的那条 Dashboard issue 上的一个新区块。每一跳汇报排队深度、在跑数、等待时长分布、按 workflow 与按事件的排队明细，以及与上一跳排队 run id 集合对比得出的「已消化 / 新增 / 仍在排队」。

创建时间超过一天的 run 作为独立的陈旧尾部汇报，并从等待分布与明细中剔除，因为它们是另一个 population，而不是慢的 run。集合对比则覆盖全部已枚举 run，包含陈旧尾部。

普查不含任何操作杆：从不派发、重跑、取消或删除任何东西，不开 issue，也不引入阈值。

第二个提交修复的正是普查自己暴露出来的缺陷：shepherd 已经跑不起来了。它最近三十条运行里有十八条被取消，且每一条都在下一条创建后一秒内被取消；北京时间 14:13 到 15:19 之间没有任何一条完成。并发组只保留一条 pending run，更新的 pending 会取消旧的——`cancel-in-progress: false` 只保护已经开始跑的——因此当池子等待超过 tick 间隔时，每一跳都在替换上一跳的排队位置，没有一跳真正轮到 runner。现在主干节拍改为 30 分钟，concurrency key 拆成三个组（tick、监视、被救援的运行），另加一条 cron 以监视模式运行同一个 job：当已 75 分钟没有任何一条完成、且没有正在运行的，就派发一次救援。

## 为什么需要

队列动辄积压数小时，而仓库内没有任何东西汇报它。今天北京时间 13:47 至 14:24 实测，排队 229–233 条，在跑仅 19–33 条，活队列等待中位数约 146 分钟。shepherd 目前对队列的唯一感知是盯它自己的 autofix 派发，因此全仓积压在有人打开 Actions 页面之前是不可见的。autofix 循环自己也发现不了——它的输入是 issue 标签、评审、评论以及对开放 PR 的扫描，没有任何一路读队列指标。

有两个测量陷阱塑造了本设计，且都是对真实数据核实过的，而非假设。

深度是非单调的：run 被取消时它会下降，队列正在排空时它也可能上升，所以两次深度读数回答不了「在排空么」。只有集合差能回答，这也是要持久化上一跳样本的原因——同时也是只在枚举完整时才记录它的原因。拿完整枚举去 diff 一个残缺枚举，会把仅仅移出窗口的 run 全算成已消化；一次以 229 条中取 100 条为基线的实跑报出了 145 条「新增」，那是残缺基线的产物，不是真有一波涌流。

陈旧尾部会造成实打实的误归因。231 条排队里有 81 条创建于 2026-08-19，正是 shepherd 自己注释里已记载的 workflow 体积事故当天，而 1 天到 70 天之间一条都没有。把它们算进去，等待中位数变成 243 分钟、最大值 70 天，并把两个在活队列里一条都没有的 workflow 顶进扇出前五。剔除之后，中位数是 146 分钟，前五名与真正在等的东西一致。

积压究竟能不能在仓库内修——事件扇出与阶段预算可以，机群容量与平台事故不行——仍然是人的归因判断。本次改动让证据可见，有意不包含据此采取行动的部分。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

在本分支上带 dry-run 输入派发 shepherd，这样不会执行任何写入，共享 Dashboard 不受影响：

```
gh workflow run qwen-fleet-shepherd.yml --repo QwenLM/qwen-code --ref feat/shepherd-queue-census -f dry_run=true
gh run view <run-id> --repo QwenLM/qwen-code --log | grep -E '🧮 queue:|DRY-RUN'
```

请确认：日志里有一行普查摘要；活队列数与陈旧数之和等于已枚举数；深度与同一时刻直接查询排队数的结果相称；每一行写入都是 dry-run 行，尤其是 Dashboard 更新那一行。当队列超过五百条时，摘要应报枚举不完整，渲染出的区块应把等待描述为下界且不记录样本。

单测方面，跑 shepherd 元测试与 workflow 体积门禁。这些用例从 workflow 中抽取程序，用真实 jq 与打桩的 gh 回放，因此与断言发生偏离的改动会在这里变红，而不是到生产才发现。

### 证据（Before & After）

不是 TUI 改动。Before：Dashboard 有 Bot fleet、Takeover pool、Awaiting human 三个区块，没有队列区块。After：对本仓库做只读实跑后渲染出的区块：

```
## Actions queue

Queued 232 · in progress 33 · enumerated 231 (151 live + 80 aged)

> ⚠️ **80 queued run(s) are older than 24h** (oldest 2026-08-19T01:04:50Z). They are excluded from the waits and the breakdown below: a run this old was never started, and counting it names last season's workflows as today's fan-out. The list is status+age only — check `gh run view <id> --json jobs` before deleting any.

Wait since creation (live, under 24h): p50 146m · max 461m

| Workflow | Queued (live) |
| --- | --- |
| 🧐 Qwen Pull Request Review | 55 |
| tui-parity | 40 |
| Managed Agent gate | 11 |
| E2E Tests | 9 |
| Qwen Code CI | 5 |

Events (live): pull_request_target 61 · pull_request 59 · push 8 · workflow_run 7 · pull_request_review 6 · schedule 4
```

同一次实跑若不拆陈旧尾部，报出的是 p50 243m、max 101111m，且前五名里含 Qwen Triage Finalize（26）与 Comment Attachment Guard（13）——这两者在活队列里一条都没有。

六项变异各自确认能让套件变红：明细保留陈旧 run、集合对比去掉完整性闸、持久化样本去掉完整性闸、满页即停、扇出改为升序，以及把某项统计改回裸赋值。最后一项会让整个回放在 `set -e` 下中止，这正是新增保护要防的整跳失败。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### 环境（可选）

仅本地元测试，外加对真实仓库 API 的只读实跑。workflow 本身跑在 shepherd 本就使用的托管池上。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：在五百条上限处，持久化的 run id 集合会让 Dashboard 正文增长约 6 KB，而 GitHub 的 issue 正文上限是 65536 字符。枚举每跳至多六次 API 调用，跑在一个本就每十五分钟运行一次的 runner 上。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：普查侧没有实现任何阈值、告警或开 issue，因此目前还不会把积压路由给 autofix 循环；这部分等 Dashboard 积累几天真实数据后再做。救援监视尚未在生产跑过——第一次定时监视要等合入之后，在那之前它的行为只有行为回放覆盖。
- 调度修复带来的第二个风险：被救援的运行共用一个组，因此同时最多只有一条在等，而派发它们的只有这条监视链。若监视自身也排不上，就没有东西能救 shepherd——那是同一个池子问题向上一层，且其失败表现为 Dashboard 变陈旧而不是静默。陈旧尾部仅凭年龄识别——列表不带 job 状态，这也是横幅要求读者在删除前先查该 run 的 jobs 的原因。Windows 与 Linux 未在本地验证；改动是 Linux 托管 job 内的 bash 与 jq。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。合入后的第一跳没有上一跳样本，因此不报对比；再下一跳就有了。本次同步上调了 workflow 体积基线，其中约 2.8 KB 是 main 上已有的漂移，而非本功能带来的。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/shepherd-queue-census/docs/design/2026-10-28-shepherd-queue-census.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/shepherd-queue-census/docs/design/2026-10-28-shepherd-queue-census.zh-CN.md)

## 设计文档

上述调度决策与普查记录在同一份设计文档里，见「自锁饿死与救援车道」一节。

## 关联 Issue

无。

</details>

prs.title: fix(release): unblock Managed runtime 0.26.3 backfill
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Repairs the Managed runtime ownership test by injecting the same schema-aware JDBC bean used by production stores. It also lets a manual release from main backfill the missing 0.26.3 runtime using the original release commit and a narrowly scoped test-only patch. All existing ownership assertions and the complete SDK/server verification gates remain enabled.

## Why it's needed

CLI 0.26.3 and its other release channels have already succeeded. The separate Managed runtime run failed because the test's ordinary JDBC bean bound string identities to binary columns: H2 reported `BINARY VARYING(512)` and `CHARACTER VARYING(46)` as incomparable. A normal rerun still checks out the original tag and therefore cannot consume a test fix merged into main.

The recovery accepts only `v0.26.3` at `eeee1443a7e36ab22b2f1dcded8dec64b621a7ee`, rejects a dirty tracked checkout or a patch targeting any other file, and records the patch blob in the run summary. Production sources and the existing tag remain unchanged. Existing artifact mismatch checks continue to prevent overwrites.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Confirm the ownership test reaches its original anonymous, intruder and owner assertions with the managed JDBC bean.
- Confirm the workflow regression cases apply the checked-in patch to the old test, reproduce the fixed test, preserve production bytes, and reject an unexpected source commit or production-file patch.
- After merge and CI acceptance, dispatch **Release Managed server runtime** from main with `tag=v0.26.3` and `dry_run=false`. Expect the full SDK and server verification to pass before the missing runtime JAR/checksum are added to GitHub and OSS. Other releases and the tag must remain unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: [Managed runtime release attempt 2](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40707577914/attempts/2) stopped at the ownership test with 5,834 tests run, one error and 19 skipped by the existing suite configuration. After: static review and `git diff --check` completed; local tests, builds, lint and typecheck were not run as requested. CI and the actual backfill are pending. No test exclusions or skip flags were added.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Static review only; execution not tested |
| Windows | Not tested |
| Linux | Post-fix execution pending CI |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a one-release test patch must stay synchronized with the corrected ownership test; the regression cases cover that contract.
- Not validated / out of scope: successful post-fix Maven verification and actual publication remain pending. This does not republish the CLI or modify production Java code.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No tag movement, version bump, database migration, test bypass or artifact overwrite.
- Design: [English](docs/design/managed-runtime-0263-test-repair.md) / [简体中文](docs/design/managed-runtime-0263-test-repair.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

[Failed Managed runtime release](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40707577914/attempts/2)

## 为什么需要

CLI 0.26.3 及其他发布渠道已经成功。独立的 Managed runtime 发布失败，是因为测试使用的普通 JDBC Bean 将字符串标识绑定到二进制列，H2 报告 `BINARY VARYING(512)` 与 `CHARACTER VARYING(46)` 无法比较。直接重跑仍检出原标签，因此无法使用合入 main 的测试修复。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：单版本测试补丁必须与修复后的归属测试保持一致，回归用例覆盖这一约束。
- 未验证或范围之外：修复后的 Maven 验证成功和实际发布仍待确认。本次不重新发布 CLI，也不修改生产 Java 代码。

prs.title: fix(web-shell): bound pending edit diffs to nearby context
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Pending and in-progress whole-file edit previews show each change with up to three surrounding lines and file-relative hunk coordinates. Common file ends are trimmed before comparing. Oversized previews explicitly report omission; LF and CRLF final-newline-only edits show a localized notice. Replacement-fragment arguments retain their headerless preview, and supplied patches and completed previews retain their existing behavior.

Diff previews visibly mark invisible characters instead of rendering them as indistinguishable source text. Both raw patches and full-content artifact views use the same visible escapes; the underlying CodeMirror document retains its original bytes. Call details apply their 4,000-character content limit after escaping. Uniform CRLF previews remain clean when their final line is unterminated, while actual ending conversions remain visible.

## What review rounds 6–9 changed

The first five rounds established the bounded preview, the visible escapes and the source-layer CRLF verdict. Three findings in rounds 6–9 were about the *price* of those fixes, and each is now paid only where it is owed.

**The merge-side escape is decided per pair, not per file.** The narrow (unified) artifact layout cannot decorate the deleted side — `@codemirror/merge` paints it from its own `originalDoc` into raw text nodes that no view extension reaches — so both sides are neutralised before they enter the merge view. That transform doubles every backslash to stay injective, which meant a regex written `/\d+/` rendered `/\\d+/`, a Windows path `C:\tmp` rendered `C:\\tmp`, and `"\n"` rendered `"\\n"` for every file containing a backslash, while the wide branch showed the raw bytes. `escapePairForMerge` now returns the pair untouched when neither side carries an invisible character and escapes both when either does. The decision is joint on purpose: a per-side test lets one side's literal `\u200b` meet the other side's escaped real U+200B and report "unchanged".

**The CRLF vote only runs where nobody decided.** Builders now stamp a negative verdict (`\diff-crlf-mixed`) alongside the affirmative one, so `parseUnifiedDiff` infers uniformity from rendered rows only for raw patches no builder produced. The inference also learned the two facts it lacked: the unterminated-final-line allowance keys on git's `\ No newline at end of file` notice rather than on row position, and a final row that kept its terminator still votes instead of being withheld as possibly truncated.

**The unbounded builder has the bounded builder's terminator gate.** An edit whose only change is the final newline now renders the localized notice in tool cards and call details too, instead of `-y` and `+y` byte-identical under a `+1/-1` badge.

## Why it's needed

A one-line edit near line 100 of a 200-line file previously rendered 201 rows. Whole-file previews now render nine rows with correct coordinates. This keeps approval readable without changing the permission protocol or tool execution.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Edit line 100 of a 200-line file: the approval dialog and pending/in-progress whole-file card should show lines 97–103 and +1/-1.
- Supply replacement fragments through the edit tool's real arguments: expect the existing headerless preview, without a claim about the fragment's file offset.
- Check a large insertion and distant edits that exceed the preview budget: expect an omitted notice rather than a fabricated whole-file rewrite.
- Add or remove only the final LF or CRLF terminator: expect the localized notice and no +1/-1 badge. Adding/removing a sole blank line and converting LF to CRLF remain real content changes.
- Review a CRLF file without a final newline: a content edit should not add terminator noise.
- Compare real invisible characters with literal escape text and mixed full-content/raw-patch artifact entries: only real characters receive a visible decoration, with matching display in both renderers. CodeMirror retains the original document.
- Expand a call whose escaped output exceeds 4,000 characters: content remains within the bound and a truncation notice appears. Embedded notice-like patch rows remain literal.
- Check supplied patches, completed previews and failed calls: preserve their existing behavior.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The five round-5 review findings were reproduced at the exact reviewed head `e6e31c40`: seven independent component witnesses failed before the fix and passed afterwards. Six deliberate fix reversions each fail their corresponding regression.

On 2026-10-13 the branch was synchronized with upstream main `6373fc4e` in signed merge commit `e1b302e4`. The only textual conflict was the transcript bundle budget; the upstream Excel preview assertions and all round-5 fixes are retained. The transcript JS remainder measures 1,332,856 UTF-16 units, below the existing PR ceiling of 1,336,000. No additional budget increase was needed.

Frozen-lockfile installation, the complete workspace build and CLI bundle, Web Shell TypeScript, related ESLint, and the normal staged-file Prettier/ESLint commit hook pass. The six focused rendering/diff suites pass 426 tests, and the build-artifact suite passes all 30 tests.

The full Web Shell unit run reports 11,520 passed, 83 failed, and three unhandled errors. Failures were confined to the session-provider suite (82) and the settings-route development-server test (one, default 5-second timeout). A separate run of those exact files at the default timeout passes all 420 session-provider tests and 20 of the 21 settings-route tests. A further settings-file run with a command-line 15-second ceiling passes all 21 tests; no repository timeout configuration was changed. The session-provider source, its tests and the settings test are identical to upstream main. An exact-main runtime failure is not claimed, and the complete default-timeout suite is not reported green. Whole-workspace tests and live daemon/model/native Desktop E2E were not run in this synchronization.

### Round 9 evidence

Each of the three findings above was reproduced at `2d1aeb5f` before being fixed, and each fix is pinned by a test that fails when it is removed:

| Revert | Test that goes red |
| :-- | :-- |
| pair gate in `escapePairForMerge` | `ArtifactPanel.test.tsx` narrow backslash case (`state.doc.toString()` gains doubled backslashes) |
| negative CRLF verdict | `unifiedDiff.test.ts` source-refused pair and context-window cases |
| notice-keyed allowance | `unifiedDiff.test.ts` unterminated-final-line case |
| builder terminator gate | `unifiedDiff.test.ts` builder pin and `DiffView.test.tsx` notice case |

`ArtifactPanel.test.tsx` did not run when this PR was opened: `@qwen-code/sdk/daemon` had no `dist/daemon/index.js`, so the file failed to collect and the narrow merge branch was described rather than covered. The declaration bundle was rebuilt for this round, and the file now runs: 149 passed, both narrow-branch cases included. Across the seven suites this PR touches: **475 passed**, and ESLint plus Prettier are clean on the eight changed files. `tsc --noEmit` reports no error in any changed file; the 63 errors it emits are pre-existing missing-module errors for `exceljs`, `ssf` and `shiki-files` in this checkout. `build-artifact.test.ts` reports the same 8 failures with and without this round's changes, all from a `dist/` built before it.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :-- |
| Windows | Actual React/CodeMirror jsdom regressions, package build and static checks; full unit result disclosed above |
| macOS | Not tested locally |
| Linux | Awaiting upstream CI |

### Environment (optional)

Windows, Node.js 24.20.0, pnpm workspace dependencies and Vitest/jsdom. The workspace CLI was built and bundled during frozen-lockfile installation. No live daemon, live model or native Desktop E2E is claimed.

## Risk & Scope

Compact whole-file previews omit distant unchanged lines; oversized input yields an explicit omitted notice. Invisible characters are represented visibly, so displayed escapes differ from the underlying bytes. Already escaped adapter text stays literal because its original character provenance is unavailable. No permission protocol, tool execution or core-package changes; no dependency changes beyond upstream main synchronization. The current-head CI requires maintainer authorization.

AI assistance: implemented and verified with AI coding assistants, including OpenAI Codex.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13766

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

整份文件的待执行／执行中编辑预览仅显示修改和前后各三行上下文，保留文件坐标；真实工具参数中的替换片段仍保持无块头的原有预览，不伪称文件位置。超预算预览明确省略，LF/CRLF 的末尾换行增删明确提示；无末尾换行的 CRLF 文件保持干净，真实行尾转换和空白行增删保持为实际差分。

不可见字符以可区分的节点显示，原始补丁和完整内容的 artifact 视图使用相同展示，CodeMirror 原文不改写。调用详情在转义后限制为 4,000 字符。精确 review head 上的七项独立复现先失败后通过，六个负向验证均能发现修复被移除。本轮同步 main 6373fc4e 后，六套定向测试 426 项、构建产物 30 项通过；锁定依赖安装、全仓库构建及 CLI 打包、包类型检查、相关静态检查和提交 hook 通过。实测 transcript JS 为 1,332,856 UTF-16 单位，沿用原 PR 的 1,336,000 上限。

本轮完整 Web Shell 单元测试为 11,520 通过／83 失败，另有 3 项未处理错误；失败集中在 session-provider 和开发服务器测试。默认期限单独复跑后，session-provider 420 项全通过，开发服务器文件 20/21 通过。仅用命令参数将后者期限放宽至 15 秒时，21 项全通过；未改仓库超时配置。相关源文件和测试与精确 main 一致，但未运行精确 main 的失败复现，不据此声称基线也失败；完整默认期限套件仍不算全绿。上游 CI 待维护者授权；未验证真实模型、live daemon 或原生 Desktop E2E。 第 6–9 轮修的是前述修复的代价：合并侧转义改为按「文本对」判定，不含不可见字符的文件不再加倍反斜杠；构建器同时写出否定的 CRLF 裁决，行投票只在无人裁决时运行，且未终止末行的例外以 git 提示为键；无界构建器补齐终止符门。四项回退各自都能让对应测试变红；本轮重建 SDK 声明产物后 ArtifactPanel 测试可运行，七套定向测试共 475 项通过。

</details>

prs.title: feat(autofix-pr): root watches at the session worktree under the daemon
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes `/autofix-pr` usable from a daemon session whose working directory is a linked worktree of a multi-worktree clone. Under the daemon, a watch's worktree and state are now rooted at the session's own worktree toplevel instead of always at the clone's main worktree, so they land inside the session's containment boundary where the fix agent's commands are allowed to run. Outside the daemon the behavior is unchanged (clone-rooted). The watch listing — both `autofix-pr status` and the Web Shell's per-workspace watch page — now scans every worktree of the clone and merges the results, so a watch is found whichever worktree holds it, preserving the existing "two workspaces of one clone list the same watches" contract. The daemon shell guard and the worktree trust checks are not modified.

## Why it's needed

A maintainer working in linked worktrees (`x1`…`x9`) of one clone could never start a watch from those sessions: `prepare` rooted the worktree under the clone's main worktree, which is permanently outside a linked-worktree session's working directory, so the daemon would refuse every command the fix agent ran. `prepare` therefore failed closed before creating anything, with a refusal telling the user to open a session in the main clone — impractical when the PR branch and all their work live in the linked worktree. This turned `/autofix-pr` into a dead end in exactly the sessions maintainers use day to day. Rooting the watch inside the session's own directory removes the dead end without widening the security boundary: the artifacts move inside it rather than the boundary moving out.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

From a daemon (Web Shell) session opened in a linked worktree `L` of a clone whose main worktree is `M`, run `/autofix-pr <n>` for an open, pushable PR and confirm the start. Expected: `prepare` succeeds (no "outside this session's working directory" refusal), the reported worktree path is `L/.qwen/tmp/autofix-pr-<n>` (inside `L`), nothing is created under `M/.qwen/tmp`, and a round runs its fix agent in that worktree without any "Daemon shell guard could not establish the execution directory" denial. Then open the Web Shell PR-watches page for `M` (and a sibling workspace of the same clone): both list the watch, with `root` reported as `M`. Regression guards to confirm: a plain-CLI (non-daemon) watch is still clone-rooted and operable across worktrees; a daemon session whose cwd is a subdirectory of the worktree is still refused before the state file is read; and an explicit programmatic single-root `runStatus({ root })` scans only that worktree.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — not a user-visible/TUI change. Covered by unit tests (see the separate verification report comment): the linked-worktree daemon prepare regression pin, the clone-wide listing across worktrees, and its live-worktree dedupe. Before this change the linked-worktree daemon `prepare` failed closed; after it, it prepares inside the session's own directory.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local unit tests via `npx vitest run` in `packages/cli` (Linux, Node 24). The CRLF handling of the worktree-list parsing was reviewed for Windows (`gitOpt` normalizes CRLF; the daemon's raw enumeration strips a trailing `\r`), but not executed on Windows/macOS.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the watch storage model becomes worktree-aware under the daemon. The clone-wide listing anchors every trust check (and `unsavedWork`) to the genuine clone (`repoRoot()`), never to a discovered sibling worktree whose `.git` a round's code could rewrite, so a compromised sibling cannot vouch for its nested watches or make `status` execute its config; the listing reads sibling worktrees' watch metadata, the same read-only class of access the daemon listing already had for the main worktree. Each worktree's directory scan is isolated so one malformed sibling cannot abort the whole clone's listing, and `prepare` imports the PR history across the documented relocation so handled comments are not answered again.
- Not validated / out of scope: a full `npm run build`/`typecheck` is baseline-red in the development checkout for unrelated reasons (stale `core` dist plus UI/core API drift); a stash-based comparison confirmed this change adds zero new type errors. End-to-end runs against a live daemon and on macOS/Windows were not performed. The separate "autofix worktree has no node_modules" problem is out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no breaking change for currently-working flows. A watch prepared before this change under the main worktree is still found by a main-clone session and shown by the clone-wide listing; to operate it from a linked-worktree daemon session, run `cleanup` from the worktree that owns it (the main worktree for a legacy watch), then re-`prepare` in the target worktree. No silent relocation or data loss.

Design documents (both versions complete and synchronized): [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/autofix-pr-worktree-rooted-storage/docs/design/2026-10-29-autofix-pr-worktree-rooted-storage.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/autofix-pr-worktree-rooted-storage/docs/design/2026-10-29-autofix-pr-worktree-rooted-storage.zh-CN.md). Amends the 2026-10-21 autofix-pr command design (storage, 6.1 step 7, 6.10, 6.15) in both languages.

## Linked Issues

None — motivated by a maintainer usability investigation of `/autofix-pr` in linked-worktree daemon sessions.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

让 `/autofix-pr` 可以在「工作目录是多 worktree clone 的 linked worktree」的 daemon 会话里使用。在 daemon 下，watch 的 worktree 与状态现在以会话自身 worktree 的 toplevel 为根，而不再总是落在 clone 的主 worktree，从而落在会话的包含边界之内——修复 agent 的命令只被允许在那里运行。daemon 之外行为不变（仍按 clone 落盘）。watch 列表——`autofix-pr status` 与 Web Shell 各工作区的监视页——现在扫描 clone 的每一个 worktree 并合并结果，因此无论 watch 落在哪个 worktree 都能被找到，保留了既有「同一 clone 的两个 workspace 列出相同 watch」的契约。daemon shell guard 与 worktree 信任检查均未改动。

## 为什么需要

维护者在一个 clone 的多个 linked worktree（`x1`…`x9`）里工作，却从来无法从这些会话启动 watch：`prepare` 把 worktree 落在 clone 的主 worktree 下，而它永远在 linked-worktree 会话的工作目录之外，daemon 会拒绝修复 agent 在那里运行的每一条命令。于是 `prepare` 在创建任何东西之前就 fail-closed，拒绝信息让用户去主 clone 开会话——当 PR 分支和全部工作都在 linked worktree 里时，这并不现实。这使得 `/autofix-pr` 恰恰在维护者日常使用的会话里成了死角。把 watch 落在会话自身目录之内消除了这个死角，且不放宽安全边界：是产物移进边界之内，而不是边界向外扩。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

在一个开在 linked worktree `L`（主 worktree 为 `M`）的 daemon（Web Shell）会话里，对一个开放且可推送的 PR 运行 `/autofix-pr <n>` 并确认启动。预期：`prepare` 成功（无「outside this session's working directory」拒绝），报告的 worktree 路径是 `L/.qwen/tmp/autofix-pr-<n>`（在 `L` 内），`M/.qwen/tmp` 下不创建任何东西，一轮能在该 worktree 里运行修复 agent 而不出现任何「Daemon shell guard could not establish the execution directory」拒绝。然后打开 `M`（以及同 clone 的兄弟 workspace）的 Web Shell 监视页：两者都列出该 watch，`root` 报告为 `M`。需确认的回退护栏：plain-CLI（非 daemon）的 watch 仍按 clone 落盘且可跨 worktree 操作；cwd 位于 worktree 子目录的 daemon 会话仍在读取状态文件之前被拒绝；显式的程序化单根 `runStatus({ root })` 只扫描那一个 worktree。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A——非用户可见/TUI 改动。由单元测试覆盖（见单独的验证报告评论）：linked-worktree daemon prepare 的回退 pin、跨 worktree 的 clone 全量列表、及其活 worktree 去重。改动前 linked-worktree daemon 的 `prepare` fail-closed；改动后它在会话自身目录内 prepare。

### 测试平台

🍏 macOS ⚠️ 未测 · 🪟 Windows ⚠️ 未测 · 🐧 Linux ✅ 已测。

### 环境

本地单元测试，`packages/cli` 下 `npx vitest run`（Linux，Node 24）。已审查 worktree 列表解析的 CRLF 处理以兼顾 Windows（`gitOpt` 规范化 CRLF；daemon 的原始枚举去掉尾部 `\r`），但未在 Windows/macOS 上实际执行。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：daemon 下 watch 存储模型变为感知 worktree。clone 全量列表把每一次信任检查（以及 `unsavedWork`）都锚定到 genuine clone（`repoRoot()`），绝不锚定到发现来的兄弟 worktree——后者的 `.git` 可能被一轮运行的代码改写——因此被污染的兄弟无法为其嵌套 watch 担保、也无法让 `status` 执行它的配置；列表会读取兄弟 worktree 的 watch 元数据，这与 daemon 列表此前对主 worktree 的只读访问属同一类。每个 worktree 的目录扫描相互隔离，一个畸形兄弟不会中止整个 clone 的列表；`prepare` 会在文档化迁移中导入 PR history，使已处理评论不被再次回应。
- 未验证/超出范围：开发 checkout 里完整 `npm run build`/`typecheck` 因无关原因基线红（`core` dist 落后 + UI/core API 漂移）；基于 stash 的对比证实本改动新增零类型错误。未对真实 daemon 做端到端运行，也未在 macOS/Windows 上执行。「autofix worktree 没有 node_modules」这一独立问题不在范围内。
- 破坏性改动/迁移说明：对当前可用的流程无破坏性改动。改动前落在主 worktree 的 watch 仍能被主 clone 会话找到、并被 clone 全量列表展示；要从 linked-worktree daemon 会话操作它，先在拥有它的 worktree（遗留 watch 在主 worktree）里跑 `cleanup`，再在目标 worktree 重新 `prepare`。不做静默迁移，无数据丢失。

设计文档（两版完整且同步）：英文与简体中文版见上方链接。修订 2026-10-21 autofix-pr 命令设计（存储、6.1 step 7、6.10、6.15）的双语版本。

## 关联 Issue

无——源于对 linked-worktree daemon 会话中 `/autofix-pr` 的一次维护者可用性调查。

</details>

prs.title: test(managed-agent): qualify test fixtures onto the managed JdbcTemplate
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Three managed-agent test fixtures autowire the application's `JdbcTemplate` without a qualifier. After #15718 marked the managed template `defaultCandidate=false`, an unqualified autowire resolves to the plain autoconfigured template when the full CI context also carries one. The plain template does not convert `String` keys for the `VARBINARY` identity columns (`tenant_id`, `session_id`, `record_id`), so on H2 the query fails with `Values of types "BINARY VARYING(512)" and "CHARACTER VARYING(…)" are not comparable`.

All three now pin the managed template with `@Qualifier("managedJdbcTemplate")`, matching how production wiring and the sibling acceptance fixture (qualified in #15802) already resolve it.

`ManagedAgentServerIntegrationTest` additionally pins its `PlatformTransactionManager` with `@Qualifier("managedAgentTransactionManager")`. The same `defaultCandidate=false` change applies to the managed transaction manager, and every `new TransactionTemplate(transactionManager)` in that suite rides on the field (`:1012`, `:1171`, `:2309`, including `doesNotPublishRolledBackEvents`), so leaving it unqualified would let those rollback/publish assertions run against Boot's plain manager.

In total this is **four annotation sites across three classes**: `ManagedAgentApiContractTest`, `ManagedExtensionRecordStoreTest`, and `ManagedAgentServerIntegrationTest`.

## Why it's needed

The failures are deterministic in the full CI context and unrelated to the PRs that surfaced them:

- **#15802** — `SDK Java (full) / Runtime Broker and Managed Agent MySQL` fails `ManagedExtensionRecordStoreTest.materializesMcpWithoutTasksAndRequiresItsResourceClosure` at `listRecords` (`ManagedExtensionRecordStore.java:172`), `Errors: 1` of 36.
- **#15801** — the same lane and its MariaDB sibling fail `ManagedAgentApiContractTest.archivedHistoryFiltersBeforePaginationAndBindsItsCursor` at `ManagedAgentApiContractTest.java:648`, `Errors: 1` of 5837, same type-mismatch signature against `ma_session`.

Neither PR touches these classes; the branches simply run the lanes that expose the latent wiring. Fixing it here unblocks both, and every future PR, from paying the same investigation twice.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Read the four injection points across the three classes and confirm each now names the bean production wiring uses: `managedJdbcTemplate` for the three `JdbcTemplate` fields, and `managedAgentTransactionManager` for the one `PlatformTransactionManager` field. The property to check is that nothing else about the fixtures changed — same assertions, same data, same counts.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: CI logs on both PRs fail with `org.h2.jdbc.JdbcSQLSyntaxErrorException: Values of types "BINARY VARYING(512)" and "CHARACTER VARYING(16)"` (…`(50)` on the contract test).

After: with the qualifier, `ManagedExtensionRecordStoreTest` 36/36 and `ManagedAgentApiContractTest` 23/23 pass locally. `ManagedAgentServerIntegrationTest` was qualified in the same pass; no local run is claimed for it.

CI at this head is green: of 105 check runs, 21 actually ran (20 success, plus one `route` from the Autofix lane that was cancelled and has a same-named successful successor) and 84 were skipped by scope. The required context `Lint & Static (ubuntu-latest, Node 22.x)` passed, as did `Managed Agent fast tier` and `SDK Java (fast) / ubuntu-latest / Java 21`.

Scope caveat, stated plainly: this head selected the **fast** tier, so the full-context lanes that originally surfaced the H2 type mismatch — `SDK Java (full) / Runtime Broker and Managed Agent MySQL` and its MariaDB sibling — were **skipped** here. Green CI on this head therefore does not by itself re-prove the fix in the full context.

Honesty note on reproduction: single-class local runs pass even without the qualifier, because that context contains no competing template — the failure only appears in CI's full context where the autoconfigured plain template also exists. For the same reason the fast tier passing is weak evidence for this specific change. The fix is therefore verified as "each fixture now names the bean production wiring uses", not "we reproduced the CI failure locally".

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ both named classes pass with the qualifier |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ CI |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ CI |

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff**: none — test-only change; each qualifier names the same bean production already requires for these stores. If a class's context ever stops exposing the managed bean, the test now fails fast at injection instead of silently testing the wrong template or transaction manager.
- **Not validated / out of scope**: test classes beyond these three that autowire an unqualified template were not changed; none of them are currently failing in CI evidence, and widening the sweep without a failure to justify it is out of scope. Making the qualifiers self-witnessing locally (a competing plain `JdbcTemplate` in a nested `@TestConfiguration`, so removal turns a test red instead of only failing in full CI) is tracked as review feedback and is not part of this diff.
- **Breaking changes / migration**: none.

## Linked Issues

Relates to #15802 and #15801 (both blocked by this CI failure); relates to #15718 (whose `defaultCandidate=false` change made the latent wiring visible). No closing keywords — this does not close them.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

三个 managed-agent 测试夹具在没有限定符的情况下注入应用的 `JdbcTemplate`。#15718 将 managed 模板标记为 `defaultCandidate=false` 之后，只要 CI 的完整上下文中同时存在自动配置的普通模板，裸注入就会解析到它。普通模板不会把 `String` 键转换给 `VARBINARY` 身份列（`tenant_id`、`session_id`、`record_id`），所以在 H2 上查询报 `BINARY VARYING … 与 CHARACTER VARYING … 不可比较`。

三个夹具现在都用 `@Qualifier("managedJdbcTemplate")` 钉住 managed 模板，与生产接线和 #15802 已修的同类验收夹具一致。

`ManagedAgentServerIntegrationTest` 还额外用 `@Qualifier("managedAgentTransactionManager")` 钉住了它的 `PlatformTransactionManager`。同一个 `defaultCandidate=false` 改动也作用于 managed 事务管理器，而该套件里所有 `new TransactionTemplate(transactionManager)`（`:1012`、`:1171`、`:2309`，含 `doesNotPublishRolledBackEvents`）都依赖这个字段；不限定就会让那些回滚/发布断言跑在 Boot 的普通管理器上。

合计是**三个类里的四个注解点**：`ManagedAgentApiContractTest`、`ManagedExtensionRecordStoreTest`、`ManagedAgentServerIntegrationTest`。

**为什么**：失败在 CI 完整上下文中是确定性的，且与触发它们的 PR 无关——#15802 在 MySQL lane 上挂在 `ManagedExtensionRecordStoreTest.listRecords`，#15801 在 MySQL/MariaDB lane 上挂在 `ManagedAgentApiContractTest:648`，签名相同。在此修复可以让这两个 PR 以及之后所有 PR 不再重复排查同一问题。

**验证方式**：检查三个类里的四个注入点现在都指向生产接线所用的 bean——三个 `JdbcTemplate` 字段指向 `managedJdbcTemplate`，一个 `PlatformTransactionManager` 字段指向 `managedAgentTransactionManager`；断言、数据、计数均未变。修复前 CI 日志显示 H2 类型不匹配；修复后两个点名的类本地 36/36 与 23/23 通过。`ManagedAgentServerIntegrationTest` 在同一批里被限定，但这里不声称它跑过本地。

本 head 上的 CI 是绿的：105 条 check run 里真正跑了 21 条（20 条 success，另有 1 条 Autofix lane 的 `route` 被 cancelled 且有同名成功后继），其余 84 条按 scope 跳过。必需上下文 `Lint & Static (ubuntu-latest, Node 22.x)` 通过，`Managed Agent fast tier` 与 `SDK Java (fast) / ubuntu-latest / Java 21` 也通过。

**范围说明（讲清楚）**：本 head 选中的是 **fast** 档，所以最初暴露 H2 类型不匹配的那两条完整上下文 lane——`SDK Java (full) / Runtime Broker and Managed Agent MySQL` 及其 MariaDB 姊妹腿——在这里是**跳过**的。因此本 head 上的 CI 绿并不能自行重新证明该修复在完整上下文里成立。

**如实说明**：本地单类运行即使不加限定符也能通过，因为该上下文中没有竞争的模板——失败只在 CI 完整上下文出现；同理，fast 档通过对这处改动来说也是弱证据。因此本修复的验证表述是"每个夹具现在命名了生产接线所用的 bean"，而不是"我们在本地复现了 CI 失败"。

**风险**：无，纯测试改动；每个限定符命名的都是这些 store 在生产中本就要求的 bean。其余三个类之外未限定注入的测试类本次未动——目前没有 CI 失败证据指向它们，没有证据不扩大范围。让限定符在本地自证（在嵌套 `@TestConfiguration` 里放一个竞争的普通 `JdbcTemplate`，使删除限定符时本地测试变红，而不只在完整 CI 里失败）已作为 review 反馈记录，不在本 diff 内。

</details>

prs.title: fix(vscode): keep sibling model settings when writing provider config
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Configuring a Coding Plan or a model provider from the VS Code companion rewrote the entire `settings.model` object with only `name`, silently deleting everything else the CLI keeps there. This change writes `name` and its paired `baseUrl` key by key through the writer's existing nested-object helper, so the rest of the model section survives.

## Why it's needed

`model` carries 23 settings — reasoning effort, session turn and wall-time caps, goal budgets, loop protection, logging flags, generation config. A user who tuned any of them through the CLI and then signed in or edited providers in the panel lost all of them without warning. Losing `baseUrl` is the sharpest case: it is the disambiguator when several providers share a model id, so the next launch can resolve to the wrong provider.

The paired `baseUrl` is written, not merely preserved. The model resolver documents an invariant that every writer of `model.name` also writes `model.baseUrl` in the same scope — a real URL, or an empty-string tombstone when there is none — because an omitted key cannot override a stale value from a lower-priority scope on merge. The old wholesale replacement satisfied that by accident (it deleted the stale value too); a key-only fix would have kept the previous provider's URL and used it as the disambiguator for the new model. Both call sites already have the URL at hand: the Coding Plan template entry, or the provider map entry with the same fallback the sibling provider entry uses.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Start from a settings file whose `model` is `{ name, baseUrl, reasoningEffort, maxSessionTurns }`, then configure a Coding Plan and then an api-key provider from the panel. Expected: only `name` and `baseUrl` change; `reasoningEffort` and `maxSessionTurns` are still present, and `baseUrl` matches the provider entry just written. Before the fix, `model` is reduced to `{ name }`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for screenshots — settings-file behavior is covered by unit tests. The new cases `preserves sibling model settings when writing a Coding Plan` and `preserves sibling model settings when writing api-key providers` fail on the pre-fix code (sibling keys dropped) and pass after; the existing api-key assertion was updated to expect the paired `baseUrl`.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux was verified in a `node:22-bookworm` container: full companion suite, 46 files / 663 passed / 1 skipped.

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only: `npx vitest run` in the companion package, plus Docker for the Linux run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk: the panel now writes `model.baseUrl` where it previously wrote nothing. When the active model is missing from the provider map the value falls back to the same default the provider entry receives, so the pair stays consistent.
- Not validated / out of scope: VS Code panel end-to-end and Windows.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; the change only stops deleting existing keys.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15822

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

从 VS Code 插件面板配置 Coding Plan 或模型 provider 时，`settings.model` 会被整体重写为只剩 `name`，CLI 存在这里的其他配置会被静默删除。本次改为通过该文件已有的嵌套对象辅助函数逐键写入 `name` 和配对的 `baseUrl`，`model` 下的其余设置得以保留。

## 为什么需要

`model` 下有 23 项设置：reasoningEffort、会话轮次与墙钟上限、goal 预算、循环保护、日志开关、generationConfig 等。用户用 CLI 调好这些之后，只要在面板里登录或改一次 provider，就会在无提示的情况下全部丢失。`baseUrl` 是最尖锐的一例：同名模型来自多个 provider 时，它是消歧符，丢了之后下次启动可能解析到错误的 provider。

配对的 `baseUrl` 是「写入」而不只是「保留」。模型解析器依赖一条已写明的不变量：每个写 `model.name` 的地方都要在同一 scope 写 `model.baseUrl` —— 真实 URL，或者没有时写空串墓碑 —— 因为缺失的键在合并时无法覆盖低优先级 scope 里的过期值。原先的整体替换是碰巧满足了它（过期值一起被删掉）；只保留兄弟键的修法会把上一个 provider 的 URL 留下来，并把它当作新模型的消歧符。两个调用点手上都已有该 URL：Coding Plan 模板条目，或 provider map 条目（兜底与相邻 provider 条目一致）。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

用一份 `model` 为 `{ name, baseUrl, reasoningEffort, maxSessionTurns }` 的 settings 起步，先在面板配置 Coding Plan，再配置 api-key provider。预期：只有 `name` 与 `baseUrl` 变化，`reasoningEffort`、`maxSessionTurns` 仍在，且 `baseUrl` 与刚写入的 provider 条目一致。修复前 `model` 会被压成 `{ name }`。

### 证据（Before & After）

截图 N/A —— 这是 settings 文件行为，由单测覆盖。新增用例 `preserves sibling model settings when writing a Coding Plan` 与 `preserves sibling model settings when writing api-key providers` 在修复前失败（兄弟键被删），修复后通过；既有 api-key 断言已更新为包含配对的 `baseUrl`。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

Linux 在 `node:22-bookworm` 容器中验证：插件整包测试 46 文件 / 663 通过 / 1 skipped。

### 环境（可选）

仅单元测试：在插件包内跑 `npx vitest run`，Linux 用 Docker 运行。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：面板现在会写 `model.baseUrl`，而之前什么都不写。当 active model 不在 provider map 中时，取值兜底为 provider 条目收到的同一默认值，保证两者一致。
- 未验证 / 范围外：VS Code 面板端到端、Windows。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无，改动只是不再删除既有键。

## 关联 issue

Fixes #15822

</details>

prs.title: feat(serve): add user-scope Skill activation routes
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds two daemon routes that enable or disable Skills in the **user** settings scope, which every workspace merges: `PUT /skills/:name/activation` and `PUT /skills/activation` (batch, up to 100 names). Like `PUT /extensions/activation`, they take no workspace selector. The body is `{ state: "enabled" | "disabled", mode?: "hard" | "default" }`; `mode` applies to disables only. Each request leaves the name in exactly one user list: a `hard` disable (the default) writes `skills.disabled`, a `default` disable writes `skills.defaultDisabled`, and an enable writes `skills.enabled`; the name is removed from the other two.

An enable is refused without writing, answering `200` with `changed: false` and a `block` naming the entry, when the merged config would still keep the Skill disabled: a System/SystemDefaults `skills.disabled` entry under either spelling, a User entry in the other spelling, or a `skills.defaultDisabled` entry no identically spelled grant cancels. Workspace entries never refuse a user write; they keep gating only their own workspace. Batch enables recheck refused names until the batch converges, so the outcome does not depend on request order.

After a change, every registered workspace runtime is reconciled and each changed key emits `settings_changed` with `scope: "user"` and the existing `skill_toggle` mutation object on every workspace event stream. To make the change reach live sessions, `workspaceSkillsRefresh` gains an optional `settingsScopes` parameter: user writes ask the ACP child and its sessions to re-read the user file as well, while every other refresh keeps re-reading only the workspace file. The runtime coordinator keeps that user reload pending until a refresh carrying it succeeds.

The routes are advertised as `user_skill_activation`, with `DaemonClient.setUserSkillActivation` / `setUserSkillsActivation` in the TypeScript SDK and documentation in the serve protocol and capabilities docs.

## Why it's needed

The daemon could only toggle Skills in workspace settings. Hosts that manage Skills across workspaces (for example an embedding product that centrally enables or disables Skills for a user) had no API for the user settings file: the generic `/workspace/settings` route rejects `skills.*`, so they wrote `~/.qwen/settings.json` directly. That bypasses the daemon's settings lock (risking lost updates against other user-scope writers), duplicates the block/spelling rules, and never reaches running sessions, because the Skills refresh only re-read the workspace file. These routes give a supported, locked, consistently validated write path that also applies to live sessions.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start `qwen serve` and check `GET /capabilities` lists `user_skill_activation`.
2. `PUT /skills/<name>/activation` with `{"state":"disabled"}`: `~/.qwen/settings.json` gains `skills.disabled: ["<name>"]`; a live session's command list drops the Skill; every workspace stream receives `settings_changed` with `scope: "user"`.
3. Repeat with `{"state":"disabled","mode":"default"}`: the name moves to `skills.defaultDisabled`; a workspace `skills.enabled` entry with the same spelling re-enables it in that workspace only.
4. `{"state":"enabled"}`: the name moves to `skills.enabled`. Add `skills.disabled: ["<name>"]` to System settings and repeat: the response is `changed: false` with `block.scope: "System"` and the file is untouched.
5. Unit tests:
   - `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/config/skill-settings.test.ts src/serve/routes/workspace-skills.test.ts src/serve/workspace-runtime-coordinator.test.ts src/serve/run-qwen-serve.test.ts src/serve/capability-parity.test.ts`

N/A (daemon API; covered by the unit tests above).

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only (vitest) on macOS, Node 26.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a `hard` user disable cannot be lifted by any workspace, which is the existing meaning of a user `skills.disabled` entry; callers that want per-workspace opt-in use `mode: "default"`. Re-reading the user file in live sessions now happens only when a user Skill write requests it, so other user settings edited behind those sessions are picked up at the same time.
- Not validated / out of scope: no read route for user-scope Skill lists (reads stay workspace-scoped); `skills.disabledLevels` and `skills.directories` are not writable through these routes; no Managed Agent equivalent (recorded in the capability parity matrix).

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

新增两个 daemon 路由，用于在**用户级** settings（所有工作区都会合并的那一层）中启用或禁用 Skill：`PUT /skills/:name/activation` 和 `PUT /skills/activation`（批量，最多 100 个名字）。与 `PUT /extensions/activation` 一样，它们不带工作区选择器。请求体为 `{ state: "enabled" | "disabled", mode?: "hard" | "default" }`，`mode` 只对禁用生效。每次请求后该名字只会出现在一个用户级名单中：`hard` 禁用（默认）写入 `skills.disabled`，`default` 禁用写入 `skills.defaultDisabled`，启用写入 `skills.enabled`，并从另外两个名单中移除。

当合并后的配置仍会让该 Skill 保持禁用时，启用请求会被拒绝且不写文件，返回 `200`、`changed: false` 以及指明具体条目的 `block`：System/SystemDefaults 中任一拼写的 `skills.disabled` 条目、User 中另一种拼写的条目，或没有同拼写授权可以抵消的 `skills.defaultDisabled` 条目。工作区条目从不拒绝用户级写入，它们只继续约束各自的工作区。批量启用会对被拒绝的名字反复重查直到收敛，因此结果与请求顺序无关。

发生变更后，所有已注册的工作区 runtime 都会 reconcile，每个变更的 key 会在每个工作区的事件流上发出带 `scope: "user"` 和现有 `skill_toggle` mutation 对象的 `settings_changed`。为了让变更作用到运行中的会话，`workspaceSkillsRefresh` 新增可选参数 `settingsScopes`：用户级写入会要求 ACP 子进程及其会话同时重读用户级文件，其他刷新仍然只重读工作区文件。runtime coordinator 会一直保留这次用户级重读请求，直到某次携带它的刷新成功。

这些路由以 `user_skill_activation` 能力标签发布，TypeScript SDK 提供 `DaemonClient.setUserSkillActivation` / `setUserSkillsActivation`，并更新了 serve 协议文档与 capabilities 文档。

## 为什么需要

此前 daemon 只能在工作区 settings 中切换 Skill。需要跨工作区管理 Skill 的宿主（例如为用户统一启停 Skill 的嵌入式产品）没有操作用户级 settings 文件的 API：通用的 `/workspace/settings` 路由会拒绝 `skills.*`，于是它们只能直接写 `~/.qwen/settings.json`。这样绕过了 daemon 的 settings 锁（可能与其他用户级写入互相覆盖），重复实现了锁定与拼写规则，而且永远不会作用到运行中的会话，因为 Skill 刷新只重读工作区文件。这两个路由提供了受支持、加锁、校验一致，并且能作用到运行中会话的写入路径。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 启动 `qwen serve`，确认 `GET /capabilities` 包含 `user_skill_activation`。
2. 对 `PUT /skills/<name>/activation` 发送 `{"state":"disabled"}`：`~/.qwen/settings.json` 中出现 `skills.disabled: ["<name>"]`；运行中会话的命令列表不再包含该 Skill；每个工作区的事件流都收到 `scope: "user"` 的 `settings_changed`。
3. 改为发送 `{"state":"disabled","mode":"default"}`：该名字移到 `skills.defaultDisabled`；某个工作区中同拼写的 `skills.enabled` 条目只会在该工作区重新启用它。
4. 发送 `{"state":"enabled"}`：该名字移到 `skills.enabled`。在 System settings 中加入 `skills.disabled: ["<name>"]` 后重复：响应为 `changed: false` 且 `block.scope: "System"`，文件不变。
5. 单元测试：
   - `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/config/skill-settings.test.ts src/serve/routes/workspace-skills.test.ts src/serve/workspace-runtime-coordinator.test.ts src/serve/run-qwen-serve.test.ts src/serve/capability-parity.test.ts`
   - `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/acpAgent.test.ts -t skill`
   - `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/server.test.ts -t "serve capability registry"`
   - `cd packages/sdk-typescript && npx vitest run test/unit/DaemonClient.test.ts`

本地以上全部通过，`packages/cli` 与 `packages/sdk-typescript` 的 `tsc --noEmit`、eslint、prettier 也通过。完整运行 `src/serve/server.test.ts` 时，在负载下每次会出现一到两条不同的无关失败；在未修改的 `origin/main` 上同样如此。

N/A（daemon API，由上述单元测试覆盖）。

|     系统     | 状态 |
| :----------: | :--: |
|   🍏 macOS   |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows  |  ⚠️  |
|   🐧 Linux   |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

仅在 macOS、Node 26 上运行单元测试（vitest）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：`hard` 用户级禁用无法被任何工作区解除，这本就是用户级 `skills.disabled` 条目的既有含义；需要按工作区单独开启的调用方应使用 `mode: "default"`。运行中会话重读用户级文件只在用户级 Skill 写入请求时发生，因此在这些会话背后编辑的其他用户级设置也会同时生效。

prs.title: test(core,cli): stop flat 30s budgets shadowing the raised ECS timeout ceiling
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Three test suites set a flat per-file / per-describe `vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 30000, hookTimeout: 30000 })`. Both vitest configs raise `testTimeout`/`hookTimeout` to 60s on the shared `ecs-qwen-*` pool and fall back to 15s elsewhere (`packages/core/vitest.config.ts`, `packages/cli/vitest.config.ts`), so a flat clamp overrides the config unconditionally: on the pool the raised 60s ceiling never takes effect and a slow-but-healthy run is killed at 30s.

Each clamp is reshaped to the repo's existing `isSlowTestHost() ? <slow> : <fast>` idiom rather than deleted:

- `packages/core/src/tools/exit-worktree.test.ts` — describe-scoped flat 30s clamp becomes `isSlowTestHost() ? 60_000 : 30_000`.
- `packages/core/src/config/config-session-env.test.ts` — file-level flat `30_000` clamp becomes the same conditional.
- `packages/cli/src/serve/server-default-bridge-wiring.test.ts` — the file-level clamp already used the idiom but with a 15s fast arm, and a describe-scoped 30s clamp shadowed it. The fast arm is raised to 30s and the shadowing clamp is removed together with its now-orphaned comment, leaving the file-level `setConfig` as the single source of truth.

The reshape is deliberately **not** monotone in one direction on purpose: off-pool stays at 30s (never dropping to the config's 15s floor), and the ECS pool rises 30s -> 60s.

Bare-deleting a flat 30s clamp would have been a regression — it would lower the off-pool budget from 30s to the config's 15s floor, which fork PRs and the macOS/Windows runners all hit. In-tree precedent for the shape used here: `packages/cli/src/serve/live/run-qwen-serve-live.test.ts` and `packages/cli/src/serve/paired-engine-host-wiring.test.ts`, both `const timeoutMs = isSlowTestHost() ? 60_000 : 30_000;`.

## Why it's needed

Deferred review findings from #10922 (originally raised on #10858). A flat clamp silently defeats the slow-host budget the rest of the repo depends on, so the shared pool flakes on tests that are slow but healthy, and the failure reads like a hang.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

This is test-budget configuration only — no runtime code changes. To confirm:

1. `git grep -n "testTimeout: 30000" packages/core/src packages/cli/src` no longer matches the three files touched here.
2. In each of the three files the effective budget is `isSlowTestHost() ? 60_000 : 30_000`, i.e. off-pool is unchanged at 30s and the `ecs-qwen-*` pool gets the 60s ceiling the shared configs already declare.
3. In `server-default-bridge-wiring.test.ts` there is now exactly one `vi.setConfig` (file level) and the describe-scoped one that shadowed it is gone along with its comment — no comment describing a clamp that no longer exists.
4. `isSlowTestHost` is exported from both `packages/core/src/test-utils/slow-test-host.ts` and `packages/cli/src/test-utils/slow-test-host.ts`; the two core files import the core copy via `../test-utils/slow-test-host.js`, the same specifier already used by `packages/core/src/config/managed-session-log.test.ts`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-user-visible (test configuration only).

Local checks that ran (exit codes preserved):

- `prettier --check` on the 3 changed files: exit 0 ("All matched files use Prettier code style!").
- `eslint` on the 3 changed files: exit 0, no findings.
- Pre-commit hook ran `prettier --write` + `eslint --fix --max-warnings 0` over the staged files: completed clean.
- Freshness gate against `origin/main`: `status=fresh`, baseHead `73a303c158`, localHead `045e94ec79`.

Checks that did **not** run, disclosed as-is:

- `packages/core` typecheck: **not completed — the `tsc --noEmit` process was OOM-killed (exit 137 / SIGKILL)** at `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=2800` on the machine this was prepared on (MemAvailable ~2.7GB, SwapFree 0). It reported zero `error TS` lines only because it was killed, not because it finished. Please treat core typecheck as unverified locally and rely on CI. As partial mitigation the import specifiers were verified structurally rather than by compiler: `packages/core/src/test-utils/slow-test-host.ts` exists and exports `isSlowTestHost`, `packages/core/src/config/managed-session-log.test.ts` already uses the byte-identical specifier from the same directory, `packages/core/src/tools/*.test.ts` already use the `../test-utils/*.js` shape from the same depth, and `packages/core/tsconfig.json` includes `src/**/*.ts`.
- `packages/cli` typecheck: **not executed** (known not to complete on this host at 2800MB or 4096MB).
- vitest for the 3 affected suites: **not executed.** `packages/core/dist` is absent because the `prepare` build was itself OOM-killed (SIGKILL) during `pnpm install`, and vitest cannot start without it.

So the only executed evidence for these three files is prettier + eslint. CI is the authoritative gate here.

### Scope: findings from #10922 deliberately NOT addressed

This PR covers 3 of the 8 findings. The remaining 5 are intentionally left out:

- `ic:5534512734-app-container` — `packages/cli/src/ui/AppContainer.test.tsx` has multiple live open second writers; touching it would collide.
- `ic:5533110347-qwen-triage-workflow-budgets` — `scripts/tests/qwen-triage-workflow.test.js` is written by open PR #13954.
- `ic:5533110347-upload-aliyun-oss-budgets` — the thread records that whether 30s is a deliberate bound for `scripts/tests/upload-aliyun-oss-assets.test.js` needs the author's call, not an agent's.
- `ic:5528481103-per-test-budgets-invisible-to-guard` — the guard file is written by open PR #14665; a tree-wide guard would also go red on out-of-scope callsites.
- `ic:5553001699-repo-wide-census` — unbounded repo-wide acceptance criteria; belongs in its own PR.

Because this addresses only part of the issue, the reference below uses `Refs` and not a closing keyword.

Note for reviewers: open PR #15227 ("fix(cli): honor slow-host timeout for command budget test") addresses the same defect class but touches only `packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-session-command-session.test.ts`, so there is no file-level overlap with this PR.

Refs #10922

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️ not tested   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️ not tested   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️ prettier + eslint only; typecheck and vitest not executed (see above)   |

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff**: the per-test budgets change `vi.setConfig({ testTimeout, hookTimeout })` semantics; these are declarative so nothing improbable, but any local or infra variance in test duration that was silently exceeding 30s will now fail at the pool's 60s instead of dying silently at 30s — that is the intended signal, and it accurately surfaces a regression rather than masking one.
- **Not validated / out of scope**: `packages/core` `tsc --noEmit` was OOM-killed locally (SIGKILL exit 137) so it is unverified on this host; `packages/cli` typecheck was not executed; vitest for the 3 affected suites was not executed because `packages/core/dist` is also absent at this workstation. prettier + eslint on the changed suites passed. CI is the authoritative gate.
- **Breaking changes**: none — the changes assert the existing contract more faithfully by reshaping the clamp to the same `isSlowTestHost() ? slow : fast` idiom the vitest configs now use.
- The scope discussion under `### Scope: findings from #10922 deliberately NOT addressed` in the Reviewer Test Plan and the local verification disclosure under `### Evidence (Before & After)` are deliberately kept there, and their summary is restated here so the template `## Risk & Scope` asks for them.

## Linked Issues

Refs [#10922](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/10922) — covers 3 of the 8 findings under that issue. The remaining 5 are: `ic:5534512734-app-container` (open second writer in `AppContainer.test.tsx`), `ic:5533110347-qwen-triage-workflow-budgets` (`scripts/tests/qwen-triage-workflow.test.js` written by open PR #13954), `ic:5533110347-upload-aliyun-oss-budgets` (needs the author's call on whether 30s is a deliberate bound), `ic:5528481103-per-test-budgets-invisible-to-guard` (guard file written by open PR #14665), and `ic:5553001699-repo-wide-census` (belongs in its own PR).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

三份测试套件给每文件/每 describe 写死 30 秒的 vi.setConfig，但 vitest 自身配置在共享 `ecs-qwen-*` 池上已把 `testTimeout`/`hookTimeout` 提到 60s（离开池时为 15s），因此写死的 30s 会无条件覆盖配置：健康且稍慢的测试在池上 30s 就被杀死。

修复方式是把三处 clamp 改为仓库现有的 `isSlowTestHost() ? <slow> : <fast>` 形态，而不是直接删除：

- `packages/core/src/tools/exit-worktree.test.ts` — describe 级 `30_000` → `isSlowTestHost() ? 60_000 : 30_000`
- `packages/core/src/config/config-session-env.test.ts` — 文件级 `30_000` → 同上
- `packages/cli/src/serve/server-default-bridge-wiring.test.ts` — 文件级 `30_000` → 同上

这些改动只改断言超时的表达，不修改被测行为。

**本地验证范围**：prettier + eslint 通过；`packages/core` typecheck 因本地 OOM 被 kill，未能完成；packages/cli typecheck 未执行；vitest 因本次工作台未能构建 `packages/core/dist` 未能执行，等 CI 验证。

**覆盖范围**：本 PR 处理 #10922 中的 8 个发现里的 3 个。其余 5 个有意未处理：`AppContainer.test.tsx` 有活的第二写手；`scripts/tests/qwen-triage-workflow.test.js` 被 open PR #13954 持有；`upload-aliyun-oss-assets.test.js` 的 30s 是否为有意边界需作者定夺；`scripts/tests/per-test-budget guard` 被 PR #14665 持有；repo-wide 普查需要单独 PR。

另注：open PR #15227 处理同类缺陷但文件与本 PR 无交叠。
</details>

prs.title: fix(memory): report omitted index entries at write time
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Report index-budget omissions and scan-cap topic-file omissions separately, with bounded name samples, and preserve the saved writer warning when loading a bounded, known trailing notice into the prompt. Character pressure among otherwise legal entries names cumulative entry length and offers durable description/name/path edits alongside merging or removal. The save instructions keep new pointers above a trailing warning.

## Why it's needed

Index rebuilding can omit memories without telling the next session which files are missing. The two omission counts have different meanings: one grouped team entry can represent several files. A character limit can also bind below the entry-count cap: 170 legal entries fill 25,669 units, while shortening their descriptions can preserve all 170. Calling that state only “too many entries” can send the maintenance agent toward unnecessary removal.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Rebuild stores exceeding the scan cap, the entry-body budget, and both. Check each count and name sample independently, preserving retained entry order and topic files.
- Rebuild 170 topics with ordinary 150-unit entries. The writer warning should identify cumulative character pressure and offer durable description edits. Shortening descriptions should allow all 170 to remain indexed.
- Check pure line-count overflow, genuinely overlong links, bounded hostile names, native/import ordering, and project/user/team stores.
- Load the generated warning as the last paragraph, then insert a pointer above its blank separator. Preserve the bounded writer warning; arbitrary long or multiline warning-like text should still consume the ordinary entry budget.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Current head: `fe9439ffb09161e86ef67327d4c6afa60d586e57`, containing required upstream gate `e24f9c48fd333fceeb69883434045a47574ed496` through a normal merge. This update changes integration history, not the reviewed writer/scanner implementation.

The recorded writer control retains 165/170 entries under the original pressure. Description-only edits retain 170/170 without a warning. Its regression fails when the diagnosis is reverted; the prior mutation evidence remains tied to the earlier recorded head.

Fresh current-head root build, bundle, complete typecheck, ESLint over seven changed TypeScript paths, Prettier over all ten PR paths, nine gate-freshness tests, and 44 lint-scope tests pass. The full Linux memory run reports **1,162 passed, two skipped, and one cold-scan performance failure**: 210.0 ms against the unchanged 100 ms ceiling. This is not a green suite. A separate native Windows control reproduces the same assertion on clean gate-source `e24f9c48fd` at 182.5 ms, with its own rebuilt core and unchanged test/configuration/dependencies; it is not a full-root baseline build and does not clear the performance gate or identify its sole cause.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Not tested locally for this update |
| Windows | No full current-writer run; the separate upstream cold-scan control fails as described above |
| Linux | Fresh build/bundle/typecheck, scoped style and helper checks pass; complete memory run retains the one performance failure above |

### Environment

Node 22.21.1, frozen pnpm dependencies, isolated Linux checkout, 6 GiB build/typecheck heap. Performance limits, retries and CI/runner markers were not relaxed.

## Risk & Scope

- Reader Criticals R2-2 and R3-2 remain delegated to #15368. Landing order is the reader first; I will resync this branch after it lands. This branch is not claimed independently clear of those reader findings.
- Remaining Suggestion-level work stays deferred after round five, including separator/sibling save-instruction precision, the candidate-window mutation fixture, orphan scan helpers, and the earlier recorded classifier/notice/census follow-ups.
- Full repository/Harness and live-provider/TUI tests were not rerun. Current upstream CI is still required; the local cold-scan threshold is unresolved.
- No migration or settings change. Design: [English](https://github.com/jabrailkhalil/qwen-code/blob/fe9439ffb09161e86ef67327d4c6afa60d586e57/docs/design/memory-index-omission-notice.md), [中文](https://github.com/jabrailkhalil/qwen-code/blob/fe9439ffb09161e86ef67327d4c6afa60d586e57/docs/design/memory-index-omission-notice.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Related to #14834 and companion #15368.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

分别报告索引预算省略和扫描文件上限省略，并提供有界名称样本；读取提示时保留已保存且符合有界尾部格式的写入警告。普通长度条目造成的字符压力会被解释为累计条目长度，并提供持久的描述、名称、路径修改以及合并或移除方式。保存指令要求将新指针插在尾部警告之前。

## 为什么需要

索引重建可能省略内存，却没有告诉下次会话哪些文件缺失。两类省略数量含义不同：一个分组团队条目可能代表多个文件。字符限制也可能在未超过条目数上限时生效：170 条合法条目占 25,669 单位，而缩短描述可能保留全部 170 条。仅将这种情况称为“条目过多”可能引导维护代理进行不必要的移除。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

- 重建超过扫描上限、条目正文预算及同时超过两者的存储。分别核对数量和名称样本，保留条目顺序与主题文件。
- 重建含 170 个主题且每条为普通 150 单位条目的存储。写入警告应指出累计字符压力并提供持久的描述修改方式。缩短描述应使全部 170 条保留在索引中。
- 检查仅行数溢出、真正的超长链接、有界恶意名称、原生/导入顺序及项目、用户、团队存储。
- 将生成警告作为最后一段加载，然后在其空行分隔符上方插入指针。保留有界写入警告；任意超长或多行的类似警告文本仍应消耗普通条目预算。

### 前后对比证据

当前提交：`fe9439ffb09161e86ef67327d4c6afa60d586e57`，通过普通合并包含所需的上游门槛 `e24f9c48fd333fceeb69883434045a47574ed496`。此次更新改变集成历史，不改变已审阅的写入端和扫描器实现。

已记录的写入端对照在原始压力下保留 165/170 条目。仅修改描述可保留 170/170 且没有警告。恢复原来的诊断会使回归失败；此前变异证据仍对应先前记录的提交。

prs.title: fix(web-shell): standardize workspace and session display copy
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Aligns the selected sidebar, shared session-creation, workspace overview, dialog and Memory scope labels to use **Workspace / 工作区** and **Session / 会话**: the sidebar's Project heading becomes Workspaces, ordinary New task actions become New session, and the workspace Memory scope uses the same noun. Existing add/rename/remove dialog copy and session-creation errors are aligned in English and Chinese.

Executable production changes are limited to values of existing translation keys; public JSDoc comments are also synchronized with the visible labels. Existing tests only update their displayed-text selectors/expectations, and the adapter documentation records the terminology. No identifiers, translation keys, component structure, APIs, storage, or runtime logic are renamed or refactored.

This is a scoped copy pass, not a product-wide terminology migration. Existing Managed-page and registration copy, the session-source Tasks tab, execution/offline hints and other feature scope labels retain their current wording. Label-derived accessible names and dialog DOM attribute values carry the new text; automation matching old labels must update its selectors.

## Why it's needed

The sidebar currently calls the same directory-backed object Project in its heading and Workspace in its actions, while ordinary conversation creation says New task. This implements the final Workspace/Session vocabulary recorded in #14988 with a small copy-only change.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- In English and Chinese, confirm the sidebar says Workspaces / 工作区 and the top, workspace-row/menu, worktree, and workspace-overview actions use New session / 新建会话 terminology. Their existing destinations and callbacks should behave as before.
- Check the existing add, rename, and remove dialogs and the workspace Memory label/description. The legacy add-dialog submit label becomes Add workspace / 添加工作区; the folder-browser flow still uses its existing Add this folder action.
- Confirm No-workspace sessions / 无工作区会话 stays named and placed as before, and Scheduled Tasks / 定时任务 retains its domain name.

Validation after syncing main: repository build and typecheck, changed-file formatting and ESLint passed. All 2,020 targeted unit tests passed across 16 files. Of 90 targeted Chromium E2E tests, 89 passed on the first run; the remaining workspace-menu test also failed on unmodified main because its text expectation omitted the existing Move up action. After synchronizing the existing Move up / Move down text expectations, its focused rerun passed. Only display strings, existing test text expectations, and terminology documentation differ from main; identifiers, translation keys, and production logic remain unchanged.

Full preflight was executed but is not green: the CLI suite reported 44,988 passing and 33 failing tests across 13 files (mostly timeouts, connection/cleanup failures, plus assertions). CLI and Core have no diff from main. The two model-configuration message assertions were separately reproduced on unmodified main cdd5f1e with the same expected/actual result. The other failures have not all been individually baseline-reproduced. The completed run also reported failures in Core, qwen-live and external-context, all outside this PR’s diff; those have not been individually baseline-reproduced. No full-preflight pass is claimed. The previously reviewed head passed all executed GitHub validation checks; the new main-sync head is being revalidated.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Real captures from the same isolated source checkout and local daemon, not mockups:

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![Project and New task](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deggs7/qwen-code/97c2b8cde8dcf0edba1e74ca03b9c66c0a7afb08/sidebar-terminology/pr-evidence/before-en.png) | ![Workspaces and New session](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deggs7/qwen-code/97c2b8cde8dcf0edba1e74ca03b9c66c0a7afb08/sidebar-terminology/pr-evidence/after-en.png) |

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | ✅ Browser verification and local automated checks |
| Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| Linux | ⚠️ Not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Isolated checkout based on main `32b4234b849c`, Vite Web Shell on loopback port 5175 connected to the existing local daemon. Browser checks opened existing UI surfaces without submitting a prompt, registering a workspace, or deleting data.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: consumers selecting controls by their displayed text must use the updated wording; translation keys and public identifiers remain compatible.
- Not validated / out of scope: changing the name or placement of the no-workspace group is tracked separately in #15309. The Recent feature from #14904 is now on main; this PR changes only its existing heading values from Recent sessions / 最近会话 to Recent / 最近. Its creation action inherits New session / 新建会话 from the existing shared key. No Recent implementation is added or refactored. A broad Managed/Agent/Skills/Workflow terminology audit is outside this focused change.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no configuration/API/storage migration; no behavior changes.

## Linked Issues

Related to #14988. The Recent-heading item is now included because #14904 has landed. The no-workspace naming and placement follow-up remains separate in #15309.

Separate follow-up: #15309.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

对齐指定 Web Shell 界面的文案为**工作区 / Workspace、会话 / Session**：侧栏“项目”改为“工作区”，普通聊天的“新建任务”改为“新建会话”，工作区 Memory 作用域采用同一术语。同步调整中英文已有添加、重命名、移除弹窗文案及会话创建错误提示。

生产可执行代码仅修改已有翻译键的值，另同步公开 JSDoc 注释中的界面名称。现有测试只同步文案选择器及预期字符串，适配器文档记录术语。没有重命名或重构标识符、翻译键、组件结构、API、存储或运行逻辑。

## 为什么需要

当前侧栏标题使用 Project，操作却使用 Workspace，普通聊天创建入口又使用 Task。本 PR 用最小文案修改落实 #14988 记录的最终“工作区 / 会话”方案。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 中英文确认侧栏显示 Workspaces / 工作区，顶部、工作区行/菜单、Worktree 和工作区总览的普通聊天创建入口使用 New session / 新建会话。原有目的地和回调行为保持一致。

同步主分支后的验证：仓库构建、类型检查、改动文件的格式检查和 ESLint 均通过。16 个文件的 2,020 项定向单元测试全部通过。90 项 Chromium 定向 E2E 首轮通过 89 项；剩余菜单测试在未修改的主分支上同样失败，原因是文字预期遗漏已有的“上移”菜单。同步已有“上移 / 下移”预期后，单独复测通过。相对主分支只改显示字符串、现有测试文字预期和术语文档，变量名、翻译键及生产逻辑保持不变。

已执行完整 preflight，但不能报告通过：CLI 测试有 44,988 项通过、33 项失败，涉及 13 个文件，主要是超时、连接及清理失败，另有少数断言失败。CLI 与 Core 相对主分支完全无差异。两项模型配置提示断言已在未修改的主分支 cdd5f1e 单独复现，预期与实际结果完全相同；其余失败尚未逐项做基线复现。完整运行另有 Core、qwen-live 和 external-context 包失败，均不在本 PR 改动范围内，尚未逐项做基线复现。不声称完整 preflight 通过。前一受审提交的 GitHub 验证检查均已通过；本轮同步主分支后的提交正在重新验证。

### 证据（修改前后）

上面的两张图来自同一个隔离源码检出和本地 daemon 的真实浏览器页面，不是模拟图。

### 测试平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | ✅ 浏览器验证及本地自动检查 |
| Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| Linux | ⚠️ 未测试 |

### 环境

基于 main `32b4234b849c` 的隔离检出，Vite Web Shell 使用本机回环端口 5175 并连接现有本地 daemon。浏览器检查只打开已有界面，没有提交提示词、注册工作区或删除数据。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：依赖显示文字定位控件的消费者需要采用新文案；翻译键及公开标识符保持兼容。
- 范围外：“无工作区会话”的候选名称和同级展示单独跟进 #15309。#14904 的最近分区现已合入 main，本 PR 仅将其既有标题翻译值从“Recent sessions / 最近会话”改为“Recent / 最近”；新建按钮通过既有共享翻译键显示“New session / 新建会话”，不增加或重构最近功能。全面的托管/Agent/Skills/Workflow 术语审计不在此次范围内。
- 无配置、API 或存储迁移，无行为变更。

Related to #14988。由于 #14904 已合入，本 PR 现包含最近标题文案；无工作区会话的名称与层级继续独立跟进 #15309。
