prs.title: fix(web-shell): pause requests offline and recover automatically
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Unifies Web Shell's native HTTP calls through the SDK and adds shared availability control for each active service connection. After a transport failure, business requests and reconnect loops pause while one bounded recovery probe runs. Successful health and authenticated capability checks automatically resume reads and session attachment.

The UI shows a localized connection warning with Retry, including fullscreen and modal artifact views. Cached reads and unsent drafts survive disconnection; terminal and local-file connections wait for recovery. Prompt submissions, uploads and other writes are not replayed automatically. User-facing connection messages use “service / 服务”.

<!-- review-fixes-84c64bf0cc -->
### Review fixes and latest UI evidence (`84c64bf0cc`)

Recovery now preserves the result of an already-issued settings update, expires cached live activity after 90 seconds offline without business requests, and keeps cold diagnostics, session lists and Managed views informative. Local host-handled commands remain usable; voice errors retain their localized service-unavailable reason. No write is replayed. Latest `origin/main` (`32b4234b84`) is merged; the only manual conflict joined two independently added regression tests, preserving both.

Full local build, typecheck (8 GiB Node heap) and CLI bundle passed, together with all **13,224 Web Shell tests across 492 files**, **81 export tests**, changed-file lint/format and **4 SDK request tests**. The fixed commit passed **10 selected Chromium checks** using the actual App and Managed provider with **mock HTTP/SSE backends**. Screenshots were visually checked. Diagnostic recovery used **manual Retry**; the narrow Managed case used a controlled DOM click on the actual button behind the artifact modal, verifying rendering conditions rather than ordinary pointer navigation. This round does not verify a real service restart, model, Java backend or Git operation. There were zero JavaScript errors; six expected mock resource errors are recorded. New-head remote CI is pending; older evidence below belongs to its stated commits.

| Cold offline diagnostics: reason and repair form | Managed view: warning remains after drawer hides |
| --- | --- |
| ![Actual App cold diagnostics with mock service offline](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/5cdd000a24733849aceee8de8e7fdc19242fc5ff/daemon-recovery/latest-main-merge/diagnostic-cold-offline-mock.png) | ![Actual narrow Managed App with service warning, mocked backends](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/5cdd000a24733849aceee8de8e7fdc19242fc5ff/daemon-recovery/latest-main-merge/managed-narrow-offline-banner-mock.png) |

[After manual recovery](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/5cdd000a24733849aceee8de8e7fdc19242fc5ff/daemon-recovery/latest-main-merge/diagnostic-recovered-mock.png) · [Checks and screenshot hashes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/5cdd000a24733849aceee8de8e7fdc19242fc5ff/daemon-recovery/latest-main-merge/verification.json) · [Bilingual scope notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/5cdd000a24733849aceee8de8e7fdc19242fc5ff/daemon-recovery/latest-main-merge/README.md)

<details>
<summary>中文：本轮修复与最新界面证据</summary>

恢复连接后保留已发出设置写入的结果；持续离线 90 秒后在本地使实时活动状态失效，不增加业务请求；首次打开诊断页、会话列表和 Managed 视图仍显示明确提示。本地宿主命令保持可用，语音保留本地化的服务不可用原因，写操作绝不重放。已合入最新 `origin/main`（`32b4234b84`）；唯一人工冲突是两边在同处新增测试，均已保留。

完整构建、类型检查（Node 堆上限 8 GiB）、CLI 打包、492 个文件中的 **13,224 项 Web Shell 测试**、**81 项导出测试**、变更文件静态检查，以及 **4 项 SDK 请求测试**均通过。固定提交上的真实 App 和 Managed Provider 通过 **10 项 Chromium 检查**，HTTP/SSE 后端为模拟，截图已目视检查。诊断恢复使用**手动重试**；窄屏 Managed 使用实际按钮的受控 DOM 点击，按钮当时被 artifact 模态层遮挡，仅证明显示条件，不声称普通指针可穿过遮挡导航。本轮不代表验证真实服务重启、模型、Java 后端或 Git 操作。JavaScript 错误为零，6 条预期 mock 资源错误已如实记录。新提交远端 CI 待出；下方旧证据保留各自提交归属。

[离线诊断](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/5cdd000a24733849aceee8de8e7fdc19242fc5ff/daemon-recovery/latest-main-merge/diagnostic-cold-offline-mock.png) · [手动恢复](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/5cdd000a24733849aceee8de8e7fdc19242fc5ff/daemon-recovery/latest-main-merge/diagnostic-recovered-mock.png) · [窄屏 Managed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/5cdd000a24733849aceee8de8e7fdc19242fc5ff/daemon-recovery/latest-main-merge/managed-narrow-offline-banner-mock.png) · [检查记录](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/5cdd000a24733849aceee8de8e7fdc19242fc5ff/daemon-recovery/latest-main-merge/verification.json) · [双语范围说明](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/5cdd000a24733849aceee8de8e7fdc19242fc5ff/daemon-recovery/latest-main-merge/README.md)

</details>

## Why it's needed

A page waiting for its first prompt can keep showing a connected state after its service stops. Independent polling then continues to fail without an explanation in the UI and can distort business API success rates. A shared gate stops subsequent business traffic instead of merely slowing each poller independently.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open the welcome page without submitting a prompt, enter a draft and browse a workspace directory. Stop the service: a persistent connection warning should appear and the draft should remain.
2. Observe network traffic after in-flight requests settle: business calls should stop, leaving one shared health probe sequence with 5/15/30-second delays. Requests rejected locally should not become HTTP requests.
3. Restart at the same address and credential without reloading or clicking Retry. The warning should disappear, reads and directory browsing should resume, and the draft should remain editable. No prompt or write should be replayed.
4. Check authentication rejection and explicit Retry, caller cancellation/timeouts, old responses after recovery, provider unmounts, and fullscreen/modal warning visibility. Deterministic regression tests cover these boundaries; the browser run below covers one real no-session provider.

### Historical evidence (Before & After)

Historical built-UI evidence (`df78833`), real test-owned service, headless Chromium; screenshots show offline → automatic recovery on the same page. All 16 browser checks passed. Stop detection: 3.473s. Offline observation: 54.056s, zero business requests after banner detection. Probe gaps: 5.004/15.002/30.002s. Same-address restart recovered automatically in 25.944s. The preserved draft remained editable, and a new directory GET returned 200. No model prompt, write request or Git mutation was performed; there were no browser page errors.

| Before recovery: offline warning and retained draft | After automatic recovery: warning removed and draft retained |
| --- | --- |
| [Historical screenshot: Service offline, draft retained](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/92a3da81845a86e2db973dc11a406dc61bf259c8/daemon-recovery/offline-after-backoff.png) | [Historical screenshot: Service automatically recovered, draft retained](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/92a3da81845a86e2db973dc11a406dc61bf259c8/daemon-recovery/recovered-draft.png) |

[Actual directory browse after recovery](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/92a3da81845a86e2db973dc11a406dc61bf259c8/daemon-recovery/recovered-directory-and-editable-draft.png) · [Sanitized network timeline and assertions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/92a3da81845a86e2db973dc11a406dc61bf259c8/daemon-recovery/network-evidence.json) · [Bilingual evidence notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/92a3da81845a86e2db973dc11a406dc61bf259c8/daemon-recovery/README.md)

Initial-load Retry was separately verified in both workspace and standalone error pages: **16/16 checks passed** in the real built UI with Playwright injecting only initial capabilities502/health503 failures. Explicit Retry sent health then capabilities before the pending backoff; the error cleared, the editor was usable, and no write was sent. Normal App mounting also performed capabilities reads after recovery (2 total for workspace,3 for standalone). This is fault-injected evidence, separate from the real stop/restart run above.

[Workspace initial error](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/92a3da81845a86e2db973dc11a406dc61bf259c8/daemon-recovery/workspace-initial-error.png) → [after Retry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/92a3da81845a86e2db973dc11a406dc61bf259c8/daemon-recovery/workspace-retry-recovered.png) · [Standalone initial error](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/92a3da81845a86e2db973dc11a406dc61bf259c8/daemon-recovery/standalone-initial-error.png) → [after Retry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/92a3da81845a86e2db973dc11a406dc61bf259c8/daemon-recovery/standalone-retry-recovered.png)

Local verification after merging current origin/main: all 12,723 Web Shell tests and 4 SDK request tests passed. The original six CI failures were reproduced; an independent red/green check confirmed that the updated loading assertions fail against the old implementation (4 cases) and pass with the fix (13 boot/loading cases). Root build, bundle and typecheck, PR-file ESLint/formatting, nine lint-freshness helper tests and diff checks passed.

### Smoke regression verification (mocked service)

The remaining browser CI failure came from a shared mock returning invented health fields. One fixture line now matches the real service response, `{"status":"ok"}`; production code and test steps/assertions are unchanged. At `bfdaa131107e24eec64bd13a147b8e722bca7acb`, the four failures were reproduced, a one-response control isolated the mismatch, and the original formal cases passed. The complete original Smoke run recorded **345 passed /1 failed** across all three configured browser projects, workers4/retries0; all four original CI failures passed. The additional local failure is a narrow-pane title-hover timeout: isolated checks recorded4/5 passes with this fix and1/1 with the old health response. Its root cause is not established; the first full/isolated failures remain recorded and are not described as a clean run. No title logic, timeout or assertion was changed. ESLint, formatting and the current-main lint freshness gate passed.

These are actual final UI screenshots from formal Playwright cases using a **mocked service**. Context usage refreshes to15% while preserving the64% snapshot; committed503 deletion retains its reopen explanation; sidebar retry restores the selected session. Prompts/deletions are simulated, so these images do not verify a real model, persisted backend or Git operation. A temporary toast from an intentionally injected failure can remain. The earlier real stop/restart evidence is kept separately at its actual verified commit; production source is unchanged between that commit and this test-only follow-up.

| Usage refreshed to15% (mock) | Reopen explanation retained after committed503 (mock) |
| --- | --- |
| [Historical screenshot: Usage recovers after transient failure with mock service](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/aa60c6430d69afe6028268d57089446ad8907ad6/daemon-recovery/ci-smoke/context-compression-light-mock.png) | [Historical screenshot: Mock committed deletion preserves reopen explanation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/aa60c6430d69afe6028268d57089446ad8907ad6/daemon-recovery/ci-smoke/committed-503-reconciled-mock.png) |

[Dark context case](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/aa60c6430d69afe6028268d57089446ad8907ad6/daemon-recovery/ci-smoke/context-compression-dark-mock.png) · [Recovered sidebar session](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/aa60c6430d69afe6028268d57089446ad8907ad6/daemon-recovery/ci-smoke/sidebar-session-recovered-mock.png) · [Sanitized verification summary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/aa60c6430d69afe6028268d57089446ad8907ad6/daemon-recovery/ci-smoke/verification.json) · [Bilingual scope notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/aa60c6430d69afe6028268d57089446ad8907ad6/daemon-recovery/ci-smoke/README.md)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ arm64: package tests and real browser stop/restart |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 22.14.0, local 0.25.3 build, headless Chromium, isolated loopback service and temporary workspace/runtime. The test-owned processes and directories were cleaned up; existing development services were untouched. Browser evidence corresponds to `df78833baca69679b198c1a0412ebc52be048a5f`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: shared availability decisions affect every panel under the owning provider. Regression tests cover false outage classification, client ownership, stale responses, cancellation and cleanup. Separate providers retain independent recovery loops.
- Not validated / out of scope: real active-model/SSE restoration, multi-panel stop/restart, audio/LAN and OS integrations. Host success-rate filtering for probes still needs integration evidence; initial failed/in-flight requests and retries hidden inside host transports cannot be eliminated by this gate.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no server route or ownership changes. The SDK request entry is additive; older supported peer SDKs retain one native REST compatibility path. Recovery never resubmits writes.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-10-09-daemon-request-recovery.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-09-daemon-request-recovery.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized.

## Linked Issues

No linked GitHub issue.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

### 此 PR 的改动

将 Web Shell 的原生 HTTP 请求统一进入 SDK，并为每个活动服务连接增加共享可用性控制。传输失败后暂停业务请求与重连循环，仅保留一个有超时上限的恢复探针；健康检查和带认证的 capabilities 检查成功后，自动恢复读取与会话附着。

界面显示带重试入口的本地化连接提示，覆盖全屏和模态 artifact 视图。断连时保留读取缓存与未发送草稿，终端和本地文件连接等待共享恢复；不会自动重放 prompt、上传或其他写操作。面向用户的连接提示使用“服务 / service”。

### 为什么需要

等待首条 prompt 的页面可能在服务停止后仍显示已连接，各自独立的轮询随后持续失败，界面却没有说明，还可能拉低业务接口成功率。共享门禁直接阻止后续业务流量，而不是让每个轮询各自降频。

### 评审验证计划

1. 在欢迎页不提交 prompt，输入草稿并浏览 workspace 目录。停止服务后，应出现持续连接提示，并保留草稿。
2. 等待在途请求结束后观察网络：业务请求应停止，只剩一个共享健康探针，按5/15/30秒退避。本地拒绝的操作不应变成 HTTP 请求。
3. 同地址、同凭证重启，不刷新或点击重试。提示应自动消失，读取与目录浏览恢复，草稿仍可编辑；不能重放 prompt 或写操作。
4. 检查认证拒绝与手动重试、调用方取消/超时、恢复后的旧响应、Provider 卸载，以及全屏/模态提示可见性。确定性回归测试覆盖这些边界；下述浏览器验证覆盖一个真实、无会话的 Provider。

### 证据（恢复前后）

使用当前构建、独立真实服务和无头 Chromium；截图展示同一页面从离线到自动恢复。16项浏览器检查全部通过。停机后3.473秒发现断连；横幅出现后观察54.056秒，业务请求为0；探针实际间隔为5.004/15.002/30.002秒。同地址重启后25.944秒自动恢复。保留的草稿仍可编辑，新目录 GET 返回200。没有提交模型 prompt、发送写请求或执行 Git 写操作，也没有浏览器 pageerror。

| 恢复前：离线横幅与保留草稿 | 自动恢复后：横幅消失，草稿保留 |

prs.title: fix(cli): carry branch points through the session load replay
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When a session is restored from disk, for example after `qwen serve` restarts, the load replay now stamps each assistant answer with its persisted branch checkpoint, the same decoration the paged transcript path already applies. Web Shell keys the Branch action off that marker, so a reopened session offers Branch on every answer that has a valid checkpoint, exactly as it did while the turn was live.

The transcript reader already indexes branch checkpoints; the restore projection just never forwarded them to the replay layer. The change plumbs them through for both the cold load and the live restore, and both replay entry points now share one stamping helper instead of only the paged path having it.

## Why it's needed

After a daemon restart, hovering any earlier answer in a restored Web Shell session shows only Copy, and no answer in the session offers Branch, even though the checkpoints on disk are still valid and branching through the RPC works. Restored sessions look read-only for no reason. #13782 has the full measurements, including that the transcript endpoint and the branch RPC both stay correct; only the load replay drops the marker.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Unit level: the new reader test asserts both restore projections (cold and live) advertise the checkpoint of an assistant record on their replay page, and the new replay tests assert the load replay stamps the checkpoint onto the answer's final visible chunk and leaves updates untouched when no branch points are passed in. The existing paged-replay tests keep pinning the stamping semantics (last visible chunk only, own-property lookup against untrusted record ids), now against the shared helper.

Real stack, the scenario from the issue: run `qwen serve`, open the Web Shell, send a prompt, wait for the answer, hover it: Branch shows. Restart `qwen serve`, reopen the same session from the sidebar, hover the same answer: Branch shows again. Before this change it did not.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A: no UI change on this side of the stack; the fix restores metadata the Web Shell client already keys on (`MessageList` shows Branch when the marker is present), and its smoke test already assumes restored replays carry it.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅    |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️    |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️    |

Unit tests, typecheck and build on macOS arm64; Windows and Linux via CI.

### Environment (optional)

N/A

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none identified. The field is additive and optional end to end, and the stamping helper is verbatim the code the paged path already ran.
- Not validated / out of scope: the ungated read-only history dump (`qwen/session/loadUpdates`) reads through the session service rather than the transcript index, so it has no branch points to forward and is untouched; rewind at head operates on the live session and does not re-replay from disk.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Closes #13782

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的内容

会话从磁盘恢复后（例如 `qwen serve` 重启再打开），load 回放现在会把每个助手回答对应的已持久化分支检查点标上去，和分页 transcript 路径已有的处理保持一致。Web Shell 正是依据这个标记来显示「分叉」按钮的，所以重新打开的会话里，凡是有有效检查点的回答都会重新提供分叉入口，和回合实时进行时完全一样。

transcript 读取层本来就索引了分支检查点，只是恢复投影从未把它们转发给回放层。本次修改把冷加载和热恢复两条路径都接通，并且两个回放入口现在共用一个打戳 helper，不再只有分页路径有这段逻辑。

## 为什么需要

daemon 重启之后，在恢复出来的 Web Shell 会话里把鼠标悬停到任意一条历史回答上，只会显示「复制」，整个会话没有任何回答提供「分叉」，尽管磁盘上的检查点仍然有效、通过 RPC 分叉也正常。恢复出来的会话无缘无故变得像只读一样。#13782 里有完整实测：transcript 接口和分叉 RPC 都是对的，只有 load 回放丢了标记。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

单测层面：新增的 reader 测试断言冷、热两个恢复投影都会在回放页上公布助手记录对应的检查点；新增的回放测试断言 load 回放会把检查点打到回答最后一个可见分块上，并且在没有传入分支点时不做任何改动。既有分页回放测试继续钉住打戳语义（只打最后一个可见分块、对不可信记录 id 做自有属性判断），只是现在跑的是共用 helper。

真实环境，按 issue 里的场景：跑 `qwen serve`，打开 Web Shell，发一条消息等回答，悬停：能看到「分叉」。重启 `qwen serve`，从侧栏重新打开同一会话，悬停同一条回答：「分叉」重新出现。在本 PR 之前它是消失的。

### 前后对比证据

N/A：这一侧没有 UI 改动；修复只是把 Web Shell 客户端本来就依赖的元数据补回去（`MessageList` 在标记存在时显示分叉），它的冒烟测试本来就假定恢复回放携带该标记。

### 已验证平台

macOS arm64 上跑了单测、typecheck 和构建；Windows 和 Linux 走 CI。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：未识别到。该字段端到端都是新增且可选的，打戳 helper 就是分页路径原本在跑的那段代码。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：非门控的只读历史导出（`qwen/session/loadUpdates`）走的是 session service 而不是 transcript 索引，没有分支点可转发，保持原样；rewind 在当前 head 上作用于存活会话，不会从磁盘重新回放。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): split shell commands on bash's separators, not JavaScript whitespace
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Bash's lexer discards exactly space, tab and newline when it decides word boundaries; JavaScript's `/\s/` matches `\r`, `\v`, `\f`, `\u00a0` and the rest of Unicode whitespace, every one of which bash treats as an ordinary word character. The shell command splitter used `/\s/` in its backward scan for the character before an `&` or `|`, so `echo x >\r& rm -rf /tmp/x` read the `\r` as spacing and kept both commands in one segment — the `rm` never reached the command roots that the shell tool's permission checks and git attribution read.

This change treats only space, tab and newline as separators, moves the predicate into a small leaf module shared by the splitter and the permission rule parser (which carried its own copy of the constant), trims segments with the existing bash-aware helper so a redirection target made of `\r` or `\u00a0` survives, and switches the second `/\s/` scan in `hasNonFinalTopLevelBackgroundOperator` to the same predicate so `echo x >\r& y` is recognised as a redirect followed by a background operator instead of a `>&` dup-redirect.

## Why it's needed

`getCommandRoots` decides which sub-commands the shell tool asks about and what it reads for git attribution; a command missing there is invisible to both. `echo x >\r& rm -rf /tmp/x` is two commands to bash, but the splitter saw one, so the second command's root was never surfaced for confirmation. The background-operator check feeds the same misreading: with `\r` skipped as whitespace, `>\r&` looked like the `>&` redirect form and the operator was not reported.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

From the repo root, run `pnpm -C packages/core exec vitest run src/utils/shell-utils.test.ts src/permissions/rule-parser.test.ts`. On `main` the new cases fail — the trailing `rm` is absent from both `getCommandRoots` and `splitCommands`, and `hasNonFinalTopLevelBackgroundOperator('echo x >\r& rm -rf /tmp/x')` returns `false`; on this branch they pass and the existing CRLF cases stay green.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible surface; the tests are the evidence.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the predicate is deliberately narrower than `/\s/`, so any caller that relied on the splitter treating `\r` / `\v` / `\f` / `\u00a0` as whitespace now gets a split. That is the intended behaviour — bash splits there — and a narrower separator set can only add splits, never merge two commands into one.
- Not validated / out of scope: other packages that re-implement bash word splitting are untouched.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #12089.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

Bash 的词法分析在划分词边界时只丢弃空格、制表符和换行；JavaScript 的 `/\s/` 还会匹配 `\r`、`\v`、`\f`、`\u00a0` 等全部 Unicode 空白，而这些在 bash 里都是普通的词字符。命令切分器在回溯扫描 `&` 或 `|` 前一个字符时用了 `/\s/`，于是 `echo x >\r& rm -rf /tmp/x` 里的 `\r` 被当作空白，两条命令被并成一段——`rm` 从此没有进入 shell 工具权限检查与 git 归因所依赖的命令根列表。

本改动只把空格、制表符和换行视为分隔符；把该判定抽到一个叶子模块，供切分器与权限规则解析器共同复用（后者原本自带一份重复常量）；段的裁剪改用已有的 bash 感知辅助函数，使由 `\r` 或 `\u00a0` 构成的重定向目标不会被 `String.prototype.trim()` 吃掉；并把 `hasNonFinalTopLevelBackgroundOperator` 里第二处 `/\s/` 扫描也切到同一判定，使 `echo x >\r& y` 被识别为「重定向 + 后台操作符」，而不是 `>&` 的重复描述符重定向。

`getCommandRoots` 决定 shell 工具要询问哪些子命令、以及读取哪些内容做 git 归因；在那里消失的命令对二者都不可见。对 bash 而言 `echo x >\r& rm -rf /tmp/x` 是两条命令，但切分器只看到一条，于是第二条命令的根从未被提交确认。后台操作符判定受同一误读影响：`\r` 被当空白跳过后，`>\r&` 看起来就是 `>&` 重定向形式，操作符因此未被上报。

验证方式：在仓库根目录运行 `pnpm -C packages/core exec vitest run src/utils/shell-utils.test.ts src/permissions/rule-parser.test.ts`。在 `main` 上新增用例失败——`rm` 既不在 `getCommandRoots` 也不在 `splitCommands` 中，且 `hasNonFinalTopLevelBackgroundOperator('echo x >\r& rm -rf /tmp/x')` 返回 `false`；在本分支上它们通过，且原有 CRLF 用例保持绿色。

主要风险：该判定刻意比 `/\s/` 更窄，因此任何依赖切分器把 `\r` / `\v` / `\f` / `\u00a0` 当空白的调用方，现在会得到一次切分。这正是期望行为（bash 就在这里切分），且更窄的分隔符集合只会增加切分，绝不会把两条命令并成一条。

破坏性变更：无。

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): open inline rename on single click of a session title
prs.body:
## What this PR does

In the Web Shell, the session title shown at the top of the session window (the pane header) is display-only plain text: clicking it does nothing, and the only inline rename is a double-click on the session row in the left sidebar. This change makes the pane title its own click target: a single click on the title (or Enter when it is focused) opens an inline rename input in place of the title text — prefilled with the current name, auto-focused and selected; Enter saves the new name through the same session-scoped rename API the sidebar's double-click and the `/rename` command use (for standalone sessions, the workspace client's standalone rename), Escape or blur cancels, and an empty name simply closes the editor. Submitting the name unchanged (Enter without editing) also just closes the editor without any daemon write, so a no-op submission cannot persist the id-prefix placeholder on sessions without a displayName. The header input works in both the single-session view and split view — each pane's header renames that pane's session. A click that finishes a text selection on the title, a pane without a session, or a rename already in flight leaves the click inert. The title click is not stopped on its way to document, so already-open Radix surfaces (session details, context usage, branch picker) still receive the native click for deferred outside-press dismissal.

## Why it's needed

Issue #14327: the pane header is where the user identifies — and wants to act on — the session in front of them, but the title was display-only, so renaming required finding the session in the sidebar and a hard-to-discover double-click. Making the header title a direct entry point to rename matches the "click a title to edit it" affordance the issue asks for. Note: the issue was originally scoped to the sidebar; on 2026-10-17 the scope was clarified to the pane header, and this PR was reworked accordingly (the sidebar's double-click rename is unchanged). The branch was also rebased onto the then-current `main` tip (`f9de111a13`, 2026-10-20) so it applies on today's tree.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

I extended `packages/web-shell/client/components/ChatPane.test.tsx` with a 12-case suite (`ChatPane pane title single-click rename`) covering: single-click opens the inline rename input prefilled and focused; Enter saves the trimmed name and reconciles the session catalog; a split pane's title (supplied via the `title` prop) renames; standalone sessions save through the workspace client; Escape cancels without saving; blur cancels without saving; an empty name closes without saving; a click that follows a text selection does not open rename; the title is inert without a session id; a failed save is reported and the editor closes; a single title click dismisses an already-open Radix popover while starting the rename (real `@radix-ui` popover, deferred outside-press path); and submitting the name unchanged (Enter without editing) closes the editor without any daemon write. The same path is covered for the header component itself: `packages/web-shell/client/components/ChatContextHeader.test.tsx` gained a 7-case suite (`ChatContextHeader session title single-click rename`) — open/prefill/focus, Enter save with catalog reconcile, no-change bail, standalone save through the workspace client, Escape cancel, empty-name close, and inert titles (no session id, non-string content).

- Run the new tests: from the repo root, `pnpm install && pnpm --filter @qwen-code/web-shell exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts client/components/ChatPane.test.tsx client/components/ChatContextHeader.test.tsx` — ChatPane.test.tsx 192/192 and ChatContextHeader.test.tsx 25/25 (217/217, 0 failures; both numbers include the pre-existing cases in those files, including upstream's new `pane approval mode allowlist` cases).
- Post-rebase note: upstream's new `ManagedSessionsPage.test.tsx` shell-slot tests render the pane header, which imports the `useConnection`/`useActions` SDK hooks; the file gained mocks for those hooks (the rename UI is inert there — a managed session row has no session of its own).
- Manual check: start a daemon with the Web Shell (`node packages/cli/dist/index.js serve --workspace <dir>`), open the Web Shell, then: (1) single-click the session title in the header → the inline rename input appears prefilled with the current name; (2) type a new name and press Enter → the header (and the sidebar) show the new name; (3) single-click the title again and press Escape → the input closes, the name is unchanged; (4) in split view, single-click the second pane's title → its pane's session is renamed; (5) single-click the title, type nothing, press Enter → the input closes, the name is unchanged, and no rename request reaches the daemon (visible in the network tab).

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before (upstream behavior): the pane header title was display-only; renaming required a double-click on the session row in the sidebar (see issue #14327).

After: a single click on the pane title opens the inline rename input prefilled with the current name; saving updates the header and the sidebar in the same run. The live end-to-end run (real Chrome against a daemon built from this branch, steps S0–S5) is described under "Tested on" / macOS; no screenshots are attached — the behavior is described here and in the issue.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⏳ |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

Machine evidence (2026-10-19, run on head `b90270059bfa6750f939ee0d89a684ffcda59bff` — a previous head of this PR, force-pushed to the current head `64e3423758a29bcbd151537030208f8d7f8fcda8`):

On the current head (2026-10-20, Docker `node:22-bookworm`): targeted re-run — ChatPane.test.tsx 192/192, ChatContextHeader.test.tsx 25/25, ManagedSessionsPage.test.tsx 105/105 (322/322, 0 failures). The full-suite rows below are on the head above; CI re-runs the full suite on the current head.

- 🍏 macOS — Docker `node:22-bookworm` (aarch64) on the macOS host (host node v26.5.0 cannot run vitest-jsdom — `window.localStorage` undefined in jsdom, established environment limitation): fresh container, copy of the branch tree, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` + root build — full web-shell client suite `vitest run --config vitest.config.ts` — 450 files / 12188 tests, all passed (12188/12188, 0 failures, 256.5s); `tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` — clean (0 errors); `eslint` on the changed files — 0 errors; `prettier --check` on the changed files — clean. Live E2E: 6-step CDP run (real user Chrome, daemon built from the branch) — S0–S5 PASS; this E2E ran on the previous head `68117bc7e5` (same feature, built before the rebase onto the current `main` tip). The machine evidence above was run on `b90270059b` (2026-10-19), a previous head of this PR; the force-push to the current head rebased the branch onto a newer `main` tip, and within this PR's own changes the only web-shell file that differs between the two heads is `ChatPane.test.tsx` (a test-only mock identity fix, covered by the targeted re-run on the current head above). The S5 scenario was additionally verified on the current head — see the Linux e2e line below.
- 🐧 Linux — same recipe (Docker `node:22-bookworm` (aarch64), fresh container, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`) — single fresh-container run on the macOS host (head `b90270059bfa6750f939ee0d89a684ffcda59bff`) — same numbers as the macOS row: 450 files / 12188 tests, all passed (12188/12188); tsc clean (0 errors); eslint 0 errors; prettier clean.
- 🪟 Windows — ⏳ pending: the UTM Win11 ARM VM was unavailable at publication time (full VM crash on 2026-10-18; power-on is a manual step in the UTM GUI). The earlier Windows run (ChatPane.test.tsx + tsc) was on the superseded head `f96df108d3` and is not cited here; the affected suites plus `tsc --noEmit` will be run on this head with `--pool=forks --poolOptions.forks.singleFork` and this row will be updated with the results.
- 🐧 Linux — S5 (2-pane Split View, rename of the second pane): PASS — separate Linux e2e container, 2026-10-20, PR head `64e3423758a29bcbd151537030208f8d7f8fcda8` (daemon serve built from the branch, real Chrome via CDP). Rename save produced exactly one `PATCH /session/<id>/metadata` in the daemon log with `displayName` persisted (`titleSource=manual`); Esc cancel produced 0 new PATCHes; 6 screenshots kept as local artifacts.

### Environment

macOS: Docker `node:22-bookworm` (aarch64) on macOS 26.6.2, fresh container (branch-tree copy, `--frozen-lockfile`); the live E2E used a daemon built from the branch (`node packages/cli/dist/index.js serve`) driven through real user Chrome via CDP. Linux: same Docker recipe as the macOS row. The S5 e2e used a separate e2e container (daemon built from the branch, `node packages/cli/dist/index.js serve`, real user Chrome driven via CDP). Windows (pending): UTM Win11 ARM VM (WinOnArm x64 emulation), node v22.23.3, pnpm 11.24.0, repo from the codeload archive of the branch base + sha256-verified overlay of the changed files.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a single click on the header title now opens rename — this is the intended behavior change requested in #14327. A click that finishes a text selection keeps its old behavior (the selection guard), a pane without a session has no rename affordance, and the title click does not stop propagation, so Radix deferred outside-press dismissal is preserved (covered by the real-popover regression test).
- Not validated / out of scope: the sidebar's double-click rename and all other sidebar surfaces are untouched; the Session Overview table and the TUI are unaffected. Standalone sessions are covered (they use the workspace client's standalone rename, mirroring the `/rename` command). The Windows machine run is pending (see Tested on).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No API, config, or data changes.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14327

prs.title: fix(core): treat a reassigned HOME as dynamic for cd and ~ targets
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A bare `cd` (and `~`, `~/…`) expands to bash's `$HOME`, but the analyzer resolved those targets from its own process environment. When the command reassigns `HOME` first, bash uses the value the command just set — which the analyzer never sees — so it certified the write against its own `HOME` with no uncertainty on a path it cannot know. This tracks `HOME` across compound segments (the same left-to-right way it already tracks `cd`) and, once a persistent reassignment has happened, resolves `cd`, `cd ~` and `cd ~/…` as dynamic; operations whose path came from a `~` token (including redirects with no `cd`) are marked `cwdUnknown` / `pathMayDependOnCwd` so the existing escalation paths apply.

Bash decides whether a word is an assignment *before* quote removal, so words are split once into their de-quoted value plus their raw source text: the assignment test reads the raw text, the self-reference test reads the value.

Only forms that change the parent shell's value latch the forfeiture:

- standalone assignment statements: `HOME=…`, `HOME+=…`, `HOME[0]=…`
- assignments after `export` / `declare` / `local` / `typeset` / `readonly` (and after a `command` / `builtin` prefix)
- `unset [-v] HOME`, `unset FOO HOME`
- `for HOME in …` / `select HOME in …` loop variables
- segments behind reserved words (`!`, `time`, `if` / `then` / `elif` / `else` / `while` / `until` / `do`) and redirect tokens before or after the assignment

Forms that cannot change the parent's `HOME` are explicitly not counted — and each row is a bash observation, not an assumption:

- self-referential values: `HOME=$HOME`, `HOME="$HOME"`, `HOME=${HOME}`, `HOME="${HOME}/"`, `HOME[0]=$HOME`, `export HOME=$HOME`
- command-scoped prefixes (`HOME=/x npm test`, `env HOME=/x node`), quoted words (`echo "HOME=/tmp"`, `git commit -m HOME=x`), subshells (`( export HOME=/x )`) and backgrounded segments (`HOME=/x sleep 1 &`)
- quoted or escaped **names**: `"HOME=/x"`, `'HOME=/x'`, `\HOME=/x`, `"HO"ME=/x` are command names for bash (rc=127, `HOME` unchanged)
- forms bash rejects: `export HOME[0]=…` / `readonly HOME[0]=…` (`not a valid identifier`, `HOME` unchanged); `HOME[1]=…` (array element only)
- `unset -f HOME` / `unset -n HOME` (function / nameref lookups, not the variable)

Function scope is modelled too: `local`, `declare` and `typeset` inside a function body latch only for the rest of that body, `declare -g` persists, and top-level `declare` / `typeset` persist. Each open body is a stack entry, so a nested function's `local` does not outlive it.

Two related shapes are also closed:

- `HOME=/x cd` — leading assignment tokens are stripped before dispatch, so the segment is recognized as a `cd` (previously it bailed at `words[0] !== 'cd'` and the following writes were resolved against the original cwd with full confidence).
- the latch is threaded into the `bash -lc` / `sh -c` unwrap and into prefix commands (`timeout`, `nohup`, `env`) and `find -exec`, so `export HOME=/tmp/attacker ; timeout 5 bash -c 'echo {} > ~/settings.json'` is uncertain too.

## Why it's needed

`export HOME=/tmp/attacker && cd && echo {} > settings.json` certified `settings.json` against the analyzer's `HOME` and reported no uncertainty, even though the resulting path is unknown. Every other non-static `cd` target already resolves as dynamic; this closes the remaining case where the analyzer reads its own environment instead of the command's.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

From the repo root, run `pnpm -C packages/core exec vitest run src/permissions/` — `shell-semantics.test.ts` runs 118 cases, all passing.

The forfeiture cases yield `uncertainWrite('/repo/settings.json')`: `export HOME=… && cd && …`, `HOME=… ; cd ; …`, `unset HOME && …`, `unset -v HOME && …`, `unset FOO HOME && …`, `HOME+=/.qwen ; cd ; …`, `HOME[0]=… ; cd ; …`, `declare HOME[0]=… ; cd ; …`, `for HOME in …; do cd; done`, `! export HOME=… ; cd ; …`, `if true; then export HOME=…; fi ; cd ; …`, `HOME=/tmp/attacker > /dev/null ; cd ; …`, `command export HOME=… ; cd ; …`, `builtin export HOME=… ; cd ; …`, `cd ~` and `cd ~/work` after a reassignment, `export HOME=… && echo {} > ~/settings.json`, the wrapper forms above, and `HOME=/repo/.qwen cd && …`. Every one of these assertions pins `process.env['HOME'] = '/home/tester'` in a `try/finally`, because a HOME-less process would make a bare `cd` dynamic anyway and let the test pass with the guard removed.

The ordering pin keeps `cd ; export HOME=/tmp/attacker ; echo {} > settings.json` resolving to the certain `/home/tester/settings.json`, matching bash where the `cd` runs before the assignment, so a later reassignment cannot reach back and turn an earlier `cd` dynamic.

The non-persistent forms keep their previous static results, one case each: `git commit -m HOME=x`, `echo HOME=…`, quoted `"HOME=/tmp"`, `HOME=/tmp/fake npm test`, `env HOME=/tmp/app node`, `HOME=/x sleep 1 &`, `( export HOME=/tmp/attacker )`, `{ export HOME=/x; } & cd`, `{ export HOME=/x; } | cat`, `export HOME | cat`, and `export HOME` / `export HOME[0]=…` without a value.

`cd`-target extraction also pins that redirections survive: `TMPDIR=/t cd build > build.log` writes `<cwd>/build.log`, `FOO=1 cd < input.txt` reads `<cwd>/input.txt`, and `cd # note` / `cd dir#part` resolve to `/home/tester` / `/home/tester/dir#part`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible surface; the tests are the evidence.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️ covered by CI   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️ covered by CI   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a `cd`, `cd ~`, `cd ~/…` or `~/…` path after a persistent `HOME` reassignment is now dynamic, so the following relative operations are uncertain instead of statically known. For a rule pinned at the old home path (say `deny WriteFileTool(~/settings.json)`), the command's real target is the new `HOME`, so the operation no longer resolves to the denied path and can fall to `ask` rather than `deny` — which is the honest outcome once the target is genuinely unknown to the analyzer. Commands that do not persist a reassignment keep their exact previous evaluation, including hard `deny`.
- Deliberately conservative, erring toward an extra prompt: a `~` inside quotes is still treated as HOME-derived (bash does not expand it), and once `HOME` is dynamic any op at or under the analyzer's `~` is marked, not only ops whose `~` token matched exactly.
- Not validated / out of scope: mutation through indirection (`eval`, `read HOME`, `printf -v HOME`, `HOME=$(…)`, `readonly`/`declare` failure after the fact, `bash --posix` `. ` builtin) is still not detected, and for these shapes the analyzer keeps its old behaviour — a static attribution against its own `HOME`, not a fallback to dynamic. Modeling them needs an interpreter-level analysis; the file's known-limitations header covers that family, and this PR does not claim otherwise.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Addresses the R3-7 item of #14095.

bash 在**去引号之前**就判定一个词是否为赋值，因此词被一次切分为"去引号后的值 + 原始文本"：赋值判定读原始文本，自引用判定读值。

只有真正改变父 shell 取值的形态才触发：

- 独立赋值语句：`HOME=…`、`HOME+=…`、`HOME[0]=…`
- 位于 `export` / `declare` / `local` / `typeset` / `readonly` 之后的赋值（以及 `command` / `builtin` 前缀之后）

- `for HOME in …` / `select HOME in …` 的循环变量

无法改变父 shell `HOME` 的形态明确不计入——每一条都来自 bash 实测，而非假设：

- 自引用取值：`HOME=$HOME`、`HOME="$HOME"`、`HOME=${HOME}`、`HOME="${HOME}/"`、`HOME[0]=$HOME`、`export HOME=$HOME`

- `unset -f HOME` / `unset -n HOME`（函数 / nameref 查找，不是该变量）

函数作用域也被建模：函数体内的 `local`、`declare`、`typeset` 只对**该函数体后续**生效，`declare -g` 持久，顶层 `declare` / `typeset` 持久；每个打开的函数体是栈上的一项，嵌套函数的 `local` 不会泄漏到外层。

另外两处相关形态也一并补上：

- `HOME=/x cd`——派发前剥离前导赋值标记，使该段被识别为 `cd`（此前在 `words[0] !== 'cd'` 处直接放弃，导致后续写入以原始 cwd 满信心解析）。
- 该状态被传入 `bash -lc` / `sh -c` 展开逻辑，并贯穿 `timeout` / `nohup` / `env` 等前缀命令与 `find -exec`，因此 `export HOME=/tmp/attacker ; timeout 5 bash -c 'echo {} > ~/settings.json'` 同样是不确定的。

## 为什么需要

`export HOME=/tmp/attacker && cd && echo {} > settings.json` 会把 `settings.json` 对分析器自己的 `HOME` 完成判定并报告无不确定性，而实际路径未知。其他所有非静态 `cd` 目标本就解析为 dynamic；本改动补上了最后一处"读取分析器自身环境而非命令环境"的情况。

| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️ 由 CI 覆盖   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️ 由 CI 覆盖   |

- 主要风险或取舍：持久重赋值之后的 `cd`、`cd ~`、`cd ~/…` 与 `~/…` 路径变为 dynamic，后续相对操作由静态已知变为不确定。对于钉在旧 home 路径上的规则（例如 `deny WriteFileTool(~/settings.json)`），命令的真实目标已是新的 `HOME`，该操作不再解析到被拒绝的路径，可能由 `deny` 落为 `ask`——在目标确实无法被分析器得知时，这是诚实的结果。没有持久重赋值的命令保持完全一致的既有判定，包括硬 `deny`。

prs.title: fix(core): keep reasoning and function_call items adjacent through Responses cleanup
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The Responses request pipeline now treats a replayed reasoning item and the group of function calls that immediately follow it (a parallel tool group) as one unit during request cleanup, at both sites that rewrite history. The orphan cleanup drops a function call whose output is missing, and it drops the preceding reasoning item only when every call in that reasoning's group is gone; when a sibling call survives, the reasoning stays because the surviving call still needs it. The reasoning-rejection recovery removes the whole group, plus the calls' outputs, whenever the group's reasoning item goes away: a signature-only item is dropped with its group, and an item with a visible summary becomes an assistant message carrying that text while its group is removed, since the endpoint's pairing error names the reasoning item itself and an assistant message does not satisfy it. One shared helper computes a reasoning item's following call group for both sites, and the recovery logs how many units it removed, so a retry that dropped tool results no longer reads identically to one that kept them.

## Why it's needed

The Responses endpoint requires a replayed reasoning item and its following function call group to stay adjacent, and rejects the whole request when either half is missing. Two cleanup transformations broke that invariant independently, and the first revision of this fix still encoded a one-to-one pairing the wire does not guarantee: popping the reasoning beside a single orphaned call could strip the reasoning a surviving sibling call needed, and dropping only the first call of a rejected reasoning's group left the rest of the group dangling. Because history is rebuilt unchanged on every send, these shapes did not fail once and heal; they failed the same way on every subsequent request in the session. Reported in #11665 with a deterministic loopback probe.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The regression tests pin the unit semantics at both cleanup sites: an orphaned call with no surviving sibling takes its reasoning with it; an orphaned call with a surviving sibling leaves the reasoning in place; a rejected reasoning, whether signature-only or carrying a visible summary, takes its entire call group and the group's outputs with it. Run the generator's test suite and confirm the full file set is green, not just the new cases.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (wire-protocol cleanup, not user-visible UI). Before: the new tests fail against the previous revision at the group shapes. After: the whole `openaiResponsesContentGenerator` suite passes, 351/351.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A (unit tests only: `npx vitest run src/core/openaiResponsesContentGenerator/` from `packages/core`, plus repo build, typecheck and lint).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the recovery path now drops a completed tool call group from the retry body whenever that group's reasoning was rejected, including the visible-summary case, where the summary text survives as an assistant message but the calls and results do not. Losing the group is what makes the retry, and every later send, wire-valid again under the pairing rule the endpoint's own error strings describe; keeping it previously meant the session failed permanently. If the endpoint in fact accepts an assistant message as the preceding item, the summary path could keep its call group; that is a maintainer call, flagged in the review thread, and safe to relax later without touching the signature-only path.
- Not validated / out of scope: no live endpoint round-trip locally (no credentials); verification is unit-level plus the pipeline suite. Adjacent reasoning items that were never paired with a function call are left as-is, matching current behavior.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for package consumers; wire behavior changes only for requests that previously failed with a 400.
- Affiliation: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #11665

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

Responses 请求管线现在把重放的 reasoning 条目和紧随其后的一组 function call（并行工具组）当作一个整体，在两个改写历史的清理点都按这个单元处理。孤立调用清理会丢弃缺少输出的 function call；只有当该 reasoning 所属组里的调用全部被清掉时，才一并丢弃前面的 reasoning 条目——如果同组还有存活的兄弟调用，reasoning 会保留，因为存活的调用仍然需要它。reasoning 拒绝恢复路径在组内 reasoning 条目消失时会移除整组以及这些调用的输出：纯签名条目连同其调用组一起丢弃；带可见摘要的条目会变成携带该摘要文本的 assistant 消息，同时移除其调用组，因为端点的配对错误点名的是 reasoning 条目本身，assistant 消息并不能顶替它。两处共用同一个 helper 来计算 reasoning 的后续调用组，恢复路径还会记录移除了多少个单元，这样「重试成功但工具结果被删」和「重试成功且保留」在日志里不再长得一样。

## 为什么需要

Responses 端点要求重放的 reasoning 条目与其后续 function call 组保持相邻，缺了任何一半都会拒绝整个请求。此前两个清理变换各自独立地破坏了这个不变量，而本修复的第一版仍然写死了 wire 并不保证的一对一配对关系：在单个孤立调用旁弹出 reasoning，可能删掉存活兄弟调用仍需要的 reasoning；只丢弃被拒绝 reasoning 组里的第一个调用，会让组里其余调用悬空。由于每次发送都会原样重建历史，这些形态不是失败一次就自愈，而是在会话里此后每一次请求都以同样方式失败。#11665 用确定性的 loopback 探针报告了该问题。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

回归测试在两个清理点都钉住了单元语义：没有存活兄弟的孤立调用会带走其 reasoning；有存活兄弟的孤立调用会保留 reasoning；被拒绝的 reasoning（无论纯签名还是带可见摘要）会带走整个调用组及组的输出。请运行该生成器的测试套件，确认整个文件集全绿，而不只是新用例。

### 前后对比证据

N/A（线上协议清理，不涉及用户可见界面）。修复前：新测试在上一版修订上按组的形态失败。修复后：整个 `openaiResponsesContentGenerator` 套件 351/351 通过。

### 测试平台

macOS 已测；Windows / Linux 未本地测试（由 CI 覆盖）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：恢复路径现在会在组内 reasoning 被拒绝时从重试请求体里丢弃整个已完成的工具调用组，包括带可见摘要的情形——摘要文本会以 assistant 消息保留，但调用与结果不会。丢弃该组是让重试以及此后每次发送重新满足线上合法性的代价，合法性按端点自身错误串描述的配对规则理解；此前保留它意味着会话会永久失败。如果端点其实接受 assistant 消息作为前导条目，摘要路径今后可以保留其调用组——这一点已在评审串中标注为维护者判断项，将来放宽不会影响纯签名路径。
- 未验证 / 范围外：本地没有跑真实端点往返（无凭据）；验证为单元级加管线套件。从未与 function call 配对的相邻 reasoning 条目保持原样，与当前行为一致。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：对包使用者无破坏；线上行为只影响此前会以 400 失败的请求。
- 利益关系：无。

</details>

auto_merge.commit_title: fix(core): keep reasoning and function_call items adjacent through Responses cleanup (#11684)
auto_merge.commit_message:
* fix(core): keep reasoning and function_call items adjacent through Responses cleanup

Two Responses request-pipeline cleanups broke the endpoint's
reasoning/function_call adjacency invariant, and both failures
poisoned every later send because history is never rewritten:

- The orphan cleanup dropped an output-less function_call but kept
  the reasoning item immediately preceding it, sending reasoning
  with no required following item.
- The reasoning-rejection recovery dropped a signature-only
  reasoning item but kept the function_call that followed it, so
  the one permitted recovery retry failed as function_call without
  its required reasoning item.

Repair at the same adjacency the endpoint enforces: dropping an
orphaned call now takes the preceding reasoning item with it, and
dropping a signature-only reasoning item now takes the following
call unit (call plus its output) with it.

Fixes #11665

* fix(core): treat a reasoning item and its following call group as one unit

Review on the previous round found the two hunks each encoded a
one-to-one pairing the wire does not guarantee. A replayed reasoning
item heads the maximal run of function_call items after it (a parallel
tool group), and the endpoint pairs them positionally, so the unit is
the whole group:

- cleanOrphanedFunctionCalls now drops a reasoning item only when every
  call in its group is orphaned, and keeps it when a sibling survives;
  popping it alongside a single orphaned member could turn a valid
  request into function_call without its required reasoning item.
- downgradeRejectedReasoningItems removes the entire group plus outputs
  when its reasoning goes away, not just the first call, and the
  summary downgrade emits the assistant message without keeping the
  group, since the pairing error names the reasoning item itself.
- The group scan is one shared helper used by both sites, and the
  downgrade logs how many units it removed so a retry that dropped
  tool results no longer looks identical to one that kept them.

* fix(core): drop the tool-media follow-up of a removed reasoning-call unit

Round three's items on #11684:

- The unit drop now also removes the captioned tool-media user message the
  converter flushes right after the unit's outputs; otherwise the retry
  carries "(attached media from previous tool call)" with no tool call left
  in the request. The drop stays positional: a later surviving group's media
  message is untouched.
- The docstring over downgradeRejectedReasoningItems said every other item
  stays byte-exact, which stopped being true when the call-group drop
  landed; it now names the unit-drop explicitly.
- The NOTE over the signature-only chunk emission pointed at geminiChat.ts
  keeping the first thoughtSignature per turn; consolidation lives in
  llm-chat.ts now and concatenates until a complete Responses signature, so
  the NOTE reads the current behavior.

Pins added for the two test gaps the review called out: the
encrypted-recovery delegation with maxLength null drops the whole unit, and
a second surviving call group keeps its calls, outputs, and media when the
first group is dropped.

* fix(core): downgrade the adjacent kept episode left bare by a rejected episode's unit drop

Two signed episodes replay adjacently and only the later one is over the reported maximum. The earlier episode's group scan breaks on the later reasoning item, so the rejected episode's unit drop removes the only call group in the turn and the kept episode would retry as a bare reasoning item, which the endpoint pairs out the same way. Sweep the rewritten items and downgrade any kept reasoning item whose original immediate follower left no trace, preserving its summary as an assistant message; an episode whose follower survived, even as a downgraded message, still stays.

* fix(core): narrow the bare-episode sweep to unit-dropped successors

The sweep fired on any removed successor, so a kept reasoning item whose
sibling was dropped merely for carrying no summary was rewritten into an
assistant message and its accepted encrypted_content was discarded. The
endpoint pairs a reasoning item with its call group, not with a
neighbouring reasoning, so only a successor taken by a unit drop leaves
a pairing debt. Track those in unitDroppedOriginals (the unit's calls,
the rejected reasoning when nothing of it survives, and the sweep's own
cascade) and test membership in that set alone.

The five reasoning-recovery pipeline tests are green again, and the
adjacent-episode case the sweep was written for stays downgraded.

* fix(core): drop the whole reasoning run heading an orphaned call group

Two adjacent signed episodes can head one call group. The per-item scan
breaks on the next reasoning item, so the earlier episode survived bare
even after every call in the group was dropped. When the group dies, pop
the maximal consecutive reasoning run off the kept tail instead of only
the single heading item.

Pin: drops the whole reasoning run heading a fully orphaned group; red
without the pop, while the sibling-survivor and mid-group cases stay
green.

* test(core): pin the bare-episode sweep's summary-less cascade

A chain of adjacent summary-less episodes ahead of one rejected unit
settles only because the sweep records each removal it makes; without
that, the head of the chain survives bare. Red when the cascade stops
recording, green again with it.

* fix(core): cover custom_tool_call groups in the reasoning-unit sweeps

followingFunctionCallIds broke its scan on the first non-function_call
item, so a reasoning run heading a custom_tool_call group read as an
empty group: the pair cleanup kept the head unconditionally, and the
rejection path dropped the head without the group, orphaning the calls
on the retry wire (#13233).

Widen the helper to both call types and carry each entry's type through,
since the output lookup keys differ (function_call_output vs
custom_tool_call_output). Rename it followingCallGroup to match.

---------

prs.title: fix(cli): probe ICU before the UI import so an ICU-less Node fails loud
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The CLI now probes the Node runtime for working ICU data before the UI bundle is imported, and exits with an actionable error naming the missing package instead of dying silently. On a host whose Node was built with small-icu but has no data package (RHEL ships it separately as nodejs-full-i18n), the interactive UI previously crashed: the text utilities construct an Intl.Segmenter at module load, V8 segfaults inside JSSegments::Create, and the relaunch loop turns the dead child into a silent return to the shell. The probe runs the same Segmenter construction in a throwaway child process — an in-process probe would take the parent down with it — and only on hosts whose build flags say ICU might be missing, so a normal startup pays nothing.

## Why it's needed

Reported in #11747 on RHEL 10: qwen returned to the shell with no message, and only running with the relaunch disabled exposed a SIGSEGV. A user on such a host has no way to tell a missing OS package apart from a broken install; the fix makes the failure say exactly which package to install.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

On a normal full-icu Node the probe short-circuits on the build flag and never spawns a child, so `qwen` starts exactly as before. The unit tests pin both directions with an injected probe: a child that exits 139 (SIGSEGV) yields exit code 1 with a message naming full ICU data and nodejs-full-i18n, a clean child lets startup continue, and a probe that cannot even spawn is treated as missing ICU. Run the file's suite and confirm all four cases pass. On a RHEL 10 host without nodejs-full-i18n (the reporter's setup), `qwen` should now print the actionable error and exit 1 instead of returning silently to the shell; installing the package should start the TUI as it did for the reporter.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (startup guard, no UI change). Before: silent exit (SIGSEGV 139 visible only with the relaunch disabled). After: an actionable stderr message and exit code 1 on the broken host; unchanged startup on healthy ones.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests: `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/utils/icu-check.test.ts`, plus repo build and typecheck. The RHEL host itself was not reproduced locally; the failing mechanism (Segmenter at module load, SIGSEGV in V8) is from the issue's coredump and the fix targets exactly that import boundary.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: on small-icu hosts with working data the probe spawns one throwaway child at startup (tens of milliseconds on that minority path); full-icu hosts skip it entirely via the build flag.
- Not validated / out of scope: the RHEL distro package layout itself is unverified locally; nothing about how the TUI uses the Segmenter changes. Non-interactive and serve paths that share the same import boundary are covered by the same check, since the import is the crash point.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; only broken hosts see a new, explicit failure where they used to see a silent crash.
- Affiliation: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #11747

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

CLI 现在在导入 UI 包之前先探测 Node 运行时是否有可用的 ICU 数据，探测失败时给出指明缺失软件包的可操作错误，而不是无声无息地死掉。当宿主机的 Node 以 small-icu 构建且没有数据包时（RHEL 把它拆成单独的 nodejs-full-i18n 包），此前交互界面会直接崩溃：文本工具在模块加载时就构造 Intl.Segmenter，V8 在 JSSegments::Create 里段错误，relaunch 循环再把死掉子进程变成一次静默的返回 shell。探针在一个一次性子进程里执行同样的 Segmenter 构造（在进程内探测会把父进程一起带走），并且只在构建标记提示 ICU 可能缺失的宿主机上运行，所以正常启动零开销。

## 为什么需要

#11747 在 RHEL 10 上报告：qwen 没有任何提示就退回 shell，只有关掉 relaunch 才看到 SIGSEGV。这种宿主机上的用户无法区分是系统缺包还是安装损坏；这个修复让失败信息直接写明该装哪个包。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

在正常的 full-icu Node 上，探针按构建标记短路、不会派生子进程，`qwen` 启动与之前完全一致。单元测试用注入的探针钉住两个方向：以 139（SIGSEGV）退出的子进程会让启动以退出码 1 失败、报错信息点名 full ICU data 与 nodejs-full-i18n；干净的子进程放行启动；连子进程都派不出来的情况按缺失 ICU 处理。请运行该文件的测试套件确认四个用例全过。在没有 nodejs-full-i18n 的 RHEL 10 宿主机（报告者环境）上，`qwen` 现在应打印可操作的错误并以退出码 1 结束，而不是静默退回 shell；装上该包后 TUI 应能正常启动。

### 前后对比证据

N/A（启动保护，无界面变化）。修复前：静默退出（只有禁用 relaunch 才能看到 SIGSEGV 139）。修复后：故障宿主机上输出可操作的 stderr 信息并以退出码 1 结束；健康宿主机启动不变。

### 测试平台

macOS 已测；Windows / Linux 未本地测试（由 CI 覆盖）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：在 small-icu 但数据完好的宿主机上，探针每次启动会多派生一个一次性子进程（少数路径上几十毫秒）；full-icu 宿主机按构建标记完全跳过。
- 未验证 / 范围外：RHEL 发行版的包布局本身未在本地验证；TUI 如何使用 Segmenter 没有任何改动。共用同一导入边界的非交互与 serve 路径也被同一检查覆盖，因为崩溃点就在那次导入。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无；只有故障宿主机会看到一个新的、明确的失败，取代原来的静默崩溃。
- 利益关系：无。

</details>

auto_merge.commit_title: fix(cli): probe ICU before the UI import so an ICU-less Node fails loud (#11753)
auto_merge.commit_message:
* fix(cli): probe ICU before the UI import so an ICU-less Node fails loud

On a Node built with small-icu and no data package (RHEL splits it into
nodejs-full-i18n), the interactive UI died silently: textUtils constructs
an Intl.Segmenter at module load, V8 segfaults inside JSSegments::Create,
and the relaunch loop turned the dead child into a silent return to the
shell. Probe the runtime in a throwaway child before importing llm.tsx —
an in-process probe would take the parent down with it — and only on
hosts whose build flags say ICU might be missing, so normal startups pay
nothing. A broken host now gets an actionable error naming the package
to install and exits 1.

Fixes #11747

* fix(cli): probe a real segmentation and scrub the probe child's env

Review follow-up: the construct-only probe missed the actual failure
mode — on small-icu builds the Segmenter constructor succeeds and the
first .segment() call dereferences the missing break-iterator data
(Builtin_SegmenterPrototypeSegment in the reporter's coredump). The
probe now iterates a grapheme segmentation so it exercises the crash
frame itself.

The gate no longer requires icu_small=true: official and full-icu
builds record icu_small=false and still skip the child entirely, while
small-icu (the RHEL/Fedora packaging, which ships break-iterator data
in nodejs-full-i18n) and builds that don't record the key both probe.

Also scrub NODE_OPTIONS from the probe child's environment: an
inherited --require/--import that fails would crash the child for
unrelated reasons and misdiagnose the host as ICU-less.

Tests now cover the icu_small branch (false/true/unrecorded) via the
exported icuSmallNeedsProbe predicate, pin the full-icu fast path
(probe never invoked), exercise the real defaultProbe child on a
healthy runtime, and prove the NODE_OPTIONS scrub with a bogus
--require.

* fix(cli): harden the ICU probe against a missing Intl binding and a parent --icu-data-dir

Review round two: needsProbe() read `typeof Intl.Segmenter`, which
throws ReferenceError instead of reporting when a no-icu build strips
the Intl binding itself. Guard the binding first.

The probe child also launched with a bare execPath, so a user who
repaired ICU with Node's own --icu-data-dir had a working parent but a
faulting child, misdiagnosed as ICU-less. Forward the flag (both the
space and = forms) into the probe's argv.

Tests cover the Intl-less runtime (probe runs, no throw) and both
icu-data-dir spellings reaching the child; 11/11 green, eslint and
prettier clean.

* fix(cli): scope the ICU probe to the interactive path and clean its child env

Round three's findings, addressed together:

- The gate moves from the cli.ts import boundary into llm.tsx main(), gated
  on config.isInteractive() minus the Zed integration. Headless and ACP runs
  never reach .segment(), and on a broken host they must not be refused for
  a defect they cannot hit. This also takes the probe out of the
  geminiImportMs window.
- The probe child env now goes through scrubInheritedLoaderEnv() (the
  canonical loader-env scrub), then NODE_OPTIONS / npm_config_node_options
  are restored after a hook-only content scrub via the new
  scrubNodeOptionsLoaderFlags() in shared-env-keys.ts, so an --icu-data-dir
  the host relies on survives while a broken --require does not.
- A probe child that fails to spawn (spawnSync error) is no longer read as
  an ICU verdict: assertFullIcuAvailable warns and continues instead of
  exiting 1 on a healthy host with a transient fork failure.

Tests pin the branches the review called out: icu_small stubbing in both
directions through process.config redefinition, the probe source actually
performing .segment() (string-pinned plus the real-child integration case),
NODE_OPTIONS scrubbing unit and end-to-end, and the interactive/headless
gate plus probe-before-render ordering in llm.test.tsx.

The module moves from utils/ to startup/ because utils/ may not import
config/ (architecture rule #9146); startup/ is the layer that may.

prs.title: fix(cli): prevent provider menu overlap in short terminals
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Keeps provider selection readable in short terminals by fitting the menu to the available rows and columns. Long menus scroll with the existing keyboard selection, resizing preserves the highlighted option, and the divider follows the available width. The full privacy URL remains visible when space permits; extremely small windows prioritize a selectable row.

## Why it's needed

The outer layout limits dialog height, but the provider menu previously rendered its full content without that budget. Ink compressed titles and descriptions into overlapping rows. This reproduces in both 40×19 and 140×19 terminals: narrow width adds wrapping, but insufficient height alone is enough.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open provider selection with an isolated configuration in 40×19 and 140×19 terminals. Navigate through all four main options; titles and descriptions should occupy separate rows, and the full privacy URL should remain readable.
2. Enter third-party providers and navigate to Requesty. Resize from short to tall and back; the highlighted provider should remain selected. Expand the terminal and confirm Requesty opens its API Key step.
3. Reduce the terminal to 40×6. The remaining menu row should still support keyboard navigation.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The original 40×19 terminal capture contains merged text such as `Alibaba ModelStudiod setup:` and `Custom Providerin provider and`. After the change, titles and descriptions occupy separate rows and navigation scrolls the visible options. At 140×19, all four options fit without overlap. The accompanying verification comment includes the actual before/after captures and detailed results.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Targeted tmux verification; runtime boundary below |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested |

### Environment (optional)

The modified provider component was transpiled into a copied 0.26.2 published runtime, with the dialog height argument connected. This exercises real Ink rendering and keyboard input; it is not a full build of this branch. Source hashes match the verified production files. The regression test was added but not run. Formatting and `git diff --check` completed; no unit tests, build, typecheck, lint, or remote review dry-run was run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Compact menus show fewer options at once. If even one complete option cannot fit, its text is truncated so navigation remains possible.
- Not validated / out of scope: iTerm2, Windows, Linux, the full branch runtime, and the existing multi-step provider forms. The form was entered only after enlarging the terminal.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. No settings or provider credentials are changed by this layout fix.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15793

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的功能

根据可用行列数调整 provider 菜单，避免矮窗口中的叠字。长菜单通过已有键盘选择机制滚动，缩放时保留高亮，分隔线跟随可用宽度。空间允许时保留完整隐私 URL；极小窗口优先保留一行可选择的菜单。

## 为什么需要

外层布局限制了弹窗高度，但 provider 菜单此前没有接收该预算，仍渲染全部内容，导致 Ink 将标题和说明压缩到重叠的行中。40×19 和 140×19 均可复现：窄宽度会增加换行，但仅高度不足也足以触发。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 使用隔离配置，在 40×19 和 140×19 终端打开 provider 选择，依次导航四个主选项。标题与说明应分行显示，完整隐私 URL 应可读。
2. 进入第三方 provider 菜单并导航到 Requesty。将窗口从矮变高再变矮，高亮应保持不变。放大后确认 Requesty 能进入 API Key 步骤。
3. 缩小到 40×6，剩余的一行菜单仍应支持键盘导航。

### 修改前后证据

原始 40×19 捕获中出现 `Alibaba ModelStudiod setup:`、`Custom Providerin provider and` 等合并文字。修改后标题与说明分行显示，导航会滚动可见选项。140×19 下四个选项均能显示且不重叠。另附验证评论包含实际前后终端捕获及详细结果。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 定向 tmux 验证；运行环境边界见下文 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测试 |

### 环境

将修改后的 provider 组件转译并替换进复制的 0.26.2 发布包，同时接入弹窗高度参数。验证使用真实 Ink 渲染和键盘输入，但不是本分支的完整构建。源码哈希与已验证的生产文件一致。已添加回归用例但未运行。已完成格式化和 `git diff --check`，未运行单测、构建、类型检查、lint 或远程 review dry-run。

## 风险与范围

- 主要权衡：紧凑菜单同时显示更少选项；如果连一个完整选项都放不下，会截断文字以保留导航。
- 未验证或不在范围内：iTerm2、Windows、Linux、完整分支运行环境及原有多步骤 provider 表单；仅在放大窗口后验证了进入表单。

修复 #15793。
